texts.en:
He closes his eyes. You can see his jaw tighten a little.

"The Hegemony has determined that it's not my concern anymore." Orcus opens his eyes. They are cold, and clear. "We'll see."
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛。你能看到他的下颌稍稍绷紧。

"霸主已经认定，这不再是我的事了。\"Orcus 睁开眼。那双眼睛又冷又清。\"我们走着瞧。"

texts.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"Not my problem anymore. It's over."
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"不再是我的问题了。都结束了。"

texts.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"Not my problem anymore. It's over."
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"不再是我的问题了。都结束了。"

texts.en:
He gives you a weary look.

"Sindria is toast. Macario with it." A long pause. "That's the line, anyway. The Hegemony has determined that it's not my concern anymore."

"So it's not."
texts.zh:
他疲惫地看了你一眼。

"Sindria 完了。Macario 也跟着完了。\"长久的沉默。\"至少官方是这么说的。霸主已经认定，这不再是我的事了。"

"那就不是吧。"

texts.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"He won."

A hand reflexively balls into a fist, loosely. Rao notices himself, and relaxes. Another sigh.
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"他赢了。"

一只手不自觉地松松握成拳。Rao 自己察觉到了，松开手。又是一声叹息。

texts.en:
"There's no reward for this, $titleHeg. My funding has been frozen pending an investigation."

"I'll be facing a court-martial. Not my first," he adds with a joyless smile. "But I imagine my assignment at Ragnar is going to be renewed until they convince me to retire. It's... what this place is for."

"You keep your head down for a bit, $titleHeg. I take full responsibility for the operation, but they're still going to be looking for people to blame. It's the Hegemony way."
texts.zh:
"这件事没有奖赏，$titleHeg。我的经费已被冻结，等候调查。"

"我要上军事法庭了。这倒不是第一次，\"他补了一句，笑意里没有半分快活。\"不过我猜，我在 Ragnar 的任职会被无限续下去，直到他们说服我退休为止。这地方...就是干这个用的。"

"你也把头低一阵子，$titleHeg。这次行动由我负全责，可他们照样会找人来背锅。这就是霸主的做派。"

texts.en: "My budget is being put under review, but I'm going to make sure you get something for your trouble." He taps something on his datapad.
texts.zh: "我的预算正在被重新审查，不过我会确保你为自己这些麻烦拿到点东西。"他在数据板上点了点什么。

texts.en:
"They're going to call me to stand before the Strategic Council," he says wearily. "An inquiry. Effectively a court-martial but they're not quite calling it that for," he snorts, "public morale."

"I can handle them. Have before, will again. Don't think I'll be leaving Ragnar any time soon though."
texts.zh:
"他们会叫我到战略委员会面前站着，\"他疲惫地说。\"一次调查。实质上就是军事法庭，只是他们不肯这么叫，为了，\"他哼了一声，\"为了士气。"

"我应付得了他们。以前应付过，以后也还得应付。不过我想，我短期内是离不开 Ragnar 了。"

texts.en:
"There's a bit of leftover budget. I'm sure the auditors won't be too put out if I ensure you're rewarded for your service."

"And who knows," he says, "Maybe when everything settles down I'll get promoted out of this back-orbit dumpster and given a seat on some committee. Plenty of those to go around."

He looks off and far away. "Hoping for somewhere warm... not Jangala though, ugh."
texts.zh:
"还剩一点预算。我确保你因这份效劳得到奖赏，审计官们想必不会太介意。"

"谁知道呢，\"他说，\"等一切平息下来，说不定我能从这个后轨道的垃圾堆里升出去，在某个委员会里弄个位子。那种位子多得是。"

他望向远处。"想找个暖和点的地方...不过别是 Jangala，唉。"

texts.en:
"There's a bit of leftover budget. I'm sure the auditors won't be too put out if I ensure you're rewarded for delivering what even they will be forced to admit is a victory."

"And you know what?," his grin only grows, "I have a pretty good feeling that I'm going to get promoted out of this back-orbit dumpster and given a seat on a decent committee. If I'm lucky, I'll even get a choice in the matter!"

"I'm hoping for..." He looks off and far away, basking in an imagined sun. "Somewhere warm. Not Jangala though, ugh."
texts.zh:
"还剩一点预算。我确保你因交付了一场连他们都不得不承认的胜利而得到奖赏，审计官们想必不会太介意。"

"你猜怎么着？\"他的笑越咧越开，\"我有种很好的预感：我能从这个后轨道的垃圾堆里升出去，在一个像样的委员会里弄个位子。运气好的话，我甚至还能自己挑一个！"

"我想去...\"他望向远处，像在享受一轮想象出来的太阳。\"暖和一点的地方。不过别是 Jangala，唉。"

texts.en:
"The auditors are going to be merciless, $titleHeg. My funding is frozen. Under investigation."

He seems older, somehow, and listless, like a ship that's lost most of its maneuvering thrusters.

"I'll be facing a court-martial, of course. Quiet retirement and keeping my mouth shut is about the best I can hope for. They'll be out for blood - someone to blame."

Rao takes a deep breath, then his eyes turn to meet yours through the link.

"I'm done. You... you keep your head down. Even if they find the idiot who provided the Diktat with a PK, the knives will be out."
texts.zh:
"审计官们不会手下留情，$titleHeg。我的经费被冻结了。正在被调查。"

他不知怎么的，看上去更老了，也提不起劲，像一艘丢掉了大半姿态推进器的船。

"我当然要上军事法庭。安静退休、把嘴闭上，差不多就是我能指望的最好结局。他们要来喝血的——总得有人背这个。"

Rao 深吸一口气，然后目光穿过通讯链路，与你的目光相接。

"我完了。你...你也把头低下去吧。就算他们找到那个给辛达强权送上行星杀手的白痴，刀也已经出鞘了。"

texts.en:
Rao appears. He looks tired. But by his eyes you can see he's smiling inside.

"It's good to see you, $titleHeg." He takes a moment, a deep breath.

"We did it."
texts.zh:
Rao 出现在画面里。他看上去很疲惫。但从他的眼神里能看出，他心里在笑。

"见到你真好，$titleHeg。"他顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"我们做到了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Rao appears. He looks tired. He doesn't even look at you.

"I still can't believe the crazy drunk did it," he says.

Now his eyes go to the feed, to you. "There's going to be an inquiry."
texts.zh:
Rao 出现在画面里。他看上去很疲惫。他甚至没有看你。

"我还是没法相信，那个疯酒鬼居然办成了，"他说。

这时他的目光才转到通讯画面，落到你身上。"接下来会有调查。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"The Hegemony is the living remnant of the Domain. The only authorized possessor of planet-killers." He snorts. "That's the official line."

"Some stupid spacer hard-up for credits must have found a PK somewhere out in the Fringe and thought selling it to the Diktat would be..." he trails off, shaking his head. "Who knows."

He looks away for a long moment.
texts.zh:
"霸主是人之领活着的残片。是唯一被授权持有行星杀手的势力。\"他哼了一声。\"官方说法就是这样。"

"准是哪个缺钱缺疯了的蠢船员，在边缘星域某处翻出一件行星杀手，还以为把它卖给辛达强权能换来...\"他话没说完，摇了摇头。\"谁知道呢。"

他把目光移开，很久没有作声。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

title.zh: 任务开始：与 rao 交谈

options.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

texts.en:
"I don't have a reputation for being stickler for regulations, but I need you to hold a Hegemony commission before we have operational discussions concerning these matters."

He lets a hand drop on his desk.

"No exceptions."
texts.zh:
"我向来不以严守条令出名，但在我们就这些事展开作战层面的讨论之前，我需要你持有霸主委任状。"

他把一只手拍到桌上。

"没有例外。"

texts.en:
Orcus Rao sets down his datapad and puts his hands together.

"What about them?"
texts.zh:
Orcus Rao 放下数据平板，双手交叠。

"他们怎么了？"

texts.en:
Orcus Rao sets down his datapad and puts his hands together.

"What about them?"
texts.zh:
Orcus Rao 放下数据平板，双手交叠。

"他们怎么了？"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en: He consider for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

options.en: What should I do?
options.zh: 我该怎么做？

options.en: Isn't... Ragnar Station a bit of a backwater?
options.zh: Ragnar 空间站...不算是有点偏僻吗？

options.en: I found Hector. Irkalla was a trap. (explain)
options.zh: 我找到了 Hector。Irkalla 是个陷阱。 (解释)

options.en: Achilles could be a problem. He's smart; navy-trained. And he keeps a cool head.
options.zh: Achilles 可能会是个麻烦。他聪明，受过海军训练，而且沉得住气。

options.en: Achilles could be a reformer. He'd be better for the Sector than Philip ever was.
options.zh: Achilles 说不定是个改革者。对这个星域来说，他会比 Philip 强得多。

options.en: Jason Andrada was on Qaras. He was dead when I arrived.
options.zh: Jason Andrada 在 Qaras 上。我赶到的时候他已经死了。

options.en: I found Pericles. Someone shot him.
options.zh: 我找到了 Pericles。有人开枪打死了他。

options.en: Let's talk about something else. (back)
options.zh: 我们谈点别的吧。 (返回)

texts.en:
"Find them," he says. "Didn't I say that already?"

"I don't think this is a pack of lies from Dolos Macario, not this time. But confirmation doesn't hurt. And I'd prefer it if someone with a little more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."
texts.zh:
"找出他们，\"他说，\"我不是已经说过了？"

"我不觉得这是 Dolos Macario 编的一整套谎话，这次不像。不过确认一下也没有坏处。而且我更希望派个比霸主一贯的'精锐'稍微懂点分寸的人去查，\"他拿起数据板，嫌恶地看了一眼，\"去查这一串穷乡僻壤。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en:
"You've done good work for the Hegemony," he says, and taps at his datapad. "For your trouble."

"And you're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
texts.zh:
"你为霸主干得不错，\"他说着，在数据平板上敲了几下。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"而在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

texts.en:
"You've served the Hegemony," he says, and taps the datapad. "For your trouble."

"You're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
texts.zh:
"你为霸主效过力，\"他说着，敲了敲数据平板。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

texts.en:
"Ragnar Complex," he corrects you. "I'm not posted here to enjoy myself, captain."

"This place," he gestures toward his surroundings, "has certain advantages. Foremost being that none of my former contingent from the Eventide class are particularly interested in taking this dishonorable post, nor are they asking to be invited for an official inspection of a fleet of mildly radioactive hulks."

He stares off into what you assume is a bulkhead, for a moment. Considering his alternatives, perhaps.

"Enough about me," he says finally.
texts.zh:
"是 Ragnar 综合设施，\"他纠正你，\"我被派到这儿可不是来享乐的，舰长。"

"这地方，\"他朝四周示意，\"有它的好处。最主要的是，我原先带的、从 Eventide 那个阶层出身的那批人，没谁特别想接这个不光彩的差事，也没谁主动要求被请来对一支轻度放射性的废船舰队做正式视察。"

他朝某个方向望了一会儿 —— 你猜那是一道舱壁。也许是在掂量自己还有别的什么出路。

"不说我了，"他最后说。

texts.en:
You explain about the automated defenses and the personalized, pre-recorded messages. Your name could have been subbed into his speeches by an algorithm, but you suspect this was meant for you.

Rao nods, listening.

"Think he's Macario's pick?"
texts.zh:
你讲了那些自动防御系统，以及那些针对个人预先录好的讯息。你的名字也许只是被算法替换进了他的演讲，但你怀疑那本是说给你听的。

Rao 点着头，听你说完。

"你觉得他是 Macario 选中的人？"

options.en: Probably. Hector seems to believe everything Macario told him.
options.zh: 多半是。Macario 说的每一句，Hector 似乎都信。

options.en: I'm not sure. Hector talks like a true believer in Andradism.
options.zh: 我不确定。Hector 说话的样子，像是个真心信仰 Andrada 主义的信徒。

options.en: I don't think so. Hector seems sheltered. How could he lead an empire?
options.zh: 我不这么认为。Hector 像是被养在温室里的人。他怎么可能领导一个帝国？

texts.en: "Just imagine," he says, then shakes his head.
texts.zh: "想想那会成什么样。"他说着，摇了摇头。

texts.en:
"If Macario had direct control over every aspect of his upbringing, and ensured that everything he knows is what Macario wishes for him to know... and never more than Macario himself."

Rao returns his speculative look to meet yours.

"This is good. We'll work with it."
texts.zh:
"如果 Macario 直接控制了他成长的每一个方面，确保他所知的一切都是 Macario 希望他知道的...而且绝不超过 Macario 本人所知的范围。"

Rao 收回审视的目光，与你对上视线。

"这很好。我们就按这个来做。"

options.en: How is this good?
options.zh: 这好在哪儿？

texts.en:
"Put some kid raised in an asteroid eating nothing but Andradaism in charge of an empire?"

He smiles. Like someone who's seen their opponent's force disposition - and has a plan.

"Good work, $titleHeg."
texts.zh:
"让一个在小行星上长大、从小只吃 Andrada 主义那一套的孩子去掌管一个帝国？"

他笑了。像是已经看清了对手的兵力部署 —— 而且心里有了主意。

"干得好，$titleHeg。"

texts.en: "Would that not serve?" His tone is rhetorical.
texts.zh: "那样岂不更好？"他的语气是反问。

texts.en: "With the help of Dolos Macario, I expect," he says.
texts.zh: "我猜，是在 Dolos Macario 的扶助之下。"他说。

texts.en:
Rao grunts acknowledgement.

"From the sounds of it they've had that one in their pocket for a great many cycles. Fortuna Kato might have had Fleet Intel help at the start, might have not... It's not the worst case we anticipated, but it's close."

He idly squeezes one hand into a fist.

"Remember, $titleHeg, we don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
texts.zh:
Rao 哼了一声，表示知道了。

"听这情形，他们把那东西攥在手里已经很多个星历年了。Fortuna Kato 一开始也许得到过舰队情报部的协助，也许没有...这还不是我们预料中最糟的情况，但也差不远了。"

他随手攥紧一只拳头。

"记住，$titleHeg，我们不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

options.en: I understand and agree.
options.zh: 我明白，也同意。

options.en: I understand and agree. (lie)
options.zh: 我明白，也同意。 (说谎)

options.en: You may have to compromise at some point, admiral...
options.zh: 到某个时候，你也许不得不妥协，上将...

texts.en: He gives you a quick look, then nods, satisfied.
texts.zh: 他飞快地看了你一眼，然后点头，颇为满意。

texts.en: He gives you a long look, then nods, unsatisfied somehow.
texts.zh: 他久久地看着你，然后点头，却总像有些不满意。

texts.en:
"I'll leave this business of 'compromise' to the diplomats, $titleHeg." He says, emphasizing your presumed rank.

"This is not a matter open to discussion," he growls.
texts.zh:
"'妥协'这种事，我留给外交官去办，$titleHeg。"他说着，特意强调了你那个想当然的军衔。

"这件事没有商量的余地，"他低吼道。

texts.en:
Orcus gives you a baleful look. "I need not remind you of our position."

"We - the Hegemony - don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
texts.zh:
Orcus 阴冷地看了你一眼。"用不着我提醒你我们的处境。"

"我们 —— 霸主 —— 不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

options.en: I understand and agree.
options.zh: 我明白，也同意。

options.en: I understand and agree. (lie)
options.zh: 我明白，也同意。 (说谎)

options.en: You may have to compromise at some point, admiral.
options.zh: 到某个时候，你也许不得不妥协，上将。

texts.en: "Dead." Rao's expression doesn't change. "How?"
texts.zh: "死了。\"Rao 神色不变，\"怎么死的？"

options.en: Looks like an accidental shooting.
options.zh: 看起来像是走火。

texts.en: "Looks like?"
texts.zh: "看起来像？"

options.en: It does. But there were... others trying to track down Jason. (explain)
options.zh: 确实像。但还有...别的人也在追查 Jason。 (解释)

texts.en: You explain how someone paid to have you questioned, and perhaps killed, by a local goon. It did not go well for said goon.
texts.zh: 你说明有人出钱，让当地一个混混来审问你，或许还要你的命。那个混混的下场不太好。

texts.en: A Diktat agent, or what appears to be one, paid for the job. You found their apartment, and a comms log of them paying for documents that confirm Jason's death. The agent then fled the planet.
texts.zh: 一名辛达强权的特工 —— 至少看起来是 —— 付了这笔钱。你找到了他的住处，还有一份通讯记录，显示他出钱买了确认 Jason 死亡的文件。之后那名特工逃出了这颗行星。

texts.en: You managed to catch their shuttle, you explain. And you explain about the hidden poison capsule, and their Sindrian Diktat uniform.
texts.zh: 你说明自己截住了他们的穿梭机，又说到那枚暗藏的毒囊，还有他们身上辛达强权的制服。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "So who hired the hitman?"
texts.zh: "那杀手是谁雇的？"

texts.en:
"Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left is hiding."

Rao rubs his chin.

"At least he's off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."
texts.zh:
"也可能是右手不知道左手在瞒什么。"

Rao 摩挲着下巴。

"至少他出局了。他大概本来也不是当领袖的料。"

texts.en:
"An inside job, huh." Rao smirks, rubbing his chin. "Or maybe an attempt at one. Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left was hiding."

"At least he's off the board."
texts.zh:
"内部人干的，嗯。\"Rao 咧嘴一笑，摩挲着下巴，\"或者只是有人想这么干。也可能是右手不知道左手在瞒什么。"

"至少他出局了。"

options.en: I don't know.
options.zh: 我不知道。

texts.en:
He blinks, giving you a questioning look.

"I'd think you would want to know who was trying to kill you, $titleHeg." Rao shrugs. "And I'd be interested in why."

"At least the kid is off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，疑惑地看着你。

"我以为你会想知道是谁想杀你，$titleHeg。\"Rao 耸耸肩，\"而我也想知道为什么。"

"至少那小子出局了。他大概本来也不是当领袖的料。"

texts.en: "Someone," Rao says, not quite asking a question. "Did you find out who?"
texts.zh: "有人干的，\"Rao 说，语气不太像在提问，\"查出是谁了吗？"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "for some reason, you tried to shoot Maeus Moroz."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He is," his look shifts to you for a moment, "or was, useful."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"出于某种原因，你试图对 Maeus Moroz 开枪。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他是个，\"他的目光在你身上停了一瞬，\"或者说，曾是个有用的人。"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "you shot Maeus."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He was useful."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"你对 Maeus 开了枪。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他曾是个有用的人。"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "you destroyed the fleet of Maeus Moroz in space."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He was useful."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"你在太空里摧毁了 Maeus Moroz 的舰队。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他曾是个有用的人。"

options.en: No. His... adoptive father, Maeus Moroz, didn't either.
options.zh: 没有。他的...养父 Maeus Moroz 也没查出来。

texts.en: Rao nods, and glances at his datapad. Unconcerned.
texts.zh: Rao 点点头，瞥了一眼数据板。并不在意。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Did you have Pericles killed?
options.zh: Pericles 是你杀的吗？

texts.en:
His look hardens into a warning.

"You're asking a dangerous question, $titleHeg. In this business I should think you would know better than that."
texts.zh:
他的眼神沉下来，成了警告。

"你在问一个危险的问题，$titleHeg。干我们这行，我以为你该比这更懂分寸。"

options.en: I understand.
options.zh: 我明白。

options.en: I just need to know what you're doing so I can do my job.
options.zh: 我只是需要知道你在做什么，好让我能办我的事。

options.en: I'm not here to act as your assassin, Orcus.
options.zh: 我不是来给你当刺客的，Orcus。

texts.en: "Good. We'll speak no more of it."
texts.zh: "很好。这件事到此为止。"

texts.en:
"You 'need to know' enough to do your part, $titleHeg," he says. "And no more. This is the Hegemony and that is how this works here."

"Take a shift to cool off," he says, dismissing you as he reaches for the comms cut-off. "The discussion is over. We will not speak of it again."

The link snaps to a Hegemony crest.
texts.zh:
"你知道的'足够'让你做好你那份事就够了，$titleHeg，\"他说，\"不能更多。这里是霸主，这里的规矩就是这样。"

"去轮一班岗，冷静一下，\"他说着伸手去切通讯，把你打发了，\"谈话结束了。这件事我们不会再提。"

通讯一断，画面定格在霸主的徽记上。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
"Admiral Rao," he says, correcting you. "And no, I never asked that particular service of you."

"Take a shift to cool off," he says, dismissing you as he reaches for the comms cut-off. "The discussion is over. We will not speak of it again."

The link snaps to a Hegemony crest.
texts.zh:
"是 Rao 上将，\"他纠正你，\"另外，没有。我从来没让你干过那件事。"

"去轮一班岗，冷静一下，\"他说着伸手去切通讯，把你打发了，\"谈话结束了。这件事我们不会再提。"

通讯一断，画面定格在霸主的徽记上。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Yes," Rao says, unsurprised.

"Then you sat at the bar and had a drink with Maeus Moroz."

His eyes lock on to you. The question is all in his look.
texts.zh:
"是的，"Rao 说，并不意外。

"然后你坐在吧台边，跟 Maeus Moroz 喝了一杯。"

他盯住你。疑问全写在他的眼神里。

options.en: He blames Dolos Macario for the death of... his son.
options.zh: 他把...他儿子的死归咎于 Dolos Macario。

texts.en: "Good," says Rao.
texts.zh: "很好，"Rao 说。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Why is that good?
options.zh: 这有什么好的？

texts.en: "Because Dolos Macario is the enemy," he says. "And Maeus is not the forgiving type."

options.en: What should I do?

options.en: I've done some investigating. They're real.

texts.en:
"Find them," he says.

"I don't think this is the usual pack of lies from Dolos Macario. Not this time. But we need confirmation, and I'd prefer it be done with more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."

He looks you over with a lingering look of disapproval.

"We should make sure you're prepared."
texts.zh:
"找到他们。"他说。

"我不认为这又是 Dolos Macario 那套惯常的谎话。这次不像。但我们需要确证，而且我希望办得比霸主那些惯常的【精锐】更讲究些，\"他拿起数据平板，厌恶地看了一眼，\"别让他们在这串穷乡僻壤里到处乱戳。"

他上下打量你，目光里留着久久不散的不满。

"我们得确保你准备妥当。"

texts.en:
Rao glances at his datapad, taps out some commands.

"My quartermaster will provide you with fuel and supplies. They're in a bay on Ragnar Complex I've assigned to you."

He puts the datapad down. "That's it. Find all those clones, sons, whatever they are."
texts.zh:
Rao 瞥了一眼数据平板，敲下几条指令。

"我的军需官会给你补给燃料和物资。东西放在 Ragnar 综合设施的一个泊位里，我划给你了。"

他放下数据平板。"就这样。把那些克隆体、儿子，随他们是什么，全都找出来。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."

title.zh: 任务开始：与 siyavong 交谈

options.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

texts.en:
"I'm afraid I couldn't even begin to discuss matters of factional security with someone who is not a member of the Persean League, nor even bears a commission in its good name."

He gives you a meaningful look, then folds his hands together.
texts.zh:
"恕我直言，凡不属英仙座联盟成员、也未以联盟之名领受委任的人，我连谈一谈势力安全事务的门都无从谈起。"

他意味深长地看了你一眼，双手交叠。

texts.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

texts.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

texts.en: "Before we continue," he says, "there's a small matter..."
texts.zh: "在继续之前，\"他说，\"还有一件小事..."

options.en: Yes?
options.zh: 什么事？

texts.en:
"My organization... would like to ensure that you are able to investigate these files." He pauses, picking up a datapad. "As a free agent, naturally, under no particular orders from Fleet Intelligence."

"To those ends, I must inform you that we have discovered a storage bay - under your name - which contains supplies and fuel."

He sets the datapad down and puts his hands together, the very image of professionalism.
texts.zh:
"我所在的机构...希望确保你有条件去查清这些文件。\"他顿了顿，拿起一块数据板。\"当然是以自由行动者的身份，不受舰队情报部的任何具体指令。"

"为此，我必须告知你：我们发现了一个登记在你名下的储藏舱，里面备有补给与燃料。"

他放下数据板，双手交叠，一副十足的职业做派。

texts.en: "Before we continue," he says, "there's a small matter..."
texts.zh: "在继续之前，\"他说，\"还有一件小事..."

options.en: Yes?
options.zh: 什么事？

options.en: You say there'll be war? With who?
options.zh: 你说会有一场战争？和谁打？

options.en: You implied that you met with Horus Yaribay after you decrypted the files...
options.zh: 你暗示过，解密文件之后你见过 Horus Yaribay...

options.en: You implied that you met with Reynard Hannan after you decrypted the files...
options.zh: 你暗示过，解密文件之后你见过 Reynard Hannan...

options.en: I reviewed the files. What should I do?
options.zh: 我看过那些文件了。我该怎么做？

options.en: Achilles Andrada. Or 'Kalian'. It says he's a Persean League officer.
options.zh: Achilles Andrada。或者叫 'Kalian'。文件里说他是英仙座联盟的军官。

options.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
options.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: I wish to discuss the matter of Andrada clones being targeted.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 Andrada 克隆体遭人追杀这件事。

options.en: We need to talk about Achilles and Gens Kato.
options.zh: 我们得谈谈 Achilles 和 Kato 氏族。

options.en: I found Hector. He seems to be under Macario's influence. (explain)
options.zh: 我找到 Hector 了。他好像正受 Macario 摆布。 (解释)

options.en: I found Hercules Andrada at the Galatia Academy.
options.zh: 我在 Galatia 学院找到了 Hercules Andrada。

options.en: Let's talk about something else.
options.zh: 咱们换个话题吧。

texts.en:
"Hector and..." He pauses, and makes a small gesture with one hand.

"And whoever will stand against him. Askonia will suffer, again. One hopes it will not spread."
texts.zh:
"Hector 还有..."他顿了顿，一只手做了个不大的手势。

"还有所有会站出来对抗他的人。Askonia 又要遭难了。但愿这场祸事不会蔓延。"

options.en: Are you doing something to stop it?
options.zh: 你们在做些什么来阻止它吗？

options.en: Can it be stopped?
options.zh: 这能阻止得了吗？

options.en: If there's a war, I intend to win it.
options.zh: 若真有战争，我要赢下它。

texts.en:
His half-smile dims.

"At this point I believe that stopping it is beyond the range of scenarios we shall see play out. But trust that all my efforts shall be to the security and safety of the Persean League - and, indeed, the entire Sector."

"Whether you believe that," his expression is ironic, "depends on many things, of course. But I must content myself with saying so."
texts.zh:
他的半笑淡了下去。

"到了这一步，我认为阻止它已不在我们所能看到的那些可能之内。但请相信，我所做的一切都是为了英仙座联盟的安全 —— 也是为了整个星域。"

"你信不信这话，\"他神情带着讥诮，\"自然取决于许多东西。但我只能把话说到这里。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow, his amused half-smile firmly in place.

"A spirited assertion, but that may not be up to you. War is a sort of negotiation, $titlePL, and direct force is but one aspect."

He gives you an indulgent look. "But you don't need me to tell you that. You are successful and... potent."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉，那副带着玩味的半笑稳稳挂着。

"说得有气势，可这恐怕不由你说了算。战争是一种谈判，$titlePL，直接动武只是其中一个方面。"

他宽容地看了你一眼。"不过这话不必我来告诉你。你的事业有成，而且...手段了得。"

texts.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力。"

options.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
options.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

texts.en: He raises an eyebrow fractionally.
texts.zh: 他微微挑起一侧眉毛。

texts.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League - and the Prime Demarchon is the foremost executive servant of the League, and it is to him I report concerning certain... critical matters."

"It is my duty," he concludes, somewhat crisply.
texts.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力 —— 而大统领是联盟最高层的行政长官，某些...关键事务，我正是向他汇报。"

"这是我的职责，"他收尾时语气颇为干脆。

options.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
options.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

texts.en:
"Officially," he says, "I shall make no recommendation regarding your involvement into the alleged contents of these files in accordance with present Persean League policy of non-intervention in matters regarding... certain trade partners, as guided by our executive leadership."

He puts his hands together, clearing his throat, and pauses for a moment. Then looks up at you.
texts.zh:
"就官方而言，\"他说，\"对你是否介入这些文件所称的内容，我不作任何建议。按英仙座联盟现行政策，凡涉及...某些贸易伙伴之事，一律不予干预 —— 此为我们的行政领导层所定。"

他双手交叠，清了清嗓子，停了一停，然后抬眼看你。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You have made a career of taking independent initiative. With provocative results. I will follow your actions with great interest and assist in defending the stability and security of the Persean League now and in the future."

The holo flickers for a moment, but you'd swear he winked.
texts.zh:
"你这一路走来，靠的就是自行其是。结果也足够惹眼。我会密切关注你的行动，并为捍卫英仙座联盟眼下与将来的稳定和安全提供协助。"

全息影像闪了一下，但你敢发誓，他眨了下眼。

options.en: I think I understand.
options.zh: 我想我明白了。

texts.en:
"That is alleged."

Siyavong's expression tightens.
texts.zh:
"那只是指控。"

Siyavong 的神情绷紧了。

options.en: It says you - your organization - knows about him. And intervened.
options.zh: 文件里说，你 —— 你的机构 —— 知道他的事，而且插了手。

texts.en:
"How interesting," he says as if he isn't interested at all.

"I will only comment that, in general terms, it is my duty to protect citizens of the Persean League." A pause. "Whatever their alleged genetic source."
texts.zh:
"有意思，"他说这话时仿佛一点也不觉得有意思。

"我只说一点，泛泛而论：保护英仙座联盟的公民是我的职责。\"一顿。\"无论他们所称的基因来源是什么。"

options.en: I'm going to find him and speak with him.
options.zh: 我会找到他，和他谈谈。

options.en: So he's safe?
options.zh: 那他是安全的？

options.en: I'll ask no more about him. For now.
options.zh: 关于他的事我不再多问。至少现在不问。

texts.en: "I will not stand in the way of the free association of citizens of the Persean League," he says.
texts.zh: "我不会妨碍英仙座联盟公民之间的自由交往，"他说。

texts.en: Saying nothing, he nods very slowly.
texts.zh: 他什么也没说，只是极缓地点了点头。

texts.en: "Good."
texts.zh: "很好。"

texts.en:
"I suspect you are correct, captain," Siyavong says. He is not overtly worried about the notion, by all appearances.

"And even if we did not see evidence, it is the first reaction I would anticipate from... many interested parties."
texts.zh:
"我猜你说得对，舰长，"Siyavong 说。从表面上看，他并不为这个念头担忧。

"就算我们看不到证据，这也是我能想到的...许多有关各方的第一反应。"

texts.en: "If that satisfaction might quell your insistence, then I suppose we must," he says, looking unimpressed.
texts.zh: "如果这点满足能让你不再坚持，那我想我们也只能如此，"他说，看起来并不买账。

texts.en:
He coughs, falsely. "Now this was an illuminating aside," Siyavong says with a distinct undercurrent of annoyance.

"Let's move toward a less gruesome topic, shall we?"
texts.zh:
他假咳了一声。"这一岔话倒真是让人长了见识，"Siyavong 说，底下明显压着一层恼意。

"我们换个不那么血腥的话题，好吗？"

options.en: Do you know who is doing it?
options.zh: 你知道是谁干的吗？

options.en: Do you want me to confront Admiral Rao?
options.zh: 你要我去当面质问 Rao 上将？

options.en: Is League Fleet Intelligence targeting Andradas?
options.zh: 是联盟舰队情报部在针对 Andrada 家的人？

options.en: Would you like me to take out the Andradas?
options.zh: 要不要我把 Andrada 家的人一个个除掉？

options.en: Let's talk about something else.
options.zh: 咱们换个话题吧。

texts.en:
"Specifically? In some cases. There are many assassins and mere murderers-for-hire in the Persean Sector."

"Who sees that they are paid, and by whom, and who allows it? Those are more difficult questions with more complex answers."

He raises a palm at you.

"Allow me to draw a hypothetical."
texts.zh:
"具体而言？有些是。英仙座星域里从来不缺刺客，也不缺只图钱的杀手。"

"谁负责付钱、付给谁、谁又默许这一切？这些问题更难，答案也更复杂。"

他朝你抬起一只手。

"让我假设一种情形。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"The Hegemony considers the Sindrian Diktat as fundamentally criminal in the highest degree - Philip Andrada is mutiny embodied. Agents of the Hegemony - and those who gives orders to said agents, say one Orcus Rao who is busier by far than an admiral assigned to a holding-before-retirement posting ought to be - will seek to undermine Andradism by any means available."

"Ideally they'd put Andrada on trial, have a full show of 'legitimacy' of the laws of the Human Domain and so forth."

"Not so easily arranged, as you may imagine. And now Andrada has produced clones to inherit his mutinous polity?" Siyavong shakes his head in mock-sympathy. "A clone is not guilty of the father's crimes. And yet..."
texts.zh:
"在霸主看来，辛达强权从根子上就是最高等级的犯罪 —— Philip Andrada 本身就是叛乱的化身。霸主的特工，以及给这些特工下命令的人 —— 比如那位 Orcus Rao，他忙得远超过一个被安排到退休前闲置职位上的上将该有的程度 —— 会想尽一切手段挖空 Andrada 主义。"

"最理想的做法是把 Andrada 送上法庭，把人之领律法的【合法性】好好演上一场，诸如此类。"

"当然，这事没那么容易办成，你大概也想得到。况且如今 Andrada 还造出了克隆体，要继承他那个叛逆的政体？\"Siyavong 装出一副同情的样子摇了摇头。\"克隆体并没有犯下父亲的罪。可话又说回来..."

options.en: You're suggesting that Orcus Rao has ordered illegal assassinations?
options.zh: 你是在说 Orcus Rao 下令进行非法暗杀？

texts.en:
"Clearly he has," Siyavong says, matter-of-fact, "ever."

"Of our Andrada clones, however? I could not provide you with hard evidence of it."

"Could he? Would he? Yes and yes. Did he?"

His knowing smile reforms.
texts.zh:
"显然有，\"Siyavong 说，语气平淡，\"从来都有。"

"不过说到我们这些 Andrada 克隆体？我拿不出确凿的证据。"

"他做得到吗？他会做吗？两个问题的答案都是肯定的。那他做了吗？"

他那副心知肚明的笑容又挂了起来。

texts.en:
His brow furrows.

"Would you not, please? It is... unnecessary."
texts.zh:
他皱起眉头。

"能不能请你别去？这...没有必要。"

options.en: I understand.
options.zh: 我明白。

options.en: If you insist, then I won't confront Orcus Rao. (lie)
options.zh: 既然你坚持，那我就不去质问 Orcus Rao 了。 (说谎)

texts.en: He gives you a look meant to hide a vast skepticism.
texts.zh: 他看了你一眼，那眼神是要掩住满腹的怀疑。

texts.en: He gives you a concerned look.
texts.zh: 他有些担忧地看了你一眼。

texts.en:
"Fleet Intelligence? No."

He gives you a warning look.

"And it would be impolitic for me to participate in speculation about certain other parties within the Persean League. Whatever you may choose to believe, I am bound by certain legal strictures as concerns citizens of the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"舰队情报部？不是。"

他给了你一个警告的眼神。

"再者，参与对英仙座联盟内某些其他势力的揣测，对我而言并不明智。不管你愿意相信什么，凡涉及英仙座联盟公民，我都要受某些法律条文的约束。"

options.en: But the Gens are not?
options.zh: 可各氏族就不受约束？

texts.en:
He drops his hint of a smile.

"I said no such thing and I would thank you not to share irresponsible 'deductions' of this sort."

"Perhaps another topic interests you, captain?"
texts.zh:
他连那点笑意也收了起来。

"我没说过这种话。这类不负责任的【推断】，还请你别到处去讲。"

"也许你更想聊点别的，舰长？"

texts.en:
"No, thank you," he says, uncomfortably. "I don't believe that would be helpful at this juncture."

He produces a strained smile.

"It was thoughtful of you to ask before... anything."
texts.zh:
"不了，谢谢，\"他说，有些不自在。\"我不认为在目前这个节骨眼上，那样做会有什么好处。"

他挤出一个勉强的笑。

"你能在做任何事之前先来问一声... 想得很周到。"

texts.en: "Please," he says.
texts.zh: "拜托了，"他说。

texts.en:
"We don't," Siyavong says. "The word you'll find for the situation is 'fraught' due, as per our previous conversation, various factors."

He gives you a cool look.

"Have patience."
texts.zh:
"我们不知道，\"Siyavong 说。\"你会用来形容这局面的词是【棘手】—— 原因嘛，如我们上次所谈，种种因素叠加。"

他冷冷地看了你一眼。

"耐心些。"

options.en: Patience for what?
options.zh: 耐心等什么？

options.en: For Achilles to make his move?
options.zh: 等 Achilles 出手？

texts.en:
"You'll know."

He re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
texts.zh:
"到时候你就知道。"

他重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

Then re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
texts.zh:
他什么也没说。

然后重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

texts.en:
You elaborate about the palatial asteroid, Hector's words, and the trap he left for you.

"So Hector is his pick." He nods to himself. "And how long has it been so, I wonder, with all the recent... stirrings."

He puts his hands together, polite and collected. "I do not imagine Macario's influence has improved Hector's character. There'll be a war before this is over, that much is clear."
texts.zh:
你把那座宫殿般的岩质小行星、Hector 的话，还有他给你设下的那个圈套，都讲了一遍。

"所以 Hector 才是他的选择。\"他自顾自地点了点头。\"我倒想知道，最近这些...骚动之下，这种局面已经持续多久了。"

他把双手叠在一起，礼貌而镇定。"我不觉得 Macario 的插手会让 Hector 的品性变好。这事了结之前必有一战，这一点很清楚。"

texts.en:
"We know about this," he says. "Perhaps more than you."

"You understand there was an attack? Several assassins. Armed."
texts.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，\"他说。\"也许比你知道得还多。"

"你该明白，那是一次袭击。好几名刺客，全副武装。"

texts.en:
"We know about this," he says.

"It could have gone rather worse, don't you think? Poor timing, nonetheless."
texts.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，"他说。

"本来可能会糟得多，你不觉得吗？话虽如此，这时机实在不巧。"

texts.en:
"We know," he says. "It could not have gone much worse, I would say. Very poor timing on your part."

Siyavong watches you.

"At least you survived the attack."
texts.zh:
"我们知道，\"他说。\"依我看，事情糟得不能再糟了。你挑的时机实在不巧。"

Siyavong 看着你。

"至少你在那场袭击里活了下来。"

options.en: Um. Is he alright?
options.zh: 他...他还好吗？

options.en: At least that.
options.zh: 至少还有这一点。

options.en: Are you implying I was involved?
options.zh: 你是在暗示这事跟我有关？

options.en: That's one less Andrada clone to menace the Sector.
options.zh: 星域里少了一个祸害人的 Andrada 克隆体。

texts.en:
He says nothing for a couple seconds. Then looks away.

"No. He is not." His eyes meet yours. "The details are considered classified. But you may assume that he is not relevant to the crisis growing in Askonia."
texts.zh:
他沉默了几秒，然后把目光移开。

"不。他不好。\"他直视你的眼睛。\"细节属于机密。不过你可以认为，他已与 Askonia 日益扩大的危机无关了。"

texts.en:
"Indeed. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
texts.zh:
"的确。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"More than that, $playerSirOrMadam. Because of course you were involved - you were right beside Hercules as he was killed."

Then he lets it go.

"But no, we understand the situation. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
texts.zh:
"不止如此，$playerSirOrMadam。因为你当然牵涉其中 —— Hercules 被杀的时候，你就在他旁边。"

然后他松了口。

"不过算了，我们了解情况。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"That is one way of looking at it," he says with frictionless self-control. "I was relieved, of course, to hear you were entirely unharmed."

"I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming about the details of the situation, particularly given the Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy..."

He puts his hands together neatly. "In any case, Provost Baird appreciates that interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."
texts.zh:
"也可以这么说，\"他说，克制得滴水不漏。\"听说你毫发无伤，我当然松了口气。"

"我不能说安全主管把事情的细节讲得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的人在场..."

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。"无论如何，Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

options.en: I told him to trust Provost Baird.
options.zh: 我让他去信 Baird 院长。

options.en: I let Provost Baird take care of him.
options.zh: 我把他交给 Baird 院长照看。

options.en: I told Hercules the Persean League would protect him. Did he contact you?
options.zh: 我告诉 Hercules，英仙座联盟会保护他。他联系过你们吗？

options.en: I told him to talk to the hacker, Gargoyle, to help him escape.
options.zh: 我让他去找那个黑客 Gargoyle，想办法脱身。

options.en: I offered him asylum on my own colony.
options.zh: 我提出可以让他在我自己的殖民地上避难。

options.en: I gave him credits to help him escape.
options.zh: 我给了他一笔星币，帮他逃走。

options.en: Well. Hope he's doing okay...
options.zh: 好吧。希望他一切还好...

texts.en:
Siyavong does something halfway between taking a deep breath and a sigh.

"Interesting," he says after a moment.
texts.zh:
Siyavong 做了个介于深吸气与叹气之间的动作。

"有意思，"他过了一会才说。

options.en: Why is that interesting?
options.zh: 这有什么值得在意的？

texts.en: "I don't know, captain," he says with exacting neutrality. "I'm sure we'll find out before long. Perhaps."
texts.zh: "我不知道，舰长，\"他说，语气中立得一丝不苟。\"我想不用多久就会知道了。也许吧。"

texts.en:
Siyavong's half-smile fades somewhat.

"No. He's disappeared."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 脸上那点半笑淡了下去。

"不。他不见了。"

options.en: Disappeared as in dead, or...
options.zh: 不见了是指死了，还是...

texts.en: He looks at you for a long moment. You can see the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes.
texts.zh: 他久久地看着你。你能看见他眼角的皱纹。

texts.en: "I couldn't say."
texts.zh: "我说不好。"

texts.en:
Something small breaks. Finlay's smile drops.

"Hercules is dead, captain. Targeted killing. He made it as far as Ancyra. Same organization as the first attempt - behind the proverbial trigger, that is. The identity of the client is less certain."
texts.zh:
某样很小的东西碎了。Finlay 的笑容落了下去。

"Hercules 死了，舰长。是定点清除。他一路逃到了 Ancyra。还是同一个组织，和第一次动手的那批人一样 —— 扣下扳机的那些。至于委托人是谁，就不那么确定了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He rubs one of his eyes.

"I liked him. Hercules. He seemed like a thoughtful young man."
texts.zh:
他揉了揉一只眼睛。

"我挺喜欢他。Hercules。看着像个有想法的年轻人。"

options.en: Why are you telling me this?
options.zh: 你为什么告诉我这些？

options.en: He was an Andrada.
options.zh: 他是 Andrada 家的人。

options.en: I liked him too.
options.zh: 我也喜欢他。

texts.en:
Siyavong taps something on his console, then adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"I don't believe I said anything. Now, where we were?"
texts.zh:
Siyavong 在控制台上点了点什么，然后调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我想我什么也没说过。那么，我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

texts.en:
"Indeed."

Siyavong adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"Where were we?"
texts.zh:
"的确。"

Siyavong 调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

texts.en:
He nods, looking down.

"So. Where were we."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，垂着眼。

"那么。我们刚才说到哪儿了。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

options.en: Interesting? Why?
options.zh: 有意思？为什么？

texts.en:
"It explains why we can't find Hercules."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
texts.zh:
"这解释了为什么我们找不到 Hercules。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

options.en: Interesting why?
options.zh: 为什么有意思？

texts.en:
"It explains why he booked transport to where he did."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
texts.zh:
"这解释了为什么他订了去那个地方的船票。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

texts.en: "Ah." Siyavong's eyes light up. "That explains it."
texts.zh: "啊。\"Siyavong 的眼睛亮了起来。\"这就说得通了。"

options.en: That explains what?
options.zh: 说得通什么？

texts.en:
"Yes," Siyavong says with no particular emphasis.

He watches you closely.
texts.zh:
"是，"Siyavong 说，语气听不出任何强调。

他紧紧地看着你。

texts.en:
"With respect for my position and duty, $titlePL, I would prefer not to discuss the situation from a perspective which could be misconstrued as favoring one or another of the Gens."

Siyavong doesn't change his expression.

"Perhaps we might speak again when the situation becomes... more clearly applicable to the security of the Persean League." He pauses. "And, perhaps, to one of its citizens, commission-bearers, or even a demarchon."
texts.zh:
"出于对我职位与职责的尊重，$titlePL，我不愿从某个可能被误解为偏袒某一氏族的立场来谈这件事。"

Siyavong 面色不改。

"也许等局势...更明确地涉及英仙座联盟的安全时，我们可以再谈。\"他顿了顿。\"或者，涉及它的某位公民、某位持委任状者，甚至某位统领时。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I can only assume you've coordinated some response with Fortuna Kato."

"I shan't trouble you for details," he finishes coolly. "I can contact Gens Kato myself."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我只能猜想，你已经和 Fortuna Kato 协调过某种应对了。"

"细节我就不烦你说了。\"他冷冷地收尾，\"我自己可以联系 Kato 氏族。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."

"We must," he gives you a look of emphasis, "speak again when it is clear that events are beginning to culminate. Contact me then."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

"我们得——\"他意味深长地看了你一眼，\"等事态明显开始走向高潮时再谈一次。到时候联系我。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."

"We must," he gives you a look of emphasis, "speak again when it is clear that events are beginning to culminate. Contact me then."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

"我们得——\"他意味深长地看了你一眼，\"等事态明显开始走向高潮时再谈一次。到时候联系我。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I can only assume you've coordinated some response with the Prime Demarchon."

"I shan't trouble you for details," he finishes coolly. "I can contact the office of the Reynard Hannan myself."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我只能猜想，你已经和大统领协调过某种应对了。"

"细节我就不烦你说了。\"他冷冷地收尾，\"我自己可以联系 Reynard Hannan 的办公室。"

texts.en: "They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I shan't act prematurely. It is, you understand, a delicate situation and it would be a mistake to expose my Gens to some scandal or crisis."
texts.zh: "它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我不会过早行动。你要明白，这是个微妙的局面，把我的氏族卷进什么丑闻或危机里，是犯不上的错。"

texts.en:
The comms connect.

"You." Arroyo doesn't look happy.

"Your first impulse after that disastrous propaganda cast - yes, I saw it - was to come here?"

He makes an exasperated sound. "Unbelievable."
texts.zh:
通讯接通了。

"你。" Arroyo 脸色不好看。

"那场灾难性的宣传直播之后——对，我看了——你的第一反应是跑到这儿来？"

他恼火地出了口气。"真是难以置信。"

options.en: Help me Arroyo. You're my only hope.
options.zh: 帮帮我，Arroyo。你是我唯一的希望了。

options.en: I need your help. You could profit from this.
options.zh: 我需要你的帮助。这事你能赚一笔。

options.en: I suppose I can just figure this out on my own.
options.zh: 那我还是自己想办法吧。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Unbelievable," he says again, disgusted.

He sighs, deeply, then puts his elbows on his desk and his head in his hands.

"But fine. Fine. Tell me why you think I should have anything to do with... you."
texts.zh:
"真是难以置信，"他又说了一遍，一脸嫌恶。

他长叹一声，然后把双肘撑在桌上，两手抱住了头。

"不过算了。算了。你倒是说说，我凭什么要跟...你——扯上关系。"

options.en: I must destroy Macario so Hector Andrada can reign as Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 我必须除掉 Macario，好让 Hector Andrada 以最高元首的身份执政。

options.en: I want to take down Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 我要扳倒 Dolos Macario。

options.en: I want to take down Dolos Macario - and the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我要扳倒 Dolos Macario——还有辛达强权。

options.en: I just want to make this whole situation go away.
options.zh: 我只想让这一团乱麻赶紧过去。

options.en: I need to prove myself to Dolos Macario. Show that he made a mistake.
options.zh: 我得向 Dolos Macario 证明我自己。让他知道他错了。

texts.en:
Arroyo sighs. Then, slowly, he raises his head.

He adjusts his suit, though it is tailored to effortless perfection, then looks at you directly, expression well past skeptical and nearly within the realm of dismissive.

"Is that what will make you happy? Fine. Hypothetically, then, let's talk about how you - yourself - get out of this."

"First, forget about 'destroying' Macario."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 叹了口气。然后缓缓抬起头。

他理了理西装——那身衣服本就剪裁得无可挑剔——然后直视着你，神情早已越过怀疑，几乎到了不屑一顾的地步。

"那样你就满意了？行。那我们就假设一下，谈谈你——你自己——怎么从这局里脱身。"

"第一，别想什么'除掉'Macario。"

texts.en: "What you have, captain," he slaps one hand in the other. "Is a PR problem. A big one. But we've got tools for that. Does anyone still talk about Daedaleon? Nope!"
texts.zh: "你现在的处境，舰长，\"他一掌拍在另一只手上，\"是个公关问题。而且是个大问题。不过我们有工具对付这个。现在还有谁提 Daedaleon 吗？没有！"

options.en: I fail to see what this has to do with Transcendent Andradan Ideology.
options.zh: 我看不出这跟 Andrada 超凡意识形态有什么关系。

options.en: Daedaleon?
options.zh: Daedaleon 是什么？

options.en: What does this have to do with showing Macario his error?
options.zh: 这跟让 Macario 认清自己的错误有什么关系？

options.en: You mean that moon Tri-Tachyon turned into an exotic radiation-spewing death-trap?
options.zh: 你是说那颗卫星——速子科技把它改造成了一座喷射奇异辐射的死亡陷阱？

texts.en:
Arroyo gapes for a moment, then says - perhaps not quite shouts - "No! Stop that, stop trying to tell me - anyone - about his transparent ideology!"

"Stars above," he says, palm to his face. "You sound like a malfunctioning sub-gamma assistant."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 张着嘴愣了片刻，然后说——也许算不上吼——"不！住口，别再跟我——跟任何人——讲他那套一眼就能看穿的意识形态了！"

"群星在上，\"他一手捂住脸。\"你听起来像台出了故障的次伽马级辅助程序。"

options.en: If you can't respect the transcendent ideology of Philip Andrada, then we have nothing to talk about.
options.zh: 如果你不尊重 Philip Andrada 那套超凡的意识形态，那我们就没什么好谈的。

options.en: I apologize. You were saying?
options.zh: 我道歉。你刚才说到哪了？

texts.en:
"I guess not," he says. "You're unbelievable."

He turns away, one hand reaching for what you assume is the comms cut-off.

"By the way, a 'fellow' Company executive got it in their head that you were interfering with their profits. Watch your back, because I'm not going to do it anymore."

He turns to look over his shoulder. "This? It's over. Have a nice life."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"看来不会，\"他说。\"你真是不可理喻。"

他转过身去，一只手伸向你猜是通讯切断键的地方。

"顺便说一句，公司里有位'同事'认定你在妨碍他们的利润。自己盯着背后吧，这事我不会再替你看着了。"

他回头看了一眼。"这事？到此为止。祝你过得愉快。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
Arroyo has made his position clear.

You'll just have to watch your back and react as other parties make their moves - or contact stronger, more willing allies.

Whether by some murderous Tri-Tachyon executive or some pretender Supreme Executor, you will be stopped by no one.
texts.zh:
Arroyo 已经把立场说得很清楚了。

你只能自己盯着背后，等别人先出手再作应对——或者去联系更强、更愿意出手的盟友。

不管是某个杀心已起的速子科技高管，还是某个僭称最高元首的人，谁都拦不住你。

texts.en:
"Let's keep focused on the problem we're trying to solve here, captain." He points, "Your reputation."

He's starting to look a bit more cheerful.
texts.zh:
"我们还是集中在这个要解决的问题上，舰长。\"他指了指。\"你的名声。"

他的脸色开始好看起来。

options.en: I can handle my own reputation, thanks.
options.zh: 我自己的名声我自己能处理，多谢。

options.en: Is this going to be expensive?
options.zh: 这得花不少钱吧？

options.en: What do you propose?
options.zh: 你有什么提议？

options.en: I can handle my own reputation, thanks.
options.zh: 我自己的名声我自己能处理，多谢。

options.en: Is this going to be expensive?
options.zh: 这得花不少钱吧？

options.en: What do you propose?
options.zh: 你有什么提议？

options.en: I don't care about that. I want to take down Macario.
options.zh: 我不在乎那些。我要扳倒 Macario。

options.en: I don't care about that. I want to destroy the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我不在乎那些。我要摧毁辛达强权。

texts.en: "No, you can't," he says. "That's why you're here."
texts.zh: "不，你处理不了，\"他说。\"这正是你来找我的原因。"

texts.en:
"With half the Sector's meat-head bounty hunters trying to kill the number one terrorist on Macario's list and the other half merely suspecting you're a baby-killer?"

"You need to get your act together. Fix your reputation, gather allies, then you can even begin to consider hitting back. I've got a contact in a PR firm that can clean things up for 50,000 credits."
texts.zh:
"半个星域的莽夫赏金猎人都在追杀 Macario 名单上的头号恐怖分子，另一半不过是在怀疑你是个杀婴犯？"

"你得先把自己收拾整齐。修好名声，拉拢盟友，然后才谈得上考虑反击。我认识一家公关公司，花 50,000 星币就能把事摆平。"

options.en: Accept
options.zh: 接受

options.en: No, I can handle it.
options.zh: 不用，我自己能处理。

options.en: I'd like to, but I can't afford it.
options.zh: 我想这么做，但付不起。

texts.en:
"Good," he says, though clearly isn't allowing himself to sound pleased. "The first rational decision you've made since..."

He considers.

Then waves a hand. "Whenever. Anyway, they'll get it done. You'll see."
texts.zh:
"很好，\"他说，语气却明显不肯露出半分满意。\"这是你自...以来做出的第一个理性决定。"

他想了想。

然后摆了摆手。"随便什么时候吧。总之他们会办妥的。你等着看就是。"

texts.en: "Now all you need to do," he leans back, hands behind his head. "Is lay low. Stay out of trouble. Let things calm down, let your investments mature. Collect the interest, re-invest."
texts.zh: "现在你只需要做一件事，\"他往后一靠，双手枕在脑后。\"低调。别惹麻烦。让事情冷下来，等你的投资慢慢成熟。收利息，再投出去。"

options.en: The situation in the Sindrian Diktat must be addressed.
options.zh: 辛达强权的局面必须处理。

options.en: I'm not sure that's a realistic outcome, Rayan.
options.zh: 我不认为那能成为现实，Rayan。

options.en: Sit it out? Not my style, Rayan.
options.zh: 袖手旁观？那不是我的作风，Rayan。

options.en: Good plan. I'll do it.
options.zh: 好计划。我照办。

texts.en: Arroyo sighs, and closes his eyes. "Somehow I thought you'd say that."
texts.zh: Arroyo 叹了口气，闭上眼睛。"不知怎么，我就猜到你会这么说。"

texts.en:
His expression makes it clear he does not welcome the topic.

"Help? I told you to lay low and you agreed."
texts.zh:
他的神情明摆着不欢迎这个话题。

"帮忙？我跟你说过要低调蛰伏，你也答应了。"

texts.en:
"Well, I already agreed to help." Arroyo looks you over. "Just don't push your luck."

"What's the plan?"
texts.zh:
"行吧，我已经答应帮忙了。\"Arroyo 把你上下打量一遍，\"只是别得寸进尺。"

"计划是什么？"

texts.en:
His look is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Back on this, huh," he says.

But he does appear to be listening.
texts.zh:
他的目光带着怀疑，几乎算得上不屑。

"又绕回这事了，"他说。

不过他看起来确实在听。

texts.en:
"I told you I didn't want to get involved," he says. "Remember when you came to me waving around some top-level secret files you stole from the... who was it - oh, right, the leader of the Sindrian Diktat's secret police with a reputation for torture and assassination? Remember that?"

He looks away, shaking his head. "I make it a policy never to get involved with someone named after an animal. Never ends well."
texts.zh:
"我跟你说过，我不想掺和。\"他说，\"还记得你跑来找我，手里挥着几份顶级机密文件，从那个...谁来着的——哦对，辛达强权秘密警察的头子，一个以酷刑和暗杀出名的家伙——从他那儿偷来的？还记得吗？"

他别过脸去，摇了摇头。"我有个原则：绝不跟名字是动物的人打交道。从来没好下场。"

texts.en:
His expression makes it clear he does not welcome the topic.

"Now why exactly would I want to get involved in that 'situation'?"
texts.zh:
他的神情明摆着不欢迎这个话题。

"那么，我到底为什么会想掺进那个'局面'里去？"

texts.en: His expression makes it clear he does not welcome the topic.
texts.zh: 他的神情明摆着不欢迎这个话题。

options.en: I want you to back Achilles' faction. He's a reformer.
options.zh: 我要你支持 Achilles 那一派。他是个改革者。

options.en: I want you to assist Hector, the true heir to Andrada.
options.zh: 我要你协助 Hector——Andrada 真正的继承人。

options.en: I want you to help supply the uprisings against the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我要你帮那些反抗辛达强权的起义者供应物资。

options.en: Uh, no plan just yet. I'll get back to you.
options.zh: 呃，暂时还没计划。我回头再来找你。

texts.en:
"The clone who looks like he didn't finish thawing out from the cryo-pod they keep self-important little officers in? The uniformed puppet dancing for Fortuna Kato?"

Arroyo holds his look for just a moment.
texts.zh:
"就是那个看着像没从冷冻舱里化透的克隆人？那种舱专用来装自命不凡的小军官。还有那个穿着制服、围着 Fortuna Kato 打转的傀儡？"

Arroyo 迎着你的目光，停了片刻。

texts.en:
"Sure," he says agreeably, tapping at a TriPad. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies. I wager we'll be moving cargo within two or three shifts."

It sounds almost as if Arroyo may enjoy running a smuggling operation into a star system burning in civil war.
texts.zh:
"行啊，\" 他爽快地应道，一边戳着 TriPad，\"我让我的人去把空壳公司搭起来。我打赌，两三个班次之内咱们就能开始运货了。"

听着倒像是 Arroyo 挺享受这桩买卖：往一个正烧着内战的星系里走私。

texts.en:
"Sure," he says agreeably, tapping at a TriPad. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies. I wager we'll be moving cargo within two or three shifts."

"Meeting concluded. And I'm busy, so." He waves you off, looking back to his TriPad.
texts.zh:
"行啊，\" 他爽快地应道，一边戳着 TriPad，\"我让我的人去把空壳公司搭起来。我打赌，两三个班次之内咱们就能开始运货了。"

"会开完了。我这儿还忙着呢，就这样。" 他摆了摆手把你打发走，目光又落回 TriPad 上。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
You cut the comms, leaving him to his business.

It sounds almost as if Arroyo may enjoy running a smuggling operation into a star system burning in civil war.
texts.zh:
你切断了通讯，留他忙自己的事去。

听着倒像是 Arroyo 挺享受这桩买卖：往一个正烧着内战的星系里走私。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: The next step: go to Yesod to tell Achilles about the logistics operation you've arranged via Arroyo.
texts.zh: 下一步：前往 Yesod，把你在 Arroyo 那里安排好的后勤行动告知 Achilles。

texts.en:
Now you need to get yourself to Yesod and inform Achilles about Arroyo's supply operation.

This should help him secure an independent power base from Gens Kato. Perhaps it is not sufficient alone, but every little bit helps.
texts.zh:
现在你得亲自去一趟 Yesod，把 Arroyo 的补给行动告知 Achilles。

这应当能帮他从 Kato 氏族手里挣出一块独立的权力根基。也许单凭这一点还不够，但积少成多。

texts.en:
Now you need to get word to Hector that you've secured an additional line of support to tip the scales in his favor.

Surely he'll recognize that you've proven your loyalty in spite of Macario's lies.
texts.zh:
现在你得把消息送到 Hector 那里：你又为他拉到了一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。

他总该认账：哪怕 Macario 满口谎话，你的忠诚已经得到了证明。

texts.en:
Now you need to get word to the Sindrian Diktat that you've secured an additional line of support for the rightful heir, Hector Andrada, which should help tip the scales in his favor. Every little bit helps, after all.

Surely they'll recognize that you've proven your loyalty in spite of Macario's gross misstep.
texts.zh:
现在你得把消息递给辛达强权：你为合法继承人 Hector Andrada 又拉到一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。毕竟积少成多。

他们总该认账：哪怕 Macario 犯下大错，你的忠诚已经得到了证明。

texts.en:
There's some time now, while the inevitable conflict lays quiet. Time to move additional supplies to the rebels, make more contacts, and refit your own fleet...

You take a moment to have your comms officer set up wide-band content monitors so you will be alerted when events of interest occur in the Askonia system.
texts.zh:
眼下还有一段时间，那场迟早要来的冲突暂且沉寂。正好把更多补给送给叛军，多结几路人脉，再把自己的舰队整备一番...

你抽空让通讯军官架起全频段内容监听，Askonia 星系里一有值得注意的动静，你就能收到警报。

texts.en:
Next step: get word to Dolos Macario that you've secured an additional line of support for the 'rightful' heir, Hector Andrada, which should help tip the scales in his favor. Every little bit helps.

He'll be forced to recognize your value in spite of his gross misstep.
texts.zh:
下一步：把消息递给 Dolos Macario——你为那位'合法'继承人 Hector Andrada 又拉到一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。积少成多嘛。

哪怕他犯下大错，也由不得他不认你的价值。

options.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

options.en: I must contact Hector directly
options.zh: 我必须直接联系 Hector

options.en: I must contact Dolos Macario
options.zh: 我必须联系 Dolos Macario

options.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

texts.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network.

It's a long shot, but even with a common snoop hack you might be able to find a link for Hector's alias - or for someone who knows where he might be found.

Decisive action is exactly how Andrada won Askonia - you need but follow his example.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。

希望不大，但哪怕只用寻常的窥探手段，也许就能找到通往 Hector 化名的链路——或是找到一个知道他下落的人。

Andrada 当年正是靠果断的行动赢下了 Askonia——你只需照他的样子做。

texts.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system.

A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and give him one last chance to correct himself before you show him the true meaning of power.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。

一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说清他犯下的错误，给他最后一次改正的机会——在那之后，就让他见识见识权力的真正含义。

options.en: It must be done. Macario must be shown the error of his ways
options.zh: 必须这么做。必须让 Macario 看清他错在哪里

texts.en:
You take a deep breath.

And open your eyes.
texts.zh:
你深吸一口气。

然后睁开了眼睛。

texts.en: Hector Andrada is key. His will alone will determine the future of the Sindrian Diktat, whatever Macario thinks.
texts.zh: 关键在于 Hector Andrada。不管 Macario 怎么想，辛达强权的未来只系于他一个人的意志。

options.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

texts.en: Dolos Macario is key. His manipulations will determine the future of the Sindrian Diktat, whatever Hector thinks.
texts.zh: 关键在于 Dolos Macario。不管 Hector 怎么想，辛达强权的未来都系于他的手腕。

options.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

texts.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system.

A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and set everything right.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。

一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说清他犯下的错误，把一切拨回正轨。

texts.en:
"That bloodthirsty, raving blowhard?"

Arroyo holds his look for just a moment.
texts.zh:
"那个嗜血成性、满嘴疯话的牛皮大王？"

Arroyo 迎着你的目光，停了片刻。

texts.en:
"That circus dumping-ground of pirates, zealots, and terrorists?"

Arroyo holds his look for just a moment.
texts.zh:
"那个海盗、狂信徒和恐怖分子凑成一堆的马戏团垃圾场？"

Arroyo 迎着你的目光，停了片刻。

texts.en: "Then why the big pitch?" He shakes his head, annoyed. "You're just going to lay low and wait after all?"
texts.zh: "那你刚才那一大通说辞算什么？\"他不耐烦地摇头，\"绕了一圈，你还是打算缩起来等？"

texts.en: "Then why the big pitch?" He shakes his head, annoyed.
texts.zh: "那你刚才那一大通兜售算什么？" 他烦躁地摇了摇头。

options.en: I'm serious. I'm going to try to lay low and see what happens.
options.zh: 我是认真的。我会尽量缩着不出头，看看会怎样。

options.en: No, I still need to deal with the situation in Askonia.
options.zh: 不，Askonia 的局面我还是得处理。

texts.en:
"Good." He nods. "Smart."

"I also should tell you. I've heard... grumbling. About you meddling in Askonia." His hand comes up. "I don't care if you meant to or not, it's immaterial. Point is, a couple fellow Company executives got the idea that their profits would be better off if your operations were closed."

"Permanently."
texts.zh:
"很好。\"他点了点头。\"聪明。"

"还有件事我该告诉你。我听到了一些...怨言。说你在 Askonia 多管闲事。\"他抬起一只手。\"我不在乎你是不是有意的，那不重要。重点是，公司里有几位高管认定，你的产业要是被关掉，他们的利润会更好看。"

"永久关掉。"

options.en: Someone's trying to kill me?
options.zh: 有人想杀我？

texts.en:
"Yeah."

He leans back. "So be careful."
texts.zh:
"是啊。"

他往后一靠。"所以小心点。"

options.en: Who is it? How? I'd like some information.
options.zh: 是谁？怎么动手？我想知道些细节。

texts.en:
Arroyo's expression doesn't change.

"That's all I've got. Like I said, rumors. And I'm not about to go digging around in the dirt of these trigger-happy ladder-climbers. It's called 'self preservation' and you should consider learning about it. Don't get killed. I'd be..."

He trails off, considering his words. None seem to come to him.

"Got work to do," he says quickly. "Arroyo out."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
Arroyo 的表情没有变化。

"我知道的就这些。我说了，都是传言。我才不会去翻那些一点就炸、只顾往上爬的家伙的脏事。这叫'自保'，你该学着点。别被人弄死了。不然我会..."

他话说到一半停住了，斟酌着用词。似乎一个词也没斟酌出来。

"我还有活要干，\"他飞快地说。\"Arroyo 完毕。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
You'll just have to watch your back and react as other parties make their moves.

Whether a murderous Tri-Tachyon executive or would-be Supreme Executor.
texts.zh:
你只能自己盯着背后，等别人先出手再作应对。

不管出手的是个杀心已起的速子科技高管，还是个想做最高元首的人。

texts.en: "I guess you do have a Tri-Tachyon commission," he admits rather begrudgingly.
texts.zh: "看来你手里确实有张速子科技的委任状，"他不情不愿地承认。

options.en: Askonia needs stability, a strong leader, for profits to be ensured. It needs Hector Andrada.
options.zh: Askonia 需要稳定，需要一位强势的领袖，利润才有保障。它需要 Hector Andrada。

options.en: Askonia needs stability, a strong leader, for profits to be ensured. It needs Achilles Andrada.
options.zh: Askonia 需要稳定，需要一位强势的领袖，利润才有保障。它需要 Achilles Andrada。

options.en: Ending Macario's corrupt reign of terror is simply the right thing to do.
options.zh: 终结 Macario 那套贪腐的恐怖统治，本来就是该做的事。

options.en: I want to show Macario why trying to make me his patsy will be his downfall.
options.zh: Macario 想拿我当替罪羊，我要让他明白，这就是他的覆灭之因。

options.en: I want to stop Macario's reign of terror and corruption.
options.zh: 我要终结 Macario 的恐怖统治和贪腐。

options.en: It's an opportunity. One side's downfall provides another's ascension, right?
options.zh: 这是个机会。一边倒下，另一边就能上位，对吧？

options.en: This is an opportunity to make credits from the chaos! (pander)
options.zh: 这场乱局正是赚星币的机会！ (谄媚)

options.en: I'm a profitable business contact, aren't I? That must count for something.
options.zh: 我是个能赚钱的商业伙伴，不是吗？这总该算点什么。

options.en: I'm a profitable business contact, aren't I. That must count for something.
options.zh: 我是个能赚钱的商业伙伴，对吧。这总该算点什么。

options.en: Macario is distracted - he's trying to run a coup. Now is the time to push.
options.zh: Macario 正分身乏术——他在操办一场政变。现在正是加码的时候。

options.en: Once I prove to Macario he made a mistake he'll reward me - and you.
options.zh: 只要我让 Macario 明白他看错了人，他就会奖赏我——还有你。

options.en: With upheaval comes opportunity. Credits moved. Old deals broken, new deals made.
options.zh: 动荡带来机会。星币在流动。旧约作废，新约签成。

options.en: Askonia's is underutilized. Suppression and uprisings are holding back an economic boom.
options.zh: Askonia 的经济远没有被充分盘活。镇压和暴动压着一场经济繁荣。

options.en: So we're agreed?
options.zh: 那我们说定了？

options.en: Maybe we can figure this out later... (back)
options.zh: 这事也许以后再想吧... (返回)

options.en: Maybe I'll just wait and see what happens...
options.zh: 也许我就先等等，看看会怎么样...

texts.en:
"A strong leader."

He gives you a withering look. "Okay. I suppose."

"Askonia has seen more corruption and unrest every cycle. The bribes are eating into profits. And where's that Supreme Executor that's supposed to keep the system in line? Personally I don't find the holos convincing- I've faked better."
texts.zh:
"一位强势的领袖。"

他投来一个能把人看矮半截的眼神。"行吧。我想是吧。"

"Askonia 每个星历年的贪腐和动荡都在加剧。贿赂正在吃掉利润。那位本该管住这个星系的最高元首呢？就我个人而言，那些全息影像一点也说服不了我——我伪造的都比他像样。"

texts.en:
"A strong leader."

He gives you a withering look. "Okay. I suppose."

"Askonia has seen more corruption and unrest every cycle. The bribes are eating into profits. And where's that Supreme Executor who's supposed to keep the system in line?? Personally I don't find the holos convincing- I've faked better."
texts.zh:
"一位强势的领袖。"

他投来一个能把人看矮半截的眼神。"行吧。我想是吧。"

"Askonia 每个星历年的贪腐和动荡都在加剧。贿赂正在吃掉利润。那位本该管住这个星系的最高元首呢？就我个人而言，那些全息影像一点也说服不了我——我伪造的都比他像样。"

texts.en:
"The right thing." He gives you a withering look. "To do."

"What does that even mean? No - don't explain. I don't care. That's not a business plan. Why am I supposed to work with you on... whatever this is?"
texts.zh:
"该做的事。\"他投来一个能把人看矮半截的眼神，\"我是说，去做。"

"这话到底什么意思？不——别解释。我不在乎。那不算商业计划。我凭什么要跟你一起干...不管你这是在干什么？"

texts.en:
"Okay," he says, crossing his arms.

"Why do I suddenly care about your infantile need for revenge? Why am I supposed to work with you on... whatever this is?"
texts.zh:
"好，"他双臂抱在胸前。

"我为什么会突然在乎你那点幼稚的复仇心？我凭什么要跟你一起干...不管你这是在干什么？"

texts.en:
"Okay," he says, crossing his arms.

"Why do I suddenly care about Askonia? Why am I supposed to help you with... what are you even proposing?"
texts.zh:
"好，"他双臂抱在胸前。

"我为什么会突然在乎 Askonia？我凭什么要帮你...你到底在提什么？"

texts.en:
"Okay," he says, crossing his arms. "That's a bit vague, but now we're beginning to talk sense."

"And it's risky, even in the hypothetical. And you need to convince me why whatever you're proposing is worth it."
texts.zh:
"好，\"他双臂抱在胸前，\"说得有点含糊，不过总算开始讲点像样的话了。"

"而且就算只是假设，这也够冒险的。你得说服我，你提的这套为什么值得。"

texts.en:
"Okay," he says, crossing his arms. "I know you don't believe that - but I do. So I like how you're talking."

"But it's risky. And you need to convince me why whatever this is is worth it."
texts.zh:
"好，\"他双臂抱在胸前，\"我知道你自己都不信这话——可我信。所以你这套说法，我喜欢。"

"但这很冒险。你得说服我，这整件事为什么值得。"

texts.en:
After a short silence, and a sigh.

"I suppose. But that's not enough."
texts.zh:
沉默了片刻，然后是一声叹息。

"我想是吧。可这还不够。"

texts.en:
"Hmm." Arroyo rubs his beard, thinking.

"Sure. If he's been planning this for ten, maybe twenty cycles... He's launching a new enterprise, he's committed his liquid assets. Customers aren't sure about the new value proposition and branding. The investors must be jumpy."

He looks at you, conceding. "It's an interesting point."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"Arroyo 捻着胡须，思索起来。

"有道理。如果他为此筹划了十年，也许二十年...他是在开张一门新买卖，把流动资金全押了进去。客户对新的价值主张和品牌还没底。投资人一定坐不住。"

他看着你，算是让步。"这个点很有意思。"

texts.en:
"Reward, huh." Arroyo rubs his beard. "You... think Dolos Macario is going to come around on all of this and give you a reward?"

"Wait," he makes a show of searching around, as if there was someone nearby that he overlooked. "Is there some other Macario you're talking about? Who isn't a vindictive monster?"

He stops to give you a look through the comms.

"Don't be stupid. At this point you're lucky if he gives you a quick execution."
texts.zh:
"奖赏，是吗。\"Arroyo 捻着胡须，\"你...觉得 Dolos Macario 会在这件事上转变心意，还给你发奖赏？"

"等等，\"他煞有介事地四下张望，像是在找什么被自己漏掉的近旁之人，\"你说的该不会是另一个 Macario 吧？总不会是那个记仇成性的怪物？"

他停下来，隔着通讯盯着你看。

"别犯傻。到这一步，他肯给你一个痛快的处决，你就该谢天谢地了。"

texts.en:
"True," he admits. "It's a high-risk market, but the potential to open new segments is equally high. There'll be some big investments made in bold initiatives."

"Weapons, ships, mercenaries, fuel, supplies - up, up, up."

He also stands up, now, getting excited.

"Supply chain stability will take a short-term hit, but heavy industry futures in stable zones... you can't lose."

Arroyo stops himself and gives you a look. Is that something like respect? He turns away before you're sure.
texts.zh:
"没错，\"他承认，\"这是个高风险的市场，可开出新板块的潜力一样高。会有一批大钱投到大胆的举措上去。"

"武器、舰船、雇佣兵、燃料、补给——涨，涨，涨。"

他也站了起来，兴致上来了。

"供应链的稳定短期内会受些冲击，可稳定地带的重工业期货...稳赚不赔。"

Arroyo 收住话头，看了你一眼。那里面是不是有点类似敬意的东西？你还没看清，他就转开了脸。

texts.en:
"Mm. The old Lion hasn't been running a tight ship, it's true."

Arroyo considers this for a moment.

"Instability lowers demand. Low investment in secondary and tertiary sectors... any surplusses invested go to low-return weapons technology - profitable for sections of Tri-Tachyon, sure." He looks over at you. "Not my department and not my portfolio, however. Low return for me. They can crash and burn, for all I care."

"If there's a new chief executive in Askonia, maybe I can get in on the ground floor of new budget allocations."

He rubs his hands together.

"They just need leadership that isn't some drooling idiot..."
texts.zh:
"嗯。那头老狮子掌舵确实不够严。"

Arroyo 琢磨了一下。

"动荡会压低需求。二、三产业投资不足...投出去的盈余都流向了低回报的武器技术——对速子科技的部分部门来说当然赚钱。\"他看过来，\"可那不是我的部门，也不在我的投资组合里。对我来说回报太低。他们烧光、垮掉，我都不在乎。"

"要是 Askonia 换个新的首席执行官，也许我能在新预算分配的起步阶段就插进去。"

他搓了搓手。

"他们只需要一个不是流着口水犯傻的领导人..."

texts.en: "No," he says. "We're not."
texts.zh: "不，\"他说，\"我们没说定。"

texts.en:
He stares at you for a moment.

"Yes, we're agreed. There are credits to be made."

"What's the plan?"
texts.zh:
他盯着你看了片刻。

"对，我们说定了。这生意有星币可赚。"

"计划是什么？"

texts.en:
"Hrm." Arroyo narrows his eyes. "After all of that?"

He shrugs.

"Good," he says. "I guess."
texts.zh:
"嗯。\"Arroyo 眯起眼，\"说完这么一大套，你就这么算了？"

他耸了耸肩。

"好，\"他说，\"大概吧。"

options.en: Yes, I'm going to lay low and see how it pans out.
options.zh: 对，我会先蛰伏，看看事情怎么发展。

options.en: No, let's discuss options.
options.zh: 不，我们还是谈谈有哪些选择。

texts.en:
"Play it safe, that's what I'd do."

Arroyo still doesn't seem pleased with you, somehow.

"稳着来，这是我的做法。"
