texts.en: You terminate the connection through the comms relay.
texts.zh: 你通过通讯中继结束了连接。

texts.en:
"Don't," she spits.

"This won't work for long," she says, voice tight. "You must contact Hector as soon as possible to... clean this up."
texts.zh:
"别说了，"她厉声道。

"这撑不了多久，\"她声音发紧。\"你必须尽快联系上 Hector，把这事...收拾干净。"

texts.en:
She nods, slowly. Pensive.

"Macario will be controlling the new Supreme Executor's comms. As he did, with time, Philip's."

Hyder considers for a moment, then her posture straightens. The tone of command enters her voice.

"Avoid the Sindrian Diktat fleets - we have our orders and will follow them to the death. If you've other allies, forces to marshal, some angle to play against Macario... seek them out. An opportunity will arise to make contact when open conflict becomes inevitable. Macario cannot personally control fleets comms in a time of war."
texts.zh:
她缓缓点头。若有所思。

"Macario 会控制新任最高元首的通讯。就像他当初随着时间推移，控制了 Philip 的一样。"

Hyder 思索片刻，随即挺直了身子。发号施令的语气回到她声音里。

"避开辛达强权的舰队——我们有自己的命令，会至死执行。如果你还有别的盟友、有能调动的兵力、有能用来对付 Macario 的门路...就去找他们。等公开冲突变得不可避免，接触的机会自然会出现。战时的舰队通讯，Macario 没法亲自控制。"

options.en: How will I know it is time?
options.zh: 我怎么知道什么时候是时机？

texts.en:
"Is he?" She looks defensive.

"And if he is - how can I fight informants, agents, assassins. He's bribed or blackmailed someone in every senior staff and ministry."

"Fleet armaments can't fight that war."
texts.zh:
"是吗？"她神情戒备起来。

"就算真是这样——我又怎么去对付线人、特工、刺客。每个高级幕僚班子、每个部里，都有人被他收买或要挟。"

"舰队火力打不了这场仗。"

options.en: You need allies. Allies who can do what Macario does.
options.zh: 你需要盟友。能替你做 Macario 那些事的盟友。

texts.en:
"After all of these... spy-games, that's what you have to say?"

She looks aside, distressed and annoyed.

"Honor, yes. I have upheld it through all, against schemers and traitors on all sides. Now a new-declared Supreme Executor, and soon another, no doubt. Which Sindrian Diktat shall I serve?"

Hyder turns to you.

"And why should I speak to you of such things? You've been nothing but a harbinger of chaos."
texts.zh:
"闹了这么多...间谍把戏，你就给我这一句？"

她移开目光，既烦躁又苦恼。

"荣誉，对。我自始至终都守着它，对抗四面八方的阴谋家和叛徒。如今又有人自立为最高元首，而且毫无疑问，很快还会有下一个。我该效忠哪一个辛达强权？"

Hyder 转向你。

"再说，我凭什么跟你谈这些？你从头到尾只会带来混乱。"

texts.en:
"Yes." She nods, not looking into the feed. "Of course."

She says nothing for a long moment.

Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the confident tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "There is much to see done."

"Hyder out."
texts.zh:
"是。\"她点点头，目光没有看向通讯画面。\"当然。"

她久久没有说话。

随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的站姿。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，语气笃定，带着指挥官办公室里惯有的那种送客口吻。\"还有许多事等着办。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

texts.en:
"I am disappointed," she says, voice going distant. A commander ordering a squad to certain death. "You approach me with critical information, and then - confusion. More underhanded schemes, half-truths."

"Is this yet another Macario scheme?" Her head tilts, just slightly. "I'm not even sure you would know it is, if it is. It would explain a lot. Everything, perhaps."
texts.zh:
"我很失望，\"她说道，声音渐渐疏远。像一位指挥官在下令让小队去送死。\"你带着关键情报来见我，结果却是——混乱。更多的暗地算计、半真半假的话。"

"这又是 Macario 的一场算计吗？\"她的头微微一偏。\"我甚至不确定，若真是如此，你自己会不会知道。这能解释很多事。也许能解释一切。"

options.en: Look, I'm just trying to help you. It isn't easy.
options.zh: 听着，我只是想帮你。这不容易。

options.en: Your paranoia is playing right into Macario's hands. This is what he wants!
options.zh: 你的偏执正合 Macario 的心意。这正是他想要的！

options.en: If that's what you think, I'll leave you to your own devices.
options.zh: 既然你这么想，那就随你自便吧。

texts.en:
She just watches you for a moment.

"Hyder out."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
她只是看了你片刻。

"Hyder 完毕。"

通讯切断。

texts.en:
She just watches you for a moment.

"Hyder out."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
她只是看了你片刻。

"Hyder 完毕。"

通讯切断。

texts.en:
You tell of extracting the encrypted files meant for Dolos Macario from the head of a courier (deceased) floating in space after a mercenary destroyed their transport on the fringe of the Askonia system.

And the contents: seven sets of reports on seven clones of Andrada hidden in seven systems spread across the Persean Sector.

You describe the details. Hyder's expression is closed.
texts.zh:
你讲起事情的经过：一名信使的运输船在 Askonia 星系边缘被雇佣兵击毁，你从漂浮在太空中的那具遗体上取出了本该交给 Dolos Macario 的加密文件。

还有文件的内容：七组报告，关于七个 Andrada 的克隆体，被藏在英仙座星域各处七个星系里。

你详述了细节。Hyder 面无表情。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I don't trust you," she says, voice level.

"And most of all I don't trust Macario. I have no reason to believe this isn't another of his games."

She crosses her arms.
texts.zh:
"我不信你，"她说道，声音平板。

"而我最不信的是 Macario。我没有理由相信这不是他又一场把戏。"

她抱起了双臂。

texts.en:
"Though I respect your word as an officer," she says, "I would be remiss not to confirm the alleged contents of these files myself."

She crosses her arms.
texts.zh:
"尽管我尊重你身为军官的保证，\"她说道，\"但若不亲自核实这些文件所称的内容，就是我的失职。"

她抱起了双臂。

options.en: Send Hyder the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

options.en: You're going to have to take my word for it, $rank.
options.zh: 这事儿你只能信我，$rank。

options.en: This stubbornness is why you're going to find yourself in front of a firing squad.
options.zh: 就是这股倔劲，迟早会让你站到行刑队面前。

options.en: Send Hyder the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

options.en: I can't do that, $rank.
options.zh: 这我做不到，$rank。

texts.en:
"Hold a moment, captain."

She takes a few minutes, scrolling rapidly through files. Rapidly assessing new intel as a trained combat officer must. Her frown only deepens.

A sign, you think, that she might believe these are real.

She sets her TriPad down and looks back through the comms, distantly. As if staring across light-years.
texts.zh:
"等一下，舰长。"

她花了几分钟，飞快地翻动文件。以一名训练有素的战斗军官应有的方式，迅速评估着新情报。她的眉头越皱越紧。

你觉得，这是个迹象——她或许相信这些都是真的。

她放下 TriPad，隔着通讯望回来，目光遥远。像是在凝视数光年之外。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"It is... disturbing." She looks away.

"Heirs of Andrada. Plots and schemes. A battle for spies, assassins, and," a look of disgust, "politicians."

Her eyes snap to yours. "How much of this have you personally confirmed?"
texts.zh:
"这...令人不安。"她移开了目光。

"Andrada 的继承人。阴谋与算计。一场由间谍、刺客，还有，\"她露出厌恶的神色，\"政客来打的战争。"

她的目光猛地转向你。"这些，你亲自核实了多少？"

options.en: It's true. All of it.
options.zh: 是真的。全都是。

options.en: Some of it.
options.zh: 有一部分。

options.en: One. So far.
options.zh: 一个。到目前为止。

options.en: None of it, yet. I came to you first.
options.zh: 一个都还没核实。我先来找的你。

texts.en: A quick nod. She unfocuses from you, thinking. For a moment.
texts.zh: 她迅速点了点头，目光从你身上散开，思索着。只片刻。

texts.en: A slow nod. She takes a moment to assemble her thoughts.
texts.zh: 她缓缓点头，花了一会儿整理思绪。

texts.en:
"I risk much to even speak of this subject. I need one hundred percent confirmation from you before this goes any further."

She sets her TriPad aside, then places her hands behind her back in formal posture.

"Thank you captain. That will be all."
texts.zh:
"光是谈论这件事，我就已经冒了极大风险。在事情继续推进之前，我需要你百分之百的确认。"

她把 TriPad 放到一旁，随后双手背到身后，摆出正式的仪态。

"谢谢你，舰长。就这样吧。"

options.en: Watch your back. Macario is going to make a move sooner or later.
options.zh: 小心背后。Macario 迟早会动手。

options.en: Remember that I gave you this. That it's me trying to protect you.
options.zh: 记住，这是我把机会给你的。是我在想办法保护你。

options.en: Wait - you believe me, right?
options.zh: 等等——你信我，对吧？

texts.en:
Hyder's hand twitches and the privacy field drops.

She watches you for a moment, then the comms cut.
texts.zh:
Hyder 的手一抽，隐私场消散了。

她看了你片刻，随后通讯切断。

texts.en:
Hyder's hand twitches and the privacy field drops.

She watches you for a moment, then the comms cut.
texts.zh:
Hyder 的手一抽，隐私场消散了。

她看了你片刻，随后通讯切断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Close the comms
options.zh: 关闭通讯

texts.en: She doesn't react for a moment.
texts.zh: 她一时没有反应。

texts.en: She doesn't react for a moment. As if an underling made an error and she's providing a chance for self-correction.
texts.zh: 她一时没有反应。像是在等一名下属自己纠正错误。

texts.en:
"Your word is not enough. If you're lying, or wrong... that is treason."

Her expression only cools.

"Treason is death."
texts.zh:
"你的话不够。如果你在撒谎，或者搞错了...那就是叛国。"

她的神情只是更冷了。

"叛国，就是死。"

options.en: Send Hyder the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

options.en: It's the best I can do. Trust me.
options.zh: 我只能做到这一步。相信我。

options.en: This stubbornness is why you're going to find yourself in front of a firing squad.
options.zh: 就是这股倔劲，迟早会让你站到行刑队面前。

texts.en:
"I cannot," she says with cold finality.

"Do not contact me again. Hyder out."

The comms snap off.
texts.zh:
"我不能，"她说道，冷硬而决绝。

"不要再联系我。Hyder 完毕。"

通讯骤然中断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
Her eyes narrow.

"Threatening an officer is a capital crime, captain. I've been far too lenient in indulging your treasonous paranoia."

"No more chances. Vacate this orbit."

"Hyder out." The comms snap off.
texts.zh:
她眯起了眼睛。

"威胁一名军官是死罪，舰长。我对你那套叛国式的偏执，实在太过纵容了。"

"没有下一次了。离开这条轨道。"

"Hyder 完毕。"通讯骤然中断。

texts.en:
"Captain, I've only just watched this... clone announces himself as Supreme Executor. This is..."

Hyder trails off. Eyes searching.
texts.zh:
"舰长，我刚看着这个...克隆体自称最高元首。这简直..."

Hyder 没有说下去。目光游移，像是在搜寻什么。

texts.en:
Achilles re-appears.

There's more color in his face than you've seen before, and he's breathing heavily - but steadily. Controlled.

This might be what passes for anger, even rage, in him.
texts.zh:
Achilles 再次出现在通讯画面中。

他脸上涨起的血色比你以往见过的都浓，呼吸粗重——但很平稳。克制住了。

在他身上，这大概就算是愤怒，甚至是暴怒了。

options.en: Say nothing
options.zh: 什么也不说

options.en: My condolences.
options.zh: 节哀。

options.en: My condolences. (lie)
options.zh: 节哀。 (说谎)

texts.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer giving rapid orders. "My staff shall contact you. An invitation."

A pause, and he adjusts his tone, remembering that he ought to be polite in a moment in which he does not exactly outrank you. Yet.

"I would... invite you to attend."
texts.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气是指挥官下达急令时那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。"

一顿。他调整了语气，想起此刻自己其实并不比你高一级——暂时还不。

"我... 想邀请你出席。"

texts.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer. "My staff will contact you. An invitation. I would... invite you to attend."

"I ask no oath, no pledge. Only your presence."
texts.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气是指挥官那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。我... 想邀请你出席。"

"我不要誓言，也不要承诺。只要你人到场。"

options.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
options.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

options.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
options.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

texts.en:
He produces a brief and joyless smirk, then you can see his eyes and his attention shifting elsewhere.

"I have much to do," he says, and reaches for his interface.

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
他扯出一个短促、毫无喜色的笑，随后你眼看着他的目光与注意力转向了别处。

"我还有很多事要办，"他说着，伸手去按他的界面。

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
You cut the comms.

True to his word, an invitation arrives shortly thereafter. A ceremony - unspecified - is to be held on a warship held in a Gens Kato-owned spacedock.

Quite soon.

They must have been waiting, and ready. The Gens Kato strategists allowed Hector to make the first move - and had contingencies prepared for whatever form it took.
texts.zh:
你切断了通讯。

他说到做到，邀请很快就到了。一场仪式——细节未明——将在一艘停泊于 Kato 氏族名下太空船坞的战舰上举行。

就在不久之后。

他们一定早有准备，一直在等。Kato 氏族的谋士们任由 Hector 先动手——并为他可能采取的任何形式都备好了后手。

options.en: Attend the ceremony
options.zh: 出席仪式

options.en: Decline to attend the ceremony
options.zh: 拒绝出席仪式

texts.en:
Some hours later, you (and your bodyguards) step off your shuttle wearing your finest uniforms.

An attendant in Gens Kato livery meets you, reading instructions off a datapad.

"Um, $titlePL $PlayerName? $PlayerSirOrMadam. Yes, you and your, uh, party; if you could please come with me?"
texts.zh:
几个小时后，你 (带着你的保镖) 走下穿梭机，穿着你最体面的制服。

一名穿着 Kato 氏族服饰的侍从迎上来，一边从数据板上读着指示。

"呃，$titlePL $PlayerName？$PlayerSirOrMadam。对，就是你和你的，呃，随行人员；请跟我来好吗？"

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
You follow the attendant to the spacedock, then through a luxuriously spacious access bridge into a large hangar within a warship.

Lines of fighters and munitions ready to be loaded dominate a crowd of officers and crew, marines and technicians. More are streaming in by the minute, led to their positions by flustered attendants.

Most are wearing uniforms - an odd design to your eyes, as if the ghost army of some long-lost battlegroup appeared out of deep space. Looking closer, you see something of the utilitarian League Armada fit done up with tyrian trim on off-white field with gold touches.
texts.zh:
你跟着侍从走向太空港，穿过一条宽敞得近乎奢华的连接廊桥，进入一艘战舰内的大机库。

成排待装的战机与弹药横在眼前，抢尽了一群军官、船员、陆战队员与技师的风头。每一分钟都有更多人涌进来，被手忙脚乱的侍从领到各自的位置。

大多数人穿着制服——在你眼里式样古怪，仿佛某支早已湮没的战斗群的幽灵大军从深空里冒了出来。再细看，你辨认出几分联盟舰队那种实用主义的剪裁，只是配上了泰尔紫的镶边，米白的底子上缀着金色点缀。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You're led to a section of VIPs and their associates - dominated by Gens Kato, but with many notable client gens. Businessfolk of many worlds, glowering mercenaries, and a proud but more humbly dressed group set along the corridors with the best access from softly buzzing camera drones - refugees of Askonia, primarily Opis.

A bold association.

You are feted with drinks and snacks, the attention of VIPs, and the lingering look of more than a few media drones. The chatter grows to a respectable din. Speculation directed toward an empty stage at one end of the hangar.

The lights dim, and the chatter subsides.
texts.zh:
你被领到贵宾及其随从的区域——Kato 氏族的人占了多数，但也有不少显赫的附庸氏族。来自多个世界的商人、面色阴沉的雇佣兵，还有一群神情骄傲却衣着朴素的人，站在位置最好、能让嗡鸣的摄像无人机顺畅取景的廊道边——他们是 Askonia 的难民，多数来自 Opis。

这一手相当大胆。

酒水点心款待着你，贵宾们围着你说话，还有不止一架媒体无人机久久地打量你。交谈声渐渐汇成一片体面的喧响。种种猜测都指向机库尽头那座空着的舞台。

灯光暗下，喧响平息。

options.en: Look to the stage
options.zh: 望向舞台

texts.en:
A lone figure emerges as a shadow into the bright spotlight. Judicious application of muffling fields ensures an awed hush.

Achilles Andrada stands, eyes cast downward, face in shadow for a long moment. You can feel the tension build.
texts.zh:
一个孤身的人影自暗处走入明亮的聚光。消音场开合得恰到好处，压出一片敬畏的静默。

Achilles Andrada 站定，垂着眼睛，面孔在阴影里停留了很久。你能感觉到紧张在积聚。

options.en: Listen
options.zh: 听他说

texts.en:
"My father," he begins. "Was a man who showed many faces. A war hero." The muffling field adjusts to let am uneasy murmur through, then asserts itself to allow the next words. "-And the Hegemony's greatest traitor."

"He was a ruthless man. A genius, and to some, a monster. As great and terrible as a force of nature; the iron hand of history set in motion."

"Above all, he was a visionary."
texts.zh:
"我的父亲，"他开口道，"是个有许多副面孔的人。一位战争英雄。"消音场稍稍放开，让一阵不安的低语透了出来，随即又重新压住，为接下来的话留出空隙。"——也是霸主最大的叛徒。"

"他是个无情的人。一个天才，在某些人眼里则是怪物。如自然之力般伟大而可怖；是历史被启动时的那只铁手。"

"而最重要的，他是个有远见的人。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Achilles stares out at the crowd, his gaze directed at some elevated point. A practiced pose.

"But in time, surrounded by corrupt and immoral advisors, my father's vision grew dim - and the Sindrian Diktat rotted under those who conspired to deceive my aging father. They hid news of his death while plotting a treasonous coup."
texts.zh:
Achilles 望向人群，目光却落在某处高点上。一个练熟了的姿势。

"但时日一久，在腐败无德的顾问包围之下，我父亲的眼光渐渐暗淡——辛达强权在那些合谋欺瞒我年迈父亲的人手里烂掉了。他们隐瞒他的死讯，同时策划一场谋逆政变。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You may know my brother, Hector," a pause for some laughs, some jeers.

Achilles is hard-faced, raising a hand for silence. A dignified rebuke after the set-up for mockery.

"He is a victim." His hand movement quells all objection.

"A puppet controlled by Dolos Macario, my father's disloyal spymaster. You know HIM as the 'Spider of Sindria', and many are the rumors of his degenerate crimes - of torture, kidnapping, and above all treason. Treason against the final will of my father, the Supreme Executor!"
texts.zh:
"你们或许认识我的兄弟，Hector，"他停顿了一下，等着几声笑、几声嘘。

Achilles 板着脸，抬手要众人安静。他先容人起哄，再以不失体面的方式驳回。

"他是个受害者。"他的手势压下了所有异议。

"一个被 Dolos Macario 操控的傀儡——我父亲那个不忠的间谍头子。你们称他【辛达瑞亚之蛛】，关于他那些堕落的罪行，流言众多——酷刑、绑架，而最要紧的是叛国。背叛我父亲、最高元首最终的遗愿！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Achilles looks down for a moment, apparently concerned, projecting vulnerability - for a moment.

"Help me free my brother from that beast," he says quietly.

Then he looks up, eyes piercing in the carefully arranged lighting. Voice growing stronger, deeper.

"Help me free Askonia."
texts.zh:
Achilles 垂下眼，有那么一瞬显得忧虑，流露出一丝脆弱——只是一瞬。

"帮我把我兄弟从那头野兽手里救出来，"他轻声说。

随即他抬起头，目光在精心布置的灯光里锋利逼人。声音渐强，渐沉。

"帮我解放 Askonia。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I shall be the heir to Andrada!"

Achilles uses the voice of command.

"I shall be your Supreme Executor! I ask not for a blind pledge with a gun at your back; I ask only that my loyal citizens of the Sindrian Diktat remember - remember the hope and vision of Philip Andrada when he gave up his life to bring order to chaos. I make that same pledge to you."

"I give my life to bring order from chaos. For you, for Askonia, for the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
"Andrada 的继承人，理应是我！"

Achilles 拿出了发号施令的嗓音。

"我将成为你们的最高元首！我不要你们在枪口抵着后背时盲目效忠；我只求我忠诚的辛达强权公民记住——记住 Philip Andrada 为从混沌中带来秩序而献出生命时的希望与远见。我向你们立下同样的誓言。"

"我献出我的生命，为从混沌中带来秩序。为了你们，为了 Askonia，为了辛达强权！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The lighting shifts subtly, illuminating the hangar. As if on cue, the crowd cheers.

An unfamiliar banner unfurls behind Achilles - he stands alone before it.

Gens Kato's PR was skillfully restrained, crafting the image of a man who looks ready to fight, surrounded by the weapons of war and the warriors who will die using them.
texts.zh:
灯光悄然变换，照亮机库。人群仿佛接到了信号，齐声欢呼。

一面陌生的旗帜在 Achilles 身后展开——他独自立在旗前。

Kato 氏族的公关手腕克制而老练，精心塑造出这样一个形象：一个看上去随时准备开战的人，置身于战争的武器与将要持着这些武器赴死的战士之间。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.zh: 开始了。一场克隆兄弟之间争夺辛达强权的战争，争夺谁将成为...

texts.en:
Now, now it is time for Hector to launch his own fleet into orbit of Sindria.

You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power to bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. He can restore your commission; he can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat!
texts.zh:
如今，该让 Hector 把自己的舰队送上 Sindria 轨道了。

你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。他能恢复你的委任；他能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献！

texts.en:
Now it is the time that Hector must launch his own fleet from Sindria to face the usurper, the pretender, Achilles.

You must bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given Macario's kill-on-sight order. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Only Hector can restore your commission. Only Hector can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat and make things as they should be.
texts.zh:
现在，Hector 必须把自己的舰队从 Sindria 派出，去迎战那个篡位者、那个僭位者，Achilles。

你必须把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，又不能被奉了 Macario 格杀令的辛达强权舰队截住。Caden 会让他的舰队按兵不动吗？Hyder 呢？

只有 Hector 能恢复你的委任。只有 Hector 能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献，让一切回到本该有的样子。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
Your bodyguards clear a path through the excited crowd - now given free license to pop the lids off pressurized drink capsules. You suspect the medics will be busy administering remedies come the end of next shift.

You step back onto your shuttle, already receiving updates from Tactical about massive fleet movements in close orbit.
texts.zh:
你的保镖在兴奋的人群中开出一条路——这些人如今获准随意拧开加压饮料罐的盖子。你估计，到下一班结束时，军医们要忙着分发解酒药了。

你回到穿梭机上，战术部门已经在不断发来近轨道大规模舰队调动的通报。

texts.en:
You close the invitation, preferring to keep your association just a little more covert.

It's a clever move, trying to have you attend the ceremony. Without saying a word it would create an image of your full support as a subordinate to Achilles Andrada. It would grant him your legitimacy - or, failing that, at least an appearance of commanding your potency.
texts.zh:
你关掉了邀请，宁可让你与他的关联再隐蔽一些。

这步棋很聪明：让你出席仪式，不必说一个字，就能造出你完全支持 Achilles Andrada、且甘居其下的形象。这会让他借到你的正统性——即便不成，至少也显得他能号令你这份力量。

texts.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam." It's your comms officer.
texts.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。"是你的通讯官。

options.en: What is it?
options.zh: 什么事？

texts.en:
"I think you're going to want to see this," they say. "Another signal flagged high interest by the content sweep."

A pause, a concerned look.

"Sindrian Diktat priority override codes, but... loc-tag says it's from the Zagan system?"
texts.zh:
"我想你最好看看这个，\"对方说，\"内容筛查又标出一条高关注度信号。"

一阵沉默，一副担忧的神色。

"辛达强权的优先级覆盖码，可是...定位标签显示它来自 Zagan 星系？"

options.en: Put it through.

texts.en:
"So there it is." Rao's got a smile on his face. "The civil war just turned hot. Couldn't ask for better timing, because next comes my favorite part."

He doesn't glance at his datapad this time. "Taking out hostiles."
texts.zh:
"来了。\"Rao 脸上挂着笑。\"内战已经打成热战了。这时机再好不过，因为接下来是我最喜欢的环节。"

这次他没看数据板。"清除敌对目标。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I'm jealous, $titleHeg, because you get an opportunity to see some action."

"Get out there and hit as many patrols and convoys as you can. Don't care if they claim to follow the traitor Philip or any one of his clones - they're all targets. And if you can get in and raid key facilities, even better. Anything bearing those purple wings is fair game."
texts.zh:
"我羡慕你，$titleHeg，因为你有机会真刀真枪干一场。"

"出去，能打多少巡逻队和运输队就打多少。别管他们声称效忠叛徒 Philip 还是他哪一个克隆体——全是目标。要是还能钻进去突袭关键设施，那就更好。凡带着那对紫色翼徽的，都可以打。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"My quartermaster will release more fuel and supplies to your tender care. I trust you'll put them to work killing mutineers."

A ping from your TriPad suggests that your own quartermaster has just received the news.
texts.zh:
"我的军需官会再拨一批燃料和补给，交给你照管。我相信你会让它们用在杀叛军上。"

你的 TriPad 响了一声提示，看来你自己的军需官刚收到消息。

texts.en:
"My quartermaster will release some fuel and supplies to a storage bay assigned to you, on Ragnar Complex. I trust you'll put what you can in the hands of our Charterist friends - remember, Nortia - and otherwise set to work killing mutineers."

A ping from your TriPad suggests that your own quartermaster has just received the news.
texts.zh:
"我的军需官会拨一批燃料和补给到 Ragnar Complex 上划给你的一间仓储舱。我相信你会把能匀出来的部分交到我们宪章派朋友手里——记住，Nortia——剩下的就用来杀叛军。"

你的 TriPad 响了一声提示，看来你自己的军需官刚收到消息。

texts.en:
"I'm not releasing more fuel and supplies," he says.

"You've already got the stocks meant for the Charterists and I want them put to work killing mutineers one way or another."

His expression goes hard. "Is that understood?"
texts.zh:
"我不会再拨燃料和补给了，"他说。

"本来要给宪章派的那批库存已经在你手上，我要它们不管走哪条路，都用在杀叛军上。"

他的神情硬了起来。"听明白了吗？"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Understood.
options.zh: 明白。

options.en: Look - I have a fleet. I can put those supplies to better use than the Charterists.
options.zh: 听我说——我有一支舰队。那批补给交给我，比给宪章派用得更好。

texts.en:
"Any more rebels, give 'em a little help, but not too much. And if you've got any more connections with unpleasant people, now's the time to call them in. We want to see the Sindrian Diktat fall, $titleHeg."

"Then the Phoenix will do what it does best and rise from the ashes, or whatever line the propaganda department is coming up for this one."

He tosses the datapad onto his desk. "That's it."

"Any questions? No?" He doesn't wait for you to interject. "Good. See you at the victory parade."
texts.zh:
"再碰上别的叛军，就给他们一点帮助，别太多。你要是还认识什么不三不四的人，现在正是把他们叫来的时候。我们要看到辛达强权倒下，$titleHeg。"

"然后凤凰会做它最擅长的事，从灰烬里重生——或者宣传部这回又想出什么说辞。"

他把数据板扔到桌上。"就这些。"

"还有问题吗？没有？\"他没等你插话。\"很好。胜利阅兵见。"

options.en: Got it.
options.zh: 明白。

texts.en:
"Does it look like we care?" he growls.

"If I wanted a deranged mercenary with authority issues to steal all the glory, I'd have put the reserve fleet directly under your command. But you might be surprised that opinions both popular and elite among the Core worlds view your type somewhat dimly compared to the 'freedom fighters' from a rich little moon that got blown to gravel by the psychotic arch-traitor."

He raises a single finger.

"And don't mistake this for a conversation. I'm telling you this out of the respect from one warrior to another."

The hand lowers. "Moving on."
texts.zh:
"你看我们像在乎吗？"他低吼道。

"我要真想找一个满脑子不服管、还疯疯癫癫的雇佣兵来抢光所有功劳，早就把预备舰队直接拨到你手下了。可你也许想不到，核心世界的民意和精英，看你们这号人都不怎么顺眼——特别比起那颗富庶小卫星上出来的'自由斗士'。那颗卫星可是被那个疯魔的超级叛徒炸成了一地碎石。"

他竖起一根手指。

"别把这当成商量。我告诉你这些，是出于一个战士对另一个战士的尊重。"

那只手放下了。"继续。"

texts.en:
Macario is controlling the comms network. The only way to contact Hector - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Hyder hold her ships back? Would Caden?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
texts.zh:
Macario 控制着通讯网络。要联系 Hector——或任何其他人——唯一的办法是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Hyder 会约束住她的舰船吗？Caden 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

texts.en:
What is Macario's ploy?

Hector has declared himself Supreme Executor, the heir to Andrada. This moment is critical to the future of the Diktat.

But how? Macario is controlling the comms network and seems determined that you play the role of antagonist.
texts.zh:
Macario 在打什么算盘？

Hector 已自立为最高元首，Andrada 的继承人。此刻对强权的未来至关重要。

可该怎么做？Macario 控制着通讯网络，而且似乎打定主意要让你来扮那个反派。

texts.en:
Hector has declared himself Supreme Executor, the heir to Andrada. This moment is critical to the future of the Diktat!

Macario is controlling the comms network and is determined that you play the role of antagonist. No doubt he's seen fit to dispatch a fleet to catch you in the act of 'sabotaging' the system comms relay...

Macario 控制着通讯网络，且打定主意要让你来扮那个反派。他多半还觉得派一支舰队来，正好能当场逮住你在'破坏'星系通讯中继站...

Who will you back as the true heir of Andrada?

texts.en:
Then you must prove yourself despite the inconvenience of being declared the foremost enemy of the Sindrian Diktat by that treacherous spymaster.

Hector will recognize your loyalty because you will demonstrate it to him by providing material support, securing wavering allies, and pledging yourself directly to his cause - once you have the opportunity to do so...

那么，尽管那个背信弃义的谍报头子已把你宣布为辛达强权的头号公敌，你仍得证明自己。

Hector 会认可你的忠诚，因为你要以实际支援、稳住摇摆的盟友、直接向他宣誓效忠来向他证明——只等你有机会这么做...

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, $PlayerName. The next target of Macario's little games, aren't you." His eyes gleam with mirth. "Yes, I'm sure you'll want to tell me it's all made up and he's manipulating me. But what of it? This is what you deserve"

Caden laughs cruelly.

"Ever word you speak is a degenerate spacer lie. I will have ears for you only as you plead for mercy - then I shall order your execution to proceed!"

He's pleased with this retort, and with a dramatic gesture orders his comms officer to cut the link.
texts.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"啊，$PlayerName。你就是 Macario 那些小游戏的下一个目标，对吧。\"他眼里闪着快意。\"是啊，你肯定想告诉我，这一切都是编的，是他在操纵我。可那又怎样？这是你自找的。"

Caden 残忍地笑了起来。

"你说的每一个字，都是堕落的太空佬的谎言。我只在你求饶的时候才听得进你的话——然后，我就下令行刑！"

他对这番回击很满意，夸张地一挥手，命令通讯官切断链路。

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see a loyal follower of the Supreme Executor's vision, and," he leans in, "One who will stand with me when the time comes, when strength and loyalty will be required to secure the future of the Persean Sector."

He leans back, satisfied. "Terrible what Macario's been saying you've done. Avoid meeting any of our fleets; there's a kill-on-sight order, you know. And they don't have my authority... and patience."

Caden smirks, then bellows "Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"啊，舰长 $playerName。光荣属于辛达强权！\"他热情地吼道。\"看到有人忠心追随最高元首的愿景，真叫人热血沸腾，而且，\"他凑近了些，\"等那一刻来临，需要力量与忠诚来保住英仙座星域的未来时，这个人会站在我这边。"

他向后靠去，很是满意。"Macario 到处说你干了些什么，那些话真难听。别去碰我们的舰队；有一道见即格杀的命令，你知道的。何况他们也没有我的气度...和耐心。"

Caden 得意地一笑，随即吼道："光荣属于辛达强权！"

Caden shrugs.

"Dolos is fickle, isn't he. Always over-complicating what ought to be simple. Waste of time, waste of resources. But he can be useful, so I indulge his whimsy from time to time."

He turns from his pacing and looks at you through the link.
texts.zh:
Caden 耸了耸肩。

"Dolos 这人反复无常，对吧。总把本该简单的事搞得无比复杂。浪费时间，浪费资源。不过他有时还有用，所以我也就时不时纵容一下他的怪念头。"

他停下踱步，转过身，透过链路看着你。

texts.en:
Caden shrugs.

"Dolos is fickle. And endlessly over-complicating what ought to be simple. Wasted effort, wasted resources. But he can be useful, so I indulge his whimsy from time to time."

He turns from his pacing and looks at you through the link.
texts.zh:
Caden 耸了耸肩。

"Dolos 反复无常。没完没了地把本该简单的事搞得无比复杂。白费力气，白费资源。不过他有时还有用，所以我也就时不时纵容一下他的怪念头。"

他停下踱步，转过身，透过链路看着你。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"It is well known that your people tend toward cowardice, forever smuggling drugs and acting as rather poor, self-serving mercenaries who overwhelm worthier opponents through surprise and number."

"Macario has seen fit to unburden himself of you. Now your loyalty is tested. What of it?"
texts.zh:
"众所周知，你们这种人天生怯懦，成天走私毒品，当那种低劣又自私的雇佣兵，靠偷袭和人多势众压过比你们更可敬的对手。"

"Macario 觉得该把你这个包袱甩掉了。现在你的忠诚要受考验了。怎么样？"

texts.en:
"It is well known that your people tend toward cowardice, forever smuggling drugs and acting as rather poor, self-serving mercenaries who overwhelm worthier opponents through surprise and number."

"Macario used you. Now your loyalty, so far as you are capable of loyalty, is tested. What of it?"
texts.zh:
"众所周知，你们这种人天生怯懦，成天走私毒品，当那种低劣又自私的雇佣兵，靠偷袭和人多势众压过比你们更可敬的对手。"

"Macario 利用了你。现在，你的忠诚——如果你也懂得什么叫忠诚的话——要受考验了。怎么样？"

options.en: We need to work together. All of us, for Hector. For the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 我们必须合作。所有人一起，为了 Hector。为了辛达强权！

options.en: Hector needs you. I, too, swore to uphold the blood of Andrada...
options.zh: Hector 需要你。我也曾宣誓维护 Andrada 的血脉...

options.en: We must preserve Philip Andrada's glorious vision! It is what he'd want.
options.zh: 我们必须守住 Philip Andrada 光荣的愿景！这才是他想要的。

options.en: Macario betrayed us both. Were not you to be Supreme Executor?
options.zh: Macario 背叛了我们两个。本来要坐上最高元首之位的，不就是你吗？

options.en: Macario will destroy the Sindrian Diktat if he isn't stopped!
options.zh: 再不拦住 Macario，他会毁了辛达强权！

texts.en: "Speak not of that!" he shouts, spittle flying. "You have no right! I was to be Supreme Executor! Not some clone, some child brainwashed by Dolos!"
texts.zh: "别提那件事！\"他吼道，唾沫横飞。\"你没有这个资格！本该由我来当最高元首！而不是某个克隆体，某个被 Dolos 洗脑的孩子！"

texts.en:
"And why should I listen to you, spacer? I never lost faith in the glory of Philip's transcendent philosophy. Never. It is others who failed. All around me, they fall. Their will is weak. Cowards. Traitors!"

He paces, like a cloned animal of Old Earth caged too long.
texts.zh:
"我凭什么要听你的，太空佬？我从未动摇过对 Philip 超凡意识形态之荣光的信念。从来没有。是别人失败了。我身边的人一个个倒下。他们意志薄弱。懦夫。叛徒！"

他来回踱步，像一头被关得太久的古地球克隆兽。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Caden wipes his brow, giving you a skeptical look. He looks suddenly tired. You notice the sweat-stains on his uniform.
texts.zh: Caden 抹了把额头，怀疑地看着你。他忽然显得很疲倦。你注意到他制服上的汗渍。

texts.en: Caden sticks his jaw out, striking a defiant pose against all who question Andradaism.
texts.zh: Caden 扬起下巴，摆出桀骜的姿态，仿佛要与所有质疑 Andrada 主义的人对抗到底。

texts.en: Caden sticks his chest out, medals flashing. His pride in his position is obvious. He looks eager to act.
texts.zh: Caden 挺起胸膛，勋章闪亮。他对自身地位的得意毫不掩饰。他看上去急于动手。

texts.en: Caden looks red and fervid, eyes gleaming with fire for Andradaism. He can't stop pacing.
texts.zh: Caden 脸色涨红，神态狂热，眼里烧着为 Andrada 主义而燃的火。他停不下踱步。

texts.en: His eyes dart around, his hand brushing his uniform pocket, then dropping to his side. You get the distinct impression that Caden is not in a receptive mood.
texts.zh: 他的目光四处游移，手在制服口袋上蹭了一下，又垂回身侧。你分明感觉到，Caden 此刻不是个听得进话的人。

options.en: We must unite under Hector Andrada's leadership! (explain)
options.zh: 我们必须团结在 Hector Andrada 的旗下！ (解释)

options.en: You should work with, rather than against, Oxana Hyder. (explain)
options.zh: 你该与 Oxana Hyder 合作，而不是与她为敌。 (解释)

options.en: Dolos Macario is your real enemy. Not Hyder, nor Hector. (explain)
options.zh: Dolos Macario 才是你真正的敌人。不是 Hyder，也不是 Hector。 (解释)

options.en: I see that you are... very busy. (leave)
options.zh: 我看得出你很...忙。 (离开)

texts.en:
You explain that the blood of Andrada will prevail over Macario's trickery and deception. Hector is a young man and he needs the experience of an old warrior, an example to lead him; indeed, a hero of the Sindrian Diktat.

He needs Horacio Caden. The Sindrian Diktat needs Horacio Caden. Indeed, Askonia - no, the Persean Sector needs Caden. It is not a place of fame and glory he might have imagined, but with Hector's father cut down... who but Horacio Caden to take Philip's place?

It is what Philip would have wanted.

Caden sulks, but you can swear he nods as you describe his heroism and wisdom.
texts.zh:
你解释说，Andrada 的血脉终将胜过 Macario 的诡计与欺瞒。Hector 还年轻，他需要一位老将的经验，需要一个可供他效法的榜样；确切地说，需要一位辛达强权的英雄。

他需要 Horacio Caden。辛达强权需要 Horacio Caden。确切地说，Askonia——不，整个英仙座星域都需要 Caden。这或许不是他想象中的功名与荣耀之地，可既然 Hector 的父亲已经倒下...除了 Horacio Caden，还有谁能取代 Philip 的位置？

这正是 Philip 会希望看到的。

Caden 沉着脸不吭声，但当你讲到他的英勇与智慧时，你发誓他点了下头。

texts.en:
You begin to explain that the blood of Andrada will prevail over Macario's trickery and deception. Hector is a young man and he needs the experience of an old warrior, an example to lead him; indeed, a hero of the-

Caden sulks, then, frustrated, interrupts with a shout.

"Enough! I won't be pandered to by a degenerate spacer. Loyal you may claim to be, but I shall not tolerate presumption! Not from spacer trash."

He takes a few seconds to catch his breath, glaring.
texts.zh:
你开口解释，Andrada 的血脉终将胜过 Macario 的诡计与欺瞒。Hector 还年轻，他需要一位老将的经验，需要一个可供他效法的榜样；确切地说，需要一位辛达强权的英雄——

Caden 沉着脸，随即烦躁地一声喝断，不让你说下去。

"够了！我不需要你这种堕落的太空佬来哄。你可以自称忠诚，但别太僭越！你僭越得太过了，太空渣滓。"

他花了几秒钟才喘匀气，瞪着你。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You explain that you see Hyder and Caden both as fighters - though she more tentative, obsessed with rules and order of logistics without truly understanding the glory of battle as described by Andrada's transcendent philosophy.

But that's why Hyder needs Horacio Caden: to serve as heroic example. This entire ploy by Macario to divide the fleets only weakens the Sindrian Diktat while enemies around a pretender.

Caden should make an ally of Hyder - subservient, of course - to use his skill, experience, and knowledge of Andrada's transcendent philosophy to overcome Hyder's innate failings.

The Diktat must come first and all must serve its cause.
texts.zh:
你解释说，在你眼里 Hyder 与 Caden 都是战士——只是她更为犹疑，执迷于规则与后勤秩序，却并不真正懂得 Andrada 超凡意识形态所描述的战斗之荣光。

也正因如此，Hyder 才需要 Horacio Caden：作为英雄的榜样。Macario 分化舰队的整套把戏，只会削弱辛达强权，同时让敌人聚拢到一名僭位者周围。

Caden 应当把 Hyder 收为盟友——当然，是从属的盟友——以他的本领、经验和对 Andrada 超凡意识形态的通晓，去弥补 Hyder 天生的缺陷。

强权必须高于一切，人人都该为它的事业效力。

texts.en:
You begin to explain that you see Hyder and Caden both as fighters - though she more tentative, obsessed with rules and order of logistics without truly understanding the glory of battle as described by Andrada's transcendent philosophy.

But that's why Hyder needs Horacio Caden: to serve as heroic example. This entire ploy by Macario to divide the fleets only-

"Cease your talk!" Caden interrupts with a shout.

"You speak defeatism! A capital offense if so I deem it. And you dare compare Hyder with myself? She's fit only to run a commissary. By Andrada's immortal glory, you're testing my patience, spacer."
texts.zh:
你解释说，在你眼里 Hyder 与 Caden 都是战士——只是她更为犹疑，执迷于规则与后勤秩序，却并不真正懂得 Andrada 超凡意识形态所描述的战斗之荣光。

也正因如此，Hyder 才需要 Horacio Caden：作为英雄的榜样。Macario 分化舰队的整套把戏，无非——

"住口！"Caden 一声喝断。

"你这是失败主义言论！我若认定如此，就是死罪。你还敢拿 Hyder 跟我相比？她只配去管军需库。以 Andrada 不朽的荣光起誓，太空佬，你是在试探我的耐性。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Even spacers like yourself," he says, claiming the line of reasoning for himself.

"It must be obvious if even you can see it," he concludes proudly.
texts.zh:
"就连你这样的太空佬，"他说，把这套推论据为己有。

"连你都看得出来，那这道理必定显而易见，"他得意地下了结论。

texts.en:
You ask, does Dolos Macario embody the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada?

He is deceptive, physically cowardly, and avoids the glory of battle and contest of will, favoring trickery instead.

Worse, he appears to believe he is better than the great work laid out by Philip Andrada! By seeking to manipulate, mold, and corrupt both the polity and heir of Andradaism reified, he mocks and sullies their perfection.

Macario is the rot in the heart of the Sindrian Diktat that must be purged. And everyone, everyone, from Gilead to Kazeron to Chicomoztoc, can see that it is Horacio Caden who holds the knife.
texts.zh:
你问：Dolos Macario 身上可体现了 Philip Andrada 的超凡意识形态？

他惯于欺瞒，身体上怯懦，回避战斗的荣光与意志的较量，只会取巧。

更糟的是，他似乎自认为比 Philip Andrada 所奠定的伟业更高明！他妄图操纵、塑造并腐蚀 Andrada 主义所实体化的政体与继承人，这是在嘲弄并玷污它们的完美。

Macario 是辛达强权心脏里的腐坏，必须清除。而从 Gilead 到 Kazeron 再到 Chicomoztoc，所有人，所有人都看得出，握刀的人是 Horacio Caden。

texts.en:
You ask, does Macario embody the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada? He is deceptive, physically cowardly, and avoids the glory of battle and contest of will, instead favoring trickery and lies.

Worse, he appears to believe he is better than-

Caden interrupts you with a snort.

"Why would you attempt to lecture, of all people, ME about the Transcendent Philosophy? You are vermin before the master."

He gestures dismissively. "Cease before I order the oxygen torn from your lungs."
texts.zh:
你问：Macario 可体现了 Philip Andrada 的超凡意识形态？他惯于欺瞒，身体上怯懦，回避战斗的荣光与意志的较量，只爱取巧与说谎。

更糟的是，他似乎自认为比——

Caden 哼了一声，打断你。

"你算什么东西，偏要来给我讲超凡意识形态？在宗师面前，你不过是虫豸。"

他轻蔑地一挥手。"趁我还没下令把你肺里的氧气抽干，闭嘴。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Caden looks off and away at a particular angle, a practiced pose to emphasize what's left of his jawline.

"And I suppose it must fall to me, as usual, the last one who has the will and the power to save the Sindrian Diktat."

He takes a deep breath, then releases it.

"So must it be."
texts.zh:
Caden 侧过脸，朝某个特定角度望去——那是练熟了的姿势，为的是显出他仅剩的那点下颌轮廓。

"那么，照例又该落到我头上——最后一个还有意志、还有力量拯救辛达强权的人。"

他深吸一口气，再缓缓吐出。

"那就只能如此了。"

texts.en:
"Yes." He looks up, eyes bloodshot.

"Yes, there is much to be done. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh:
"是。"他抬起头，双眼布满血丝。

"是，还有很多事要做。荣耀归于辛达强权。"

options.en: Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 荣耀归于辛达强权！

texts.en:
"To the death," he mutters, hair lank.

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"至死方休，"他低声说，头发黏成一绺绺。

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
He scoffs, expression more cruel than pitying.

"A spacer's oath. What's that worth? More than the blood of a clone?"
texts.zh:
他嗤了一声，那神情与其说是怜悯，不如说是残忍。

"一个太空佬的誓言。值几个钱？比一个克隆体的血还值钱？"

texts.en:
"You speak far too familiarly of the Supreme Executor's mind, spacer," Caden says, expression is pitiless.

"None knew him as did I. Certainly some clone, some child brainwashed by Dolos knows nothing, nothing at all."
texts.zh:
"你对最高元首的心思说得也太随便了，太空佬，"Caden 说，神情毫无怜悯。

"没有人像我那样了解他。某个克隆体，某个被 Dolos 洗脑的孩子，当然什么都不知道，什么都不知道。"

texts.en:
He gives you a cold look at that. But it is not dismissive.

"I was to be Supreme Executor," he growls. "Not some clone, some child brainwashed by Dolos."
texts.zh:
听到这话，他冷冷瞥了你一眼。但那目光并非不屑。

"本该由我来当最高元首，\"他低吼道，\"而不是某个克隆体，某个被 Dolos 洗脑的孩子。"

texts.en: "Yes, yes," he waves a hand impatiently. "Of course you did and do. An admirable declaration... for a spacer."
texts.zh: "是，是，\"他不耐烦地摆摆手。\"你当然效忠过，现在也还效忠着。一番值得钦佩的宣言...对一个太空佬来说。"

texts.en: "Of course. This loyalty is unexpected, but admirable... from a spacer." Caden looks pleased with himself, puffing up his chest, setting medals jangling.
texts.zh: "当然。这份忠诚出人意料，不过...对一个太空佬来说，值得钦佩。"Caden 看上去颇为自得，挺起胸膛，勋章叮当作响。

texts.en:
"Tri-Tachyon?" He scoffs. "Fools! Decadent fools, cowards who invent robots to play war. What do robots know of glory?"

He looks far and away, becoming somehow unsatisfied with this line of thought.

Caden turns back to you.

"This is an unexpected loyalty, but admirable... for a spacer. War is not won on an empty stomach eh?" He pats his stomach, setting medals jangling.
texts.zh:
"速子科技？\"他不屑地哼了一声。\"蠢货！堕落的蠢货，一群造机器人来打仗的懦夫。机器人懂什么荣耀？"

他望向远方，不知怎的，越想越不痛快。

Caden 转回来看你。

"这份忠诚出人意料，不过...对一个太空佬来说，值得钦佩。空着肚子可打不赢仗，对吧？"他拍拍自己的肚子，勋章叮当作响。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see a 'loyal' follower of the Supreme Executor's vision."

He smirks at his own cleverness.

"Terrible what Macario's saying you've done. I do suggest you avoid meeting any of our other fleets; there's a kill-on-sight order, you know. It was Macario's idea and he has no authority over me, so I've chosen to treat you with... patience."
texts.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"啊，舰长 $playerName。光荣属于辛达强权！\"他热情地吼道。\"看到有人'忠心'追随最高元首的愿景，真叫人热血沸腾。"

他为自己这份机灵得意地笑了。

"Macario 到处说你干了些什么，那些话真难听。我确实建议你避开我们其余的舰队；有一道见即格杀的命令，你知道的。那是 Macario 的主意，而他无权管我，所以我选择对你...保持耐心。"

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "Dolos tells me such things, such terrible things about what he claims you've done."
texts.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"舰长 $playerName。光荣属于辛达强权！\"他热情地吼道。\"Dolos 跟我说了些事，说了些很可怕的事，都是他声称你干下的。"

texts.en: Macario's informants could be listening. It may be best to begin this conversation through a private channel via the Sindria Relay.
texts.zh: Macario 的线人也许正在监听。这次谈话，最好经由 Sindria Relay 走私人频道开始。

texts.en:
The comms stall on the crest of the Persean League navy.

After several minutes, you pass the link to your comms officer to watch.
texts.zh:
通讯画面停在英仙座联盟海军的徽记上。

几分钟后，你把这条线路交给通讯官盯着。

options.en: Wait
options.zh: 稍等

texts.en:
You review a few reports from your senior officers, supply and fuel levels. A bizarre suggestion from a junior officer to switch to a four shift rotation...

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," you hear your comms officer. "I have Achilles... Achilles Andrada for you."
texts.zh:
你翻了几份高级军官的报告：补给与燃料存量。一名下级军官提出了改用四班轮换制的古怪建议...

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"你听见通讯官的声音，\"Achilles... Achilles Andrada 要找你。"

options.en: Put him through.
options.zh: 接进来。

texts.en: He appears before you, posture rigid, uniform perfectly ordered.
texts.zh: 他出现在你面前，身姿僵直，制服一丝不苟。

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "My time is in great demand."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我的时间很紧。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "I do not welcome your conversation, so make it quick."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我不欢迎这场谈话，所以有话快说。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "You are sworn to my lost brother and we shall soon do battle. What have you to say?"
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"你已向我那迷失的兄弟宣誓效忠，我们很快就要交战。你还有什么话说？"

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says stoically. "Your presence at the announcement of my Supreme Executorship was not unnoticed."

He lowers his head slightly, a slow nod. An acknowledgement that you acted as honorably as the situation allowed, even if you are no friend, much less an ally.
texts.zh:
"$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 淡淡地说，\"你出席我获任最高元首的宣告仪式，我不是没看见。"

他微微低头，缓缓一点。那是承认：在局势允许的范围内，你已尽可能做得体面，尽管你不是朋友，更不是盟友。

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "My time is in great demand."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我的时间很紧。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "I do not welcome your conversation, so make it quick."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我不欢迎这场谈话，所以有话快说。"

options.en: The Persean League has made you weak. Hector is going to crush you.
options.zh: 英仙座联盟把你养软了。Hector 会碾碎你。

options.en: The blood of Andrada runs thin in you. Perhaps your cloning was botched?
options.zh: 你身上 Andrada 的血太稀了。也许当初克隆你的时候出了岔子？

options.en: I've come to pledge my support for your cause. Because Finlay Siyavong told me to.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。因为 Finlay Siyavong 让我来。

options.en: I've come to pledge my support. Because it's what the Persean League wants.
options.zh: 我来表示支持。因为这是英仙座联盟想要的。

options.en: Fortuna Kato is paying me to pledge you my support. So here I am.
options.zh: Fortuna Kato 出钱让我向你效忠。所以我来了。

options.en: I've come to pledge my support for your cause. Because Fortuna Kato asked.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。因为 Fortuna Kato 开口了。

options.en: I have come to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。

options.en: I have come to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。

options.en: I have come to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。

options.en: I have decided to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我已决定对你的事业表示支持。

options.en: I have come to pledge my support to your cause. (lie)
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。 (说谎)

options.en: I agreed to pledge to you, but I cannot truly support your cause.
options.zh: 我答应过向你效忠，但我无法真正支持你的事业。

options.en: I agreed to pledge to you, but I cannot truly support your cause.
options.zh: 我答应过向你效忠，但我无法真正支持你的事业。

options.en: The Prime Demarchon, Reynard Hannan, is conspiring against you.
options.zh: 大统领 Reynard Hannan 正在密谋对付你。

options.en: I've secured support for your cause from a Tri-Tach agent on Achaman Station.
options.zh: 我在 Achaman 站上为你的事业争取到了一名速子科技特工的支持。

options.en: I've secured a line of support for you from a wealthy Tri-Tachyon executive.
options.zh: 我为你在速子科技一位富有的高管那里打通了一条支持渠道。

options.en: Took you long enough to answer your comms.
options.zh: 你接通讯可真够慢的。

options.en: I've come to ask you to make a compromise with the Volturnian Self Defense Covenant.
options.zh: 我来是想请你与 Volturnian 自卫盟约达成妥协。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colony, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colonies, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"I think not," Achilles says, a distinct chill entering his voice. "On both counts."

Achilles reaches for the comms cut off.

"This conversation serves no purpose. Consider it terminated."
texts.zh:
"我看未必，\"Achilles 说，声音里明显添了几分寒意，\"两条都不成立。"

Achilles 伸手去切断通讯。

"这场谈话毫无意义。就当它已经结束了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: The link terminates rather abruptly.
texts.zh: 通讯链接断得相当突兀。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
"That's not how it works, captain," he says.

"Perhaps you've been reading too much into the more esoteric sections of my father's 'transcendent philosophy'. He trained as an admiral, not a cloning technician; to be great at one field does not give mastery of all others."

"He forgot that, in time."

Achilles reaches for the comms cut off.

"I shall not."
texts.zh:
"事情不是这么运作的，舰长，"他说。

"也许你把我父亲那套【超凡意识形态】里过于玄虚的章节读得太多了。他受的是海军上将的训练，不是克隆技师；精通一行，并不等于通晓其余各行。"

"到后来，他把这一点忘了。"

Achilles 伸手去切断通讯。

"我不会忘。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Agent Siyavong." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Siyavong 特工。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎；我不是不知感恩的人。"

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colony, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colonies, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

options.en: The way I see it, if I can be rich, you can be Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 在我看来，只要我能发财，你就能当上最高元首。

options.en: Remember, I'm doing this for the Persean League.
options.zh: 记住，我做这些是为了英仙座联盟。

options.en: I do think you'll be the best for Askonia.
options.zh: 我确实认为，对 Askonia 来说，你才是最好的选择。

options.en: You must not become a client, a puppet, of Fortuna Kato.
options.zh: 你绝不能变成 Fortuna Kato 的门客、她的傀儡。

options.en: I want to ensure Macario is removed. I assume you're agreed?
options.zh: 我要确保 Macario 被除掉。我想你对此没有异议？

options.en: I'm only doing this so I can see Macario dead.
options.zh: 我这么做，只是为了亲眼看到 Macario 死。

options.en: It wasn't cheap.
options.zh: 这可不便宜。

texts.en:
"$TitlePL." Achilles begins to speak, then falters.

It's the first time you've seen him like this. He seems uncomfortable owing anyone such gratitude as would be appropriate.

"I'll assign a liaison officer, and," he pauses again. "I should say... thank you, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
"$TitlePL。"Achilles 开口，又顿住了。

你还是头一次见他这样。看来欠下别人这样一份感激，让他浑身不自在。

"我会派一名联络官，还有——\"他又顿住。\"我该说... 谢谢你，$titlePL。"

texts.en: "I expect you'll want something," he says, flashing a cynical look. "But first we're going to have a war to win."
texts.zh: "我猜你总归是想要点什么，\"他说，眼里闪过一丝讥讽。\"但首先，我们得先打赢一场战争。"

texts.en: "I expect you'll want something," he says, flashing a cynical look. "But first we're going to have a war to win."
texts.zh: "我猜你总归是想要点什么，\"他说，眼里闪过一丝讥讽。\"但首先，我们得先打赢一场战争。"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Have no fear that I misconstrue your ultimate loyalty, captain. I've heard that very sentiment often, and clearly."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"不必担心我会误解你最终的忠诚，舰长。这种话我听得多了，而且听得清清楚楚。"

texts.en: "Now," he says. "There is much to see done."
texts.zh: "现在，\"他说。\"还有许多事等着办。"

texts.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer. "My staff will contact you. An invitation. Will you do this? I ask no oath or pledge, simply your presence at... an important announcement."
texts.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气已换成指挥官那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。你愿意来吗？我不要誓言，也不要承诺，只要你到场——出席... 一场重要的宣告。"

texts.en:
As he draws breath to speak further some kind of alert sounds. With an annoyed look he presses his cuff and holds it to his ear.

"Understood." Achilles' expression hardens.

His eyes turn to you. "Setting this link to standby."
texts.zh:
他吸了口气，正要继续往下说，某种警报响了。他面露恼色，按下袖口，把它凑到耳边。

"明白。"Achilles 的神情沉了下去。

他的目光转向你。"这条链路转入待机。"

options.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
options.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

options.en: What's going on?
options.zh: 怎么回事？

texts.en:
He produces a brief and joyless smirk, then you can see his eyes and his attention shifting elsewhere.

"I have much to do," he says, and reaches for his interface.

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
他扯出一个短促、毫无喜色的笑，随后你眼看着他的目光与注意力转向了别处。

"我还有很多事要办，"他说着，伸手去按他的界面。

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
You cut the comms.

True to his word, an invitation arrives shortly thereafter. A ceremony - unspecified - is to be held on a warship held in a Gens Kato-owned spacedock.

Quite soon.

They must have been waiting, and ready. The Gens Kato strategists allowed Hector to make the first move - and had contingencies prepared for whatever form it took.
texts.zh:
你切断了通讯。

他说到做到，邀请很快就到了。一场仪式——细节未明——将在一艘停泊于 Kato 氏族名下太空船坞的战舰上举行。

就在不久之后。

他们一定早有准备，一直在等。Kato 氏族的谋士们任由 Hector 先动手——并为他可能采取的任何形式都备好了后手。

options.en: Attend the ceremony
options.zh: 出席仪式

options.en: Decline to attend the ceremony
options.zh: 拒绝出席仪式

texts.en:
Some hours later, you (and your bodyguards) step off your shuttle wearing your finest uniforms.

An attendant in Gens Kato livery meets you, reading instructions off a datapad.

"Um, $titlePL $PlayerName? $PlayerSirOrMadam. Yes, you and your, uh, party; if you could please come with me?"
texts.zh:
几个小时后，你 (带着你的保镖) 走下穿梭机，穿着你最体面的制服。

一名穿着 Kato 氏族服饰的侍从迎上来，一边从数据板上读着指示。

"呃，$titlePL $PlayerName？$PlayerSirOrMadam。对，就是你和你的，呃，随行人员；请跟我来好吗？"

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
You follow the attendant to the spacedock, then through a luxuriously spacious access bridge into a large hangar within a warship.

Lines of fighters and munitions ready to be loaded dominate a crowd of officers and crew, marines and technicians. More are streaming in by the minute, led to their positions by flustered attendants.

Most are wearing uniforms - an odd design to your eyes, as if the ghost army of some long-lost battlegroup appeared out of deep space. Looking closer, you see something of the utilitarian League Armada fit done up with tyrian trim on off-white field with gold touches.
texts.zh:
你跟着侍从走向太空港，穿过一条宽敞得近乎奢华的连接廊桥，进入一艘战舰内的大机库。

成排待装的战机与弹药横在眼前，抢尽了一群军官、船员、陆战队员与技师的风头。每一分钟都有更多人涌进来，被手忙脚乱的侍从领到各自的位置。

大多数人穿着制服——在你眼里式样古怪，仿佛某支早已湮没的战斗群的幽灵大军从深空里冒了出来。再细看，你辨认出几分联盟舰队那种实用主义的剪裁，只是配上了泰尔紫的镶边，米白的底子上缀着金色点缀。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You're led to a section of VIPs and their associates - dominated by Gens Kato, but with many notable client gens. Businessfolk of many worlds, glowering mercenaries, and a proud but more humbly dressed group set along the corridors with the best access from softly buzzing camera drones - refugees of Askonia, primarily Opis.

A bold association.

You are feted with drinks and snacks, the attention of VIPs, and the lingering look of more than a few media drones. The chatter grows to a respectable din. Speculation directed toward an empty stage at one end of the hangar.

The lights dim, and the chatter subsides.
texts.zh:
你被领到贵宾及其随从的区域——Kato 氏族的人占了多数，但也有不少显赫的附庸氏族。来自多个世界的商人、面色阴沉的雇佣兵，还有一群神情骄傲却衣着朴素的人，站在位置最好、能让嗡鸣的摄像无人机顺畅取景的廊道边——他们是 Askonia 的难民，多数来自 Opis。

这一手相当大胆。

酒水点心款待着你，贵宾们围着你说话，还有不止一架媒体无人机久久地打量你。交谈声渐渐汇成一片体面的喧响。种种猜测都指向机库尽头那座空着的舞台。

灯光暗下，喧响平息。

options.en: Look to the stage
options.zh: 望向舞台

texts.en:
A lone figure emerges as a shadow into the bright spotlight. Judicious application of muffling fields ensures an awed hush.

Achilles Andrada stands, eyes cast downward, face in shadow for a long moment. You can feel the tension build.
texts.zh:
一个孤身的人影自暗处走入明亮的聚光。消音场开合得恰到好处，压出一片敬畏的静默。

Achilles Andrada 站定，垂着眼睛，面孔在阴影里停留了很久。你能感觉到紧张在积聚。

options.en: Listen
options.zh: 听他说

texts.en:
"My father," he begins. "Was a man who showed many faces. A war hero." The muffling field adjusts to let am uneasy murmur through, then asserts itself to allow the next words. "-And the Hegemony's greatest traitor."

"He was a ruthless man. A genius, and to some, a monster. As great and terrible as a force of nature; the iron hand of history set in motion."

"Above all, he was a visionary."
texts.zh:
"我的父亲，"他开口道，"是个有许多副面孔的人。一位战争英雄。"消音场稍稍放开，让一阵不安的低语透了出来，随即又重新压住，为接下来的话留出空隙。"——也是霸主最大的叛徒。"

"他是个无情的人。一个天才，在某些人眼里则是怪物。如自然之力般伟大而可怖；是历史被启动时的那只铁手。"

"而最重要的，他是个有远见的人。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Achilles stares out at the crowd, his gaze directed at some elevated point. A practiced pose.

"But in time, surrounded by corrupt and immoral advisors, my father's vision grew dim - and the Sindrian Diktat rotted under those who conspired to deceive my aging father. They hid news of his death while plotting a treasonous coup."
texts.zh:
Achilles 望向人群，目光却落在某处高点上。一个练熟了的姿势。

"但时日一久，在腐败无德的顾问包围之下，我父亲的眼光渐渐暗淡——辛达强权在那些合谋欺瞒我年迈父亲的人手里烂掉了。他们隐瞒他的死讯，同时策划一场谋逆政变。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You may know my brother, Hector," a pause for some laughs, some jeers.

Achilles is hard-faced, raising a hand for silence. A dignified rebuke after the set-up for mockery.

"He is a victim." His hand movement quells all objection.

"A puppet controlled by Dolos Macario, my father's disloyal spymaster. You know HIM as the 'Spider of Sindria', and many are the rumors of his degenerate crimes - of torture, kidnapping, and above all treason. Treason against the final will of my father, the Supreme Executor!"
texts.zh:
"你们或许认识我的兄弟，Hector，"他停顿了一下，等着几声笑、几声嘘。

Achilles 板着脸，抬手要众人安静。他先容人起哄，再以不失体面的方式驳回。

"他是个受害者。"他的手势压下了所有异议。

"一个被 Dolos Macario 操控的傀儡——我父亲那个不忠的间谍头子。你们称他【辛达瑞亚之蛛】，关于他那些堕落的罪行，流言众多——酷刑、绑架，而最要紧的是叛国。背叛我父亲、最高元首最终的遗愿！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Achilles looks down for a moment, apparently concerned, projecting vulnerability - for a moment.

"Help me free my brother from that beast," he says quietly.

Then he looks up, eyes piercing in the carefully arranged lighting. Voice growing stronger, deeper.

"Help me free Askonia."
texts.zh:
Achilles 垂下眼，有那么一瞬显得忧虑，流露出一丝脆弱——只是一瞬。

"帮我把我兄弟从那头野兽手里救出来，"他轻声说。

随即他抬起头，目光在精心布置的灯光里锋利逼人。声音渐强，渐沉。

"帮我解放 Askonia。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I shall be the heir to Andrada!"

Achilles uses the voice of command.

"I shall be your Supreme Executor! I ask not for a blind pledge with a gun at your back; I ask only that my loyal citizens of the Sindrian Diktat remember - remember the hope and vision of Philip Andrada when he gave up his life to bring order to chaos. I make that same pledge to you."

"I give my life to bring order from chaos. For you, for Askonia, for the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
"Andrada 的继承人，理应是我！"

Achilles 拿出了发号施令的嗓音。

"我将成为你们的最高元首！我不要你们在枪口抵着后背时盲目效忠；我只求我忠诚的辛达强权公民记住——记住 Philip Andrada 为从混沌中带来秩序而献出生命时的希望与远见。我向你们立下同样的誓言。"

"我献出我的生命，为从混沌中带来秩序。为了你们，为了 Askonia，为了辛达强权！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The lighting shifts subtly, illuminating the hangar. As if on cue, the crowd cheers.

An unfamiliar banner unfurls behind Achilles - he stands alone before it.

Gens Kato's PR was skillfully restrained, crafting the image of a man who looks ready to fight, surrounded by the weapons of war and the warriors who will die using them.
texts.zh:
灯光悄然变换，照亮机库。人群仿佛接到了信号，齐声欢呼。

一面陌生的旗帜在 Achilles 身后展开——他独自立在旗前。

Kato 氏族的公关手腕克制而老练，精心塑造出这样一个形象：一个看上去随时准备开战的人，置身于战争的武器与将要持着这些武器赴死的战士之间。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: It has begun. A war between clone-brothers over the Sindrian Diktat, over who will become the
texts.zh: 开始了。一场克隆兄弟之间争夺辛达强权的战争，争夺谁将成为...
effects: #AddTextSmall "New intel created to track Askonian civil war" highlight

texts.en:
Now, now it is time for Hector to launch his own fleet into orbit of Sindria.

You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power to bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. He can restore your commission; he can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat!
texts.zh:
如今，该让 Hector 把自己的舰队送上 Sindria 轨道了。

你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。他能恢复你的委任；他能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献！

texts.en:
Now it is the time that Hector must launch his own fleet from Sindria to face the usurper, the pretender, Achilles.

You must bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given Macario's kill-on-sight order. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Only Hector can restore your commission. Only Hector can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat and make things as they should be.
texts.zh:
现在，Hector 必须把自己的舰队从 Sindria 派出，去迎战那个篡位者、那个僭位者，Achilles。

你必须把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，又不能被奉了 Macario 格杀令的辛达强权舰队截住。Caden 会让他的舰队按兵不动吗？Hyder 呢？

只有 Hector 能恢复你的委任。只有 Hector 能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献，让一切回到本该有的样子。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
Your bodyguards clear a path through the excited crowd - now given free license to pop the lids off pressurized drink capsules. You suspect the medics will be busy administering remedies come the end of next shift.

You step back onto your shuttle, already receiving updates from Tactical about massive fleet movements in close orbit.
texts.zh:
你的保镖在兴奋的人群中开出一条路——这些人如今获准随意拧开加压饮料罐的盖子。你估计，到下一班结束时，军医们要忙着分发解酒药了。

你回到穿梭机上，战术部门已经在不断发来近轨道大规模舰队调动的通报。

texts.en:
You close the invitation, preferring to keep your association just a little more covert.

It's a clever move, trying to have you attend the ceremony. Without saying a word it would create an image of your full support as a subordinate to Achilles Andrada. It would grant him your legitimacy - or, failing that, at least an appearance of commanding your potency.
texts.zh:
你关掉了邀请，宁可让你与他的关联再隐蔽一些。

这步棋很聪明：让你出席仪式，不必说一个字，就能造出你完全支持 Achilles Andrada、且甘居其下的形象。这会让他借到你的正统性——即便不成，至少也显得他能号令你这份力量。

texts.en:
"I think you're going to want to see this," they say. "Another signal flagged high interest by the content sweep."

A pause, a concerned look.

"Sindrian Diktat priority override codes, but... loc-tag says it's from the Zagan system?"
texts.zh:
"我想你最好看看这个，\"对方说，\"内容筛查又标出一条高关注度信号。"

一阵沉默，一副担忧的神色。

"辛达强权的优先级覆盖码，可是...定位标签显示它来自 Zagan 星系？"

options.en: Put it through.
options.zh: 接进来。

texts.en:
"-was a visionary."

Achilles Andrada stares out at you, his gaze appears directed at an elevated point behind you.

"But in time, surrounded by corrupt and immoral advisors, my father's vision grew dim - and the Sindrian Diktat fell under those who conspired to deceive my aging father. They hid news of his death while plotting a treasonous coup."
texts.zh:
"——是个有远见的人。"

Achilles Andrada 凝视着你，可那目光似乎落在你身后某处较高的点上。

"但时日一久，在腐败无德的顾问包围之下，我父亲的眼光渐渐暗淡——辛达强权落入了那些合谋欺瞒我年迈父亲的人手中。他们隐瞒他的死讯，同时策划一场谋逆政变。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You may know my brother, Hector," a pause for some laughs, some jeers.

Achilles is hard-faced, raising a hand for silence. A dignified rebuke after the set-up for mockery.

"He is a victim." His hand movement quells all objection. "A puppet controlled by Dolos Macario, my father's disloyal spymaster. You know HIM as the 'Spider of Sindria', and many are the rumors of his degenerate crimes - of torture, kidnapping, and above all treason. Treason against the final will of my father, the Supreme Executor!"
texts.zh:
"你们或许认识我的兄弟，Hector，"他停顿了一下，等着几声笑、几声嘘。

Achilles 板着脸，抬手要众人安静。他先容人起哄，再以不失体面的方式驳回。

"他是个受害者。\"他的手势压下了所有异议。\"一个被 Dolos Macario 操控的傀儡——我父亲那个不忠的间谍头子。你们称他【辛达瑞亚之蛛】，关于他那些堕落的罪行，流言众多——酷刑、绑架，而最要紧的是叛国。背叛我父亲、最高元首最终的遗愿！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Achilles looks down for a moment, apparently concerned, projecting vulnerability - for a moment.

"Help me free my brother from that beast," he says quietly.

Then he looks up, eyes piercing through the holo. Voice growing stronger, deeper.

"Help me free Askonia."
texts.zh:
Achilles 垂下眼，有那么一瞬显得忧虑，流露出一丝脆弱——只是一瞬。

"帮我把我兄弟从那头野兽手里救出来，"他轻声说。

随即他抬起头，目光穿透全息影像。声音渐强，渐沉。

"帮我解放 Askonia。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I am the heir to Andrada!"

Achilles uses the voice of command.

"I will be your Supreme Executor! I ask not for a blind pledge with a gun at your back; only that my loyal citizens of the Sindrian Diktat remember - remember the hope and vision of Philip Andrada when he gave up his life to bring order to chaos. I make that same pledge to you."

"I give my life to bring order from chaos. For you, for Askonia, for the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
"我才是 Andrada 的继承人！"

Achilles 拿出了发号施令的嗓音。

"我将成为你们的最高元首！我不要你们在枪口抵着后背时盲目效忠；我只求我忠诚的辛达强权公民记住——记住 Philip Andrada 为从混沌中带来秩序而献出生命时的希望与远见。我向你们立下同样的誓言。"

"我献出我的生命，为从混沌中带来秩序。为了你们，为了 Askonia，为了辛达强权！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The view pulls back - a warship hangar, lines of fighters and munitions ready to load. A crowd of officers and crew, marines and technicians, cheer.

An unfamiliar banner unfurls behind Achilles - he stands alone before it.

Gens Kato's PR was skillfully restrained, crafting the image of a man who looks ready to fight, surrounded by the weapons of war and the warriors who will die using them.
texts.zh:
镜头拉远——战舰机库，成排的战机与待装的弹药。一群军官与船员、陆战队员与技师在欢呼。

一面陌生的旗帜在 Achilles 身后展开——他独自立在旗前。

Kato 氏族的公关手腕克制而老练，精心塑造出这样一个形象：一个看上去随时准备开战的人，置身于战争的武器与将要持着这些武器赴死的战士之间。

texts.en:
Now, now it is time for Hector to launch his own fleet into orbit of Sindria.

You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power to bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. He can restore your commission; he can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat!
texts.zh:
如今，该让 Hector 把自己的舰队送上 Sindria 轨道了。

你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。他能恢复你的委任；他能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献！

texts.en:
Now it is the time that Hector must launch his own fleet from Sindria to face the usurper, the pretender, Achilles.

You must bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given Macario's kill-on-sight order. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Only Hector can restore your commission. Only Hector can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat and make things as they should be.
texts.zh:
现在，Hector 必须把自己的舰队从 Sindria 派出，去迎战那个篡位者、那个僭位者，Achilles。

你必须把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，又不能被奉了 Macario 格杀令的辛达强权舰队截住。Caden 会让他的舰队按兵不动吗？Hyder 呢？

只有 Hector 能恢复你的委任。只有 Hector 能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献，让一切回到本该有的样子。

"So there it is." Rao's got a smile on his face. "The civil war just turned hot. Couldn't ask for better timing, because next comes my favorite part."

He doesn't glance at his datapad this time. "Taking out hostiles."

"来了。\"Rao 脸上挂着笑。\"内战已经打成热战了。这时机再好不过，因为接下来是我最喜欢的环节。"

texts.en:
"I'm jealous, $titleHeg, because you get an opportunity to see some action."

"Get out there and hit as many patrols and convoys as you can. Don't care if they claim to follow the traitor Philip or any one of his clones - they're all targets. And if you can get in and raid key facilities, even better. Anything bearing those purple wings is fair game."
texts.zh:
"我羡慕你，$titleHeg，因为你有机会真刀真枪干一场。"

"出去，能打多少巡逻队和运输队就打多少。别管他们声称效忠叛徒 Philip 还是他哪一个克隆体——全是目标。要是还能钻进去突袭关键设施，那就更好。凡带着那对紫色翼徽的，都可以打。"

"我的军需官会再拨一批燃料和补给，交给你照管。我相信你会让它们用在杀叛军上。"

texts.en:
"My quartermaster will release some fuel and supplies to a storage bay assigned to you, on Ragnar Complex. I trust you'll put what you can in the hands of our Charterist friends - remember, Nortia - and otherwise set to work killing mutineers."

A ping from your TriPad suggests that your own quartermaster has just received the news.

texts.en:
"I'm not releasing more fuel and supplies," he says.

"You've already got the stocks meant for the Charterists and I want them put to work killing mutineers one way or another."

His expression goes hard. "Is that understood?"
texts.zh:
"我不会再拨燃料和补给了，"他说。

"本来要给宪章派的那批库存已经在你手上，我要它们不管走哪条路，都用在杀叛军上。"

他的神情硬了起来。"听明白了吗？"

texts.en:
"Any more rebels, give 'em a little help, but not too much. And if you've got any more connections with unpleasant people, now's the time to call them in. We want to see the Sindrian Diktat fall, $titleHeg."

"Then the Phoenix will do what it does best and rise from the ashes, or whatever line the propaganda department is coming up for this one."

He tosses the datapad onto his desk. "That's it."

"Any questions? No?" He doesn't wait for you to interject. "Good. See you at the victory parade."
texts.zh:
"再碰上别的叛军，就给他们一点帮助，别太多。你要是还认识什么不三不四的人，现在正是把他们叫来的时候。我们要看到辛达强权倒下，$titleHeg。"

"然后凤凰会做它最擅长的事，从灰烬里重生——或者宣传部这回又想出什么说辞。"

他把数据板扔到桌上。"就这些。"

"还有问题吗？没有？\"他没等你插话。\"很好。胜利阅兵见。"

texts.en:
"Does it look like we care?" he growls.

"If I wanted a deranged mercenary with authority issues to steal all the glory, I'd have put the reserve fleet directly under your command. But you might be surprised that opinions both popular and elite among the Core worlds view your type somewhat dimly compared to the 'freedom fighters' from a rich little moon that got blown to gravel by the psychotic arch-traitor."

He raises a single finger.

"And don't mistake this for a conversation. I'm telling you this out of the respect from one warrior to another."

The hand lowers. "Moving on."
texts.zh:
"你看我们像在乎吗？"他低吼道。

"我要真想找一个满脑子不服管、还疯疯癫癫的雇佣兵来抢光所有功劳，早就把预备舰队直接拨到你手下了。可你也许想不到，核心世界的民意和精英，看你们这号人都不怎么顺眼——特别比起那颗富庶小卫星上出来的'自由斗士'。那颗卫星可是被那个疯魔的超级叛徒炸成了一地碎石。"

他竖起一根手指。

"别把这当成商量。我告诉你这些，是出于一个战士对另一个战士的尊重。"

那只手放下了。"继续。"

texts.en:
Horacio Caden appears on the holo.

Sweating, distraught. His eyebrows twitching.

Dolos Macario flanks him, face blank and still. To Caden's right there is space for another. Heavy banners bearing Sindrian Diktat crest and color fall behind them in velvet waves.

Caden is speaking.
texts.zh:
Horacio Caden 出现在全息影像中。

满头大汗，心神大乱。眉毛不住抽动。

Dolos Macario 立在他侧后，面无表情，静止不动。Caden 右手边空着一个位置。缀着辛达强权徽记与色彩的厚重旗帜在他们身后如天鹅绒的波纹般层层垂落。

Caden 正在讲话。

"-to announce that our beloved Supreme Executor," his voice catches for a moment. He proceeds. "Supreme Executor Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria, conqueror of Askonia, philosopher... teacher... died early this morning. He-"

You can almost picture it in your mind.
texts.zh:
"...宣布我们敬爱的最高元首，\"他的声音哽了一下，随即继续，\"最高元首 Philip Andrada，辛达瑞亚之狮，Askonia 的征服者，哲人...导师...已于今日凌晨逝世。他——"

你几乎能在脑中勾出那幅画面。

texts.en:
* * *

The man would have brought a squad of marines, a special unit attached to the Ministry of Internal Security for "wet work".

Loyal. Compromised. And two, perhaps three, senior officers of INTSEC in full uniform. To project authority.

There'd have been signs of violence. Perhaps a streak of blood where a body was pulled away. Inconvenient witnesses or principled objectors, purged.

If they had passed any bond-workers, those would have gaped shamelessly. Their guards would have known to salute.
texts.zh:
* * *

那人会带上一队陆战队——一支隶属于内部安全部、专门干"脏活"的特种小队。

忠诚。各有把柄。还有两三名 INTSEC 高级军官，全套制服在身，用以彰显权威。

现场本该留下暴力的痕迹。也许还有一道拖走尸体时蹭出的血迹。碍事的目击者，或是讲原则的反对者，都被清除了。

要是他们路上遇到什么契约工，那些人准会毫不掩饰地张大嘴看。看守他们的工头自然也懂得敬礼。
