options.en: Of course. I consider us partners in this endeavor.
options.zh: 当然。这件事上，我视我们为伙伴。

options.en: No, you chose your path. I must choose my own.
options.zh: 不。你选了你自己的路。我也得走我自己的。

texts.en:
"In truth, I've had my eyes on the Askonia situation for some time. The history of Opis, of... Andrada. It is at the center of the conflict between League and Hegemony."

He waves a hand, brushing the past away.

"There is a man, a contact, on Nortia. He is an organizer for the Askonia Charterist Alliance. The Hegemony favors his organization."

"So shall I. Give him supplies, fuel, credits - whatever he needs. My people will arrange a meeting."
texts.zh:
"说实话，Askonia 的局势我盯了有些时候了。Opis 的历史，还有...Andrada。这里正是联盟与霸主冲突的中心。"

他摆了摆手，把那些过往挥到一边。

"Nortia 上有个人，我的一个关系人。他是 Askonia 宪章派同盟的组织者。霸主那边是看好他这一伙的。"

"我也一样。给他补给、燃料、星币——他要什么就给什么。我的人会安排一次会面。"

options.en: Nortia. The ACA. Got it.
options.zh: Nortia。ACA。明白了。

options.en: Arnaud Iscare? I've spoken with him already, yes.
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare？我已经和他谈过了，是的。

options.en: Arnaud Iscare? I've already given him everything the ACA required.
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare？ACA 要的东西，我已经全给他了。

texts.en:
Horus sounds more confident somehow, a new sense of purpose driving him as he lays out plans.

"I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron containing everything you need. And credits."
texts.zh:
Horus 的声音不知不觉间多了几分底气；一种新的目标感驱使着他，把计划一条条铺开。

"我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，你要的东西里头都有。还有星币。"

texts.en:
"I ask, also, that you assist the rebels however you might, even those who may be somewhat at cross-purpose with the ACA. Our cause is to correct where the Hegemony went so wrong - the Sindrian Diktat itself must be destroyed, no matter which clone of the arch-mutineer would lead it."

"Andrada made many enemies - most of all the Hegemony - and they will thank us for helping them."
texts.zh:
"另外，我还想请你不论用什么法子，都尽量帮一把那些叛军——哪怕其中有些人和 ACA 的宗旨不尽一致。我们要做的，是纠正霸主当年错得太离谱的地方——辛达强权本身必须被摧毁，不管坐上那位子的是那个老叛徒的哪一具克隆体。"

"Andrada 树敌无数——其中最恨他的就是霸主——我们帮他们一把，他们会感激我们的。"

"Don't forget, $titlePL - speak with Finlay Siyavong. But remember above all that he cannot give you orders, only advice. You need not do as he says."

Horus picks up his TriPad again, and hums approvingly as he flicks through notifications. He looks up.

"I believe that is all?"

"That was you? Stars above... of course." He smiles, a new sense of purpose driving him. "Nonetheless, I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron with fuel and supplies. I expect that you may have other contacts, or means, that might assist... our cause."
texts.zh:
Horus 皱着眉，在数据板上点了几下，然后抬起头。

"那是你做的？群星在上...当然。\"他笑了，一种新的目标感驱使着他。\"不管怎样，我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，里头有燃料和补给。我想你也许还有别的关系，或者别的门路，能帮上...我们这桩事业。"

"You speak with conviction and clarity. I believe... I do believe I shall do as you suggest, $titlePL."

He still looks uneasy, but a sense of confidence in having made a hard decision settles in his expression.
texts.zh:
"您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我想... 我确是打算照您说的办了，$titlePL。"

texts.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall make inquiries with the office of the Prime Demarchon to ascertain Reynard's policies concerning Gens Kato. Common orbit may yet be found."

texts.en:
"You truly believe so?"

He looks strained. "I suppose my Gens has much to gain if Fortuna's plans fail. And to be second is no shameful thing. I must look first to the safety of Gens Yaribay...our future is inexorably bound to Gens Hannan given the present state of affairs."

He pauses, then muses, "There will always be more opportunities, in time..."
texts.zh:
"你真这么认为？"

他面色绷紧。"我想，如果 Fortuna 的计划失败，我的氏族能得的好处不少。屈居第二也并非什么丢人的事。我得首先顾全 Yaribay 氏族的安危...以眼下的局面，我们的前途和 Hannan 氏族已经死死绑在一起了。"

他顿了顿，若有所思："假以时日，机会总是会有的..."

texts.en:
Macario is controlling the comms network. The only way to contact Hector - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Hyder hold her ships back? Would Caden?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
texts.zh:
Macario 控制着通讯网络。要联系 Hector——或任何其他人——唯一的办法是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Hyder 会约束住她的舰船吗？Caden 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

texts.en:
What is Macario's ploy?

Hector has declared himself Supreme Executor, the heir to Andrada. This moment is critical to the future of the Diktat.

But how? Macario is controlling the comms network and seems determined that you play the role of antagonist.
texts.zh:
Macario 在打什么算盘？

Hector 已自立为最高元首，Andrada 的继承人。此刻对强权的未来至关重要。

可该怎么做？Macario 控制着通讯网络，而且似乎打定主意要让你来扮那个反派。

texts.en:
Hector has declared himself Supreme Executor, the heir to Andrada. This moment is critical to the future of the Diktat!

Macario is controlling the comms network and is determined that you play the role of antagonist. No doubt he's seen fit to dispatch a fleet to catch you in the act of 'sabotaging' the system comms relay...
texts.zh:
Hector 已自立为最高元首，Andrada 的继承人。此刻对强权的未来至关重要！

Macario 控制着通讯网络，且打定主意要让你来扮那个反派。他多半还觉得派一支舰队来，正好能当场逮住你在'破坏'星系通讯中继站...

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Was it a mistake to trust Macario?
options.zh: 信任 Macario 是不是一开始就错了？

texts.en: It is increasingly clear that he considers you a loose end that needs to be trimmed.
texts.zh: 越来越清楚的是，他把你当成了一个需要剪掉的尾巴。

options.en: Forget about Macario, then. I must support the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 那就别再管 Macario 了。我必须支持辛达强权！

options.en: I'll make Macario regret his betrayal. Revenge will be mine!
options.zh: 我要让 Macario 为他的背叛后悔。这仇我一定报！

texts.en:
The question remains- Which Sindrian Diktat?

Who will you back as the true heir of Andrada?
texts.zh:
问题仍在——哪一个辛达强权？

你要拥立谁作 Andrada 真正的继承人？

options.en: Hector. Who I shall convince of my loyalty.
options.zh: Hector。我会让他相信我的忠诚。

options.en: Achilles. Who, conveniently, already opposes Macario.
options.zh: Achilles。正好，他本就与 Macario 为敌。

texts.en:
Then you must prove yourself despite the inconvenience of being declared the foremost enemy of the Sindrian Diktat by that treacherous spymaster.

Hector will recognize your loyalty because you will demonstrate it to him by providing material support, securing wavering allies, and pledging yourself directly to his cause - once you have the opportunity to do so...
texts.zh:
那么，尽管那个背信弃义的谍报头子已把你宣布为辛达强权的头号公敌，你仍得证明自己。

Hector 会认可你的忠诚，因为你要以实际支援、稳住摇摆的盟友、直接向他宣誓效忠来向他证明——只等你有机会这么做...

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The only way you are going to be able to contact Hector - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Hyder hold her ships back? Would Caden?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
texts.zh:
你能联系上 Hector——或任何其他人——的唯一办法，就是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Hyder 会约束住她的舰船吗？Caden 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh: 断开中继连接，离开

texts.en: Then you must pledge yourself to Achilles, a trained military leader who is not burdened by being the puppet of a spymaster quite so treacherous as Dolos Macario.
texts.zh: 那么你必须向 Achilles 宣誓效忠——一位受过训练的军事领袖，不必背负做 Dolos Macario 这种背信弃义的谍报头子傀儡的包袱。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh: 断开中继连接，离开

texts.en:
So it's personal.

You will pledge yourself to one goal above all: the destruction of Dolos Macario.

Who are his enemies? Who will turn on him, who will aid you in sabotaging his machinations? Now is the time to call upon their resources.
texts.zh:
这么说，是私怨。

你将立誓只为一个目标：毁掉 Dolos Macario。

谁是他的敌人？谁会倒戈相向，谁会帮你破坏他的算计？现在正是动用他们资源的时候。

options.en:
Continue
#defaultLeave:Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh:
继续
#defaultLeave:断开中继连接，离开

texts.en:
And what of the heirs?

Who will you back as a 'true' heir of Andrada?
texts.zh:
那些继承人呢？

你要拥立谁作 Andrada 的'真正'继承人？

options.en: Hector. Who I shall convince of my loyalty.
options.zh: Hector。我会让他相信我的忠诚。

options.en: Achilles. Who, conveniently, already opposes Macario.
options.zh: Achilles。正好，他本就与 Macario 为敌。

options.en: No one. Let them both burn, and their Sindrian Diktat with them.
options.zh: 谁都不。让他们两个一起烧，连同他们的辛达强权。

texts.en: So be it.
texts.zh: 那就这样吧。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh: 断开中继连接，离开

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Have no fear that I misconstrue your ultimate loyalty, captain. I've already heard that very sentiment often, and clearly."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"不必担心我会误解你最终的忠诚，舰长。这种话我已经听得多了，而且听得清清楚楚。"

texts.en:
"I cannot disagree."

He smiles, though it is a cold smile. "Leadership in Askonia has been rather scarce of late, has it not?"
texts.zh:
"我无法反驳。"

他笑了笑，只是那笑冷得很。"最近 Askonia 的领导人可是相当稀缺，不是吗？"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Trust that I have no intention of becoming that, captain."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"请相信，我没有变成那种人的打算，舰长。"

texts.en:
"Trust that I have no intention of becoming that, captain."

He smiles, a cold smile.

"Strange, though, this behaviour... from a client of Fortuna Kato. Or do you call it a partnership?"
texts.zh:
"请相信，我没有变成那种人的打算，舰长。"

他露出一个冷笑。

"不过真奇怪，这种做派... 竟出自 Fortuna Kato 的一个门客。还是说，你们管这叫合伙？"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"I am entirely untroubled by your motivation, captain. After all it is likely, though not certain, that he was behind the assassination attempt that Fleet Intelligence is content to call 'a bar fight'."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"你的动机我毫不介意，舰长。毕竟那场暗杀——舰队情报部乐意称之为'一场酒吧斗殴'——多半是他主使的，虽然还不能确定。"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"I have no qualms with your motive, captain. After all it is likely, though not certain, that he tried to have me assassinated in what League intelligence is content to call 'a bar fight'. The other possibilities..."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"你的动机我毫无意见，舰长。毕竟他多半——虽然还不能确定——就是想让人暗杀我，而联盟情报部门乐意把这事称作'一场酒吧斗殴'。其余的可能性..."

texts.en:
"You made a wager, captain, and I presume you accept the risk that entails."

He smiles, a cold smile.

"I'll see that you win, however. Though not for the sake of your accounts."
texts.zh:
"你下了注，舰长，我猜你也接受随之而来的风险。"

他露出一个冷笑。

"不过，我会让你赢的。虽然不是为了你的账本。"

texts.en:
"The work of Agent Siyavong, no doubt." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. But your support is welcome, whatever the means by which it was obtained; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"这无疑是 Siyavong 特工的手笔。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。不过，不论你用什么手段换来的，你的支持我都欢迎；我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
"Fortuna. Of course." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome, whatever its motive, and I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna。当然。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。不论你出于什么动机，你的支持我都欢迎，我也并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
"Fortuna. Of course."

Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome, and I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna。当然。"

Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，我不是不知感恩的人。"

texts.en:
Achilles almost smiles, then acknowledges your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 几乎露出笑意，随后以一个点头而非鞠躬，算是领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
Achilles almost smiles, then acknowledges your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 几乎露出笑意，随后以一个点头而非鞠躬，算是领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
Achilles watches you carefully, acknowledging your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 仔细打量着你，以一个点头而非鞠躬，领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected. He doesn't look pleased, however, and understandably.

"I can only assume this is more bedamned Gens politicking," he says. "It has the smell of Reynard Hannan about it."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。不过他看上去并不高兴——这也难怪。

"我只能认为，这又是那些该死的氏族政治，\"他说。\"这味道一闻就是 Reynard Hannan 的手笔。"

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected. He doesn't look pleased, however, and understandably.

"I can only assume this is more bedamned Gens politicking," he says. "It has the smell of Reynard Hannan about it."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。不过他看上去并不高兴——这也难怪。

"我只能认为，这又是那些该死的氏族政治，\"他说。\"这味道一闻就是 Reynard Hannan 的手笔。"

options.en: I tell you this because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

options.en: I tell you this because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

options.en: No, actually I am working with Horus Yaribay.
options.zh: 不，其实我是在和 Horus Yaribay 合作。

texts.en: "I respect your candor, if not your choice of master," he says.
texts.zh: "我敬重你的坦率，虽然不敬重你选的主子，"他说。

texts.en: "A public demonstration of support, even if it is given no true substance, is nonetheless useful."
texts.zh: "公开表态支持，哪怕没有半点实质内容，也依然有用。"

texts.en: "Then I may say with confidence that we share that much," he says, though his voice is not warm.
texts.zh: "那么我可以有把握地说，至少在这一点上我们是一致的，"他说，只是语气并不热络。

texts.en:
Achilles is taken aback.

"Unexpected. I always considered Horus Yaribay to be a tr-" He catches himself.

"An uncertain leader. With unconventional beliefs, given his position."
texts.zh:
Achilles 一怔。

"出乎意料。我一直以为 Horus Yaribay 是个叛——"他及时收住了。

"一个靠不住的领袖。以他的位置而言，信念未免太不合常规。"

options.en: I tell you this because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

options.en: I tell you this because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

texts.en:
"This was anticipated," he says, then gives you an inquisitive look.

"But why are you here, now, telling me this?"
texts.zh:
"这在我预料之中，"他说，随后探询地看了你一眼。

"可你为什么现在跑来，把这件事告诉我？"

options.en: To warn you. I want you to win despite Reynard.
options.zh: 来提醒你。我希望你赢，哪怕 Reynard 插手也一样。

options.en: Because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
options.zh: 因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

options.en: Because it amuses me.
options.zh: 因为我觉得有趣。

options.en: Because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

texts.en: "Good," he says like your position is both obvious and unquestionably correct.
texts.zh: "很好，"他说，那口气仿佛你的立场既显而易见，又无可置疑地正确。

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition." Achilles almost smiles. "Your support is welcome; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。\"Achilles 几乎笑了。\"你的支持我欢迎；我不是不知感恩的人。"

texts.en: "I respect your candor," he says. "And I must ask the question: do I have your support?"
texts.zh: "我敬重你的坦率，\"他说。\"而且我必须问一句：我是否得到了你的支持？"

options.en: Yes.
options.zh: 是的。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 没有。

texts.en:
"Too bad," he says. "As we have nothing more to discuss, I will consider the conversation concluded."

Without another word he reaches over and presses the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"太遗憾了，\"他说。\"既然我们再没有什么可谈的，我就此认为谈话结束。"

他一言不发，伸手按下了通讯切断键。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"It is strange, $playerName, to taunt me to my face after so much effort. It is a waste. And for what?"

He, for one, sounds unamused. His expression clears and is replaced by something stoic, hardened over many cycles.

"You are no use to me. Do not interfere."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"$playerName，费了这么多功夫之后当面嘲弄我，真是奇怪。这是浪费。究竟图什么？"

至少他听起来毫无笑意。他脸上的神情一扫而空，换成了某种坚忍的东西——历经许多星历年磨出来的硬。

"你对我没有用处。别来碍事。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: "Then we have nothing more to talk about," he says conclusively, then reaches over and presses the comms cut-off.
texts.zh: "那我们就没有什么可谈的了，"他以定论的口吻说，随后伸手按下了通讯切断键。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"An understandable position," he says calmly. "Your choice must be your own."

"I must ask the question, $titlePL: do I have your support?"
texts.zh:
"可以理解，\"他平静地说。\"你的选择必须由你自己作。"

"我必须问一句，$titlePL：我是否得到了你的支持？"

options.en: Yes.
options.zh: 是的。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 没有。

texts.en: "Yes, we've had unusually sophisticated materiel coming in. Good Tri-Tachyon tech. Unlocked, it seems, by an insider. The kind of kit that usually comes from lucky convoy-raiding."
texts.zh: "是的，最近进来的物资精密得反常。上好的速子科技货。看来是有内鬼解锁的。这种装备，通常只有运气极好地劫下一支运输队才弄得到。"

texts.en:
"It is useful to diversify sources of material support. I expect you appreciate the implications, captain."

He nods toward you. "I do."
texts.zh:
"物资来源多样化，总是有用的。我想你明白这意味着什么，舰长。"

他朝你点了点头。"我明白。"

texts.en:
He nods, satisfied and even amused.

"It is welcome," he says. "I admit, my staff - yes, I have a staff now - was a little surprised when your partner first made contact."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，颇为满意，甚至有些觉得好笑。

"这很受欢迎，\"他说。\"我承认，我的幕僚——没错，我现在也有幕僚了——在你那位伙伴初次接触时，还有点吃惊。"

texts.en:
"Of course." He doesn't quite smile.

"My logistics team noted that the black market prices were unusually generous. My new shadowy 'benefactor' might make enemies of the usual con-artists if they aren't careful."
texts.zh:
"当然。"他算不上笑了。

"我的后勤组注意到，黑市上的价格优惠得反常。我那位新来的、神出鬼没的'恩主'，要是不小心，恐怕会把那些惯常坑蒙拐骗的家伙都得罪光。"

texts.en:
He blinks, expressionless.

Saying nothing for several moments more. As if to drive the point home that he does not owe you an explanation or even a reaction.

"Captain," he says finally. "You did not come here to whine, I hope."
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，面无表情。

又是好一会儿一言不发。仿佛要把这一点钉实：他不欠你任何解释，甚至连一个反应都不欠。

"舰长，\"他终于开口。\"我希望你不是来这儿诉苦的。"

texts.en:
"Unthinkable," he snaps.

"Those Pather terrorists have been carrying out a campaign of sabotage and assassination to directly undermine my cause. And for what? One would hope that they recognize that I am not my father - or my brother - and am not to fault for the excesses of either."

Achilles takes a deep breath. "I've already shown considerable restraint, captain. Considerable."

His tone makes his feelings about further discussion of the topic quite clear.
texts.zh:
"想都别想，"他厉声道。

"那些左径恐怖分子一直在搞破坏、搞暗杀，就是要直接毁掉我的事业。可这又是图什么？我倒希望他们能明白：我不是我父亲——也不是我兄长——他们两人做过的那些过头事，怪不到我头上。"

Achilles 深吸了一口气。"我已经克制得够多了，舰长。相当多。"

他的语气已经把他的态度说得很清楚：这个话题不必再谈。

texts.en: The comms stall for several minutes on the crest of the Persean League.
texts.zh: 通讯画面在英仙座联盟的徽记上停滞了好几分钟。

options.en: Wait
options.zh: 稍等

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "My time is in great demand."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我的时间很紧。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "I do not welcome your conversation, so make it quick."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我不欢迎这场谈话，所以有话快说。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "You are sworn to my lost brother and we shall soon do battle. What have you to say?"
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"你已向我那迷失的兄弟宣誓效忠，我们很快就要交战。你还有什么话说？"

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says stoically. "Your presence at the announcement of my Supreme Executorship was not unnoticed."

He lowers his head slightly, a slow nod. An acknowledgement that you acted as honorably as the situation allowed, even if you are no friend, much less an ally.
texts.zh:
"$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 淡淡地说，\"你出席我获任最高元首的宣告仪式，我不是没看见。"

他微微低头，缓缓一点。那是承认：在局势允许的范围内，你已尽可能做得体面，尽管你不是朋友，更不是盟友。

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "My time is in great demand."

texts.en: "And more than service, you pledged the support of your colonial organization to my cause." He nods, almost but not quite a bow.
texts.zh: "而且你不只效了力，还把殖民组织的力量押在了我的事业上。"他点了点头，姿态近乎躬身，却又算不上躬身。

texts.en:
"Fine words cost little," he says with an uncommon hint of humor in his voice. "And do little to repay the sacrifice and expenses of my supporters."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
texts.zh:
"漂亮话不值几个钱，\"他说，语气里带着少见的几分幽默，\"也还不清我支持者们的牺牲与花销。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

texts.en:
"Fine words cost little," he says. "And they do little to repay the sacrifice - and expenses - of my supporters. We have great debts to pay due to the devastation, but it is a poor leader who does not see to his followers."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
texts.zh:
"漂亮话不值几个钱，\"他说，\"也还不清我支持者们的牺牲——还有花销。这场浩劫让我们欠下巨额债务，可一个不照应追随者的领袖，算不上好领袖。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

texts.en:
"It was hard fought," he says. "Askonia... will have debts to pay for a long, long time. But it is a poor leader who does not pay the expenses incurred by his followers while supporting his cause."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
texts.zh:
"这一仗打得很苦，\"他说，\"Askonia...要还很久很久的债。可追随者为了支持我的事业而欠下的开销，一个不替他们付账的领袖，算不上好领袖。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

texts.en:
"And I will not use fine words to hide the fact that I cannot reward you with credits."

Achilles takes a breath. He clearly does not enjoy this.

"My Sindrian Diktat is reduced, and deeply in debt. Recovery from the devastation of war is..."

He trails off, looking distant. And very tired.
texts.zh:
"我也不会用漂亮话来掩饰：我没法用星币酬谢你。"

Achilles 吸了口气。他显然并不享受这番话。

"我的辛达强权被削弱了，还背上了一身深债。从战争浩劫中恢复，是..."

他的话音低了下去，目光望向远处。他看上去疲惫至极。

texts.en:
"Good intentions will not transform the ruins and the dead into victory," he says distantly. Then comes back to you, if anything, suddenly self-conscious. "I will not use fine words to hide the fact that I cannot reward you with credits."

Achilles takes a breath. He clearly does not enjoy this.

"My Sindrian Diktat is reduced, and deeply in debt. Recovery from the devastation of war is..."

He trails off, looking distant. And very tired.
texts.zh:
"好意没法把废墟和死者变成胜利，\"他神色遥远地说。随后他回过神来，反倒突然有些局促。\"我也不会用漂亮话来掩饰：我没法用星币酬谢你。"

Achilles 吸了口气。他显然并不享受这番话。

options.zh: 你能摆脱 Kato 氏族的影响，我就放心了。

options.en: I didn't support you for credits. I did it for the blood of Andrada.
options.zh: 我支持你不是为了星币，是为了 Andrada 的血脉。

texts.en: He nods again, expression controlled.
texts.zh: 他又点了点头，神情克制。

texts.en:
"Were that it was so simple. If I was a Persean League Fleet lieutenant, winning would have been enough- job done, now get some R&R."

Achilles looks wistful for just a moment.

"But Askonia calls. I must transform a win into a victory; no small task, even for the 'blood of Andrada'."

By his smirk, you are led to understand that he is making a joke.

"Now I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
texts.zh:
"要是事情真有那么简单就好了。我要是英仙座联盟舰队的一名上尉，打赢就够了——事情完了，回去休整。"

Achilles 有一瞬间神情怅然。

"可 Askonia 在召唤。我得把一场胜仗变成一场胜利；就算对'Andrada 的血脉'来说，这也不是小事。"

看他那副得意的笑，你明白他是在开玩笑。

"现在我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

texts.en:
"Were that 'better' was so simple as your good intentions. If I was a lieutenant back in Fleet, winning would have been enough. Job done, get some R&R."

He looks wistful for just a moment.

"But Askonia calls. I must transform a win into a resounding victory; no small task, even for the 'blood of Andrada'."

By his smirk, you are led to understand that he is making a joke.

"Now I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.

"可 Askonia 在召唤。我得把一场胜仗变成一场响当当的胜利；就算对'Andrada 的血脉'来说，这也不是小事。"

看他那副得意的笑，你明白他是在开玩笑。

"现在我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

texts.en:
You'd swear his eyes glint coldly as he takes a deep, calming breath.

"Matters such as this are never so simple as they appear," he says. "And we shall not be speaking further on the subject at this time."

"Askonia calls. I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.

他深深吸了一口气，让自己平静下来；你几乎敢发誓，那一瞬他的眼里闪过一丝冷光。

"这种事从来不像看上去那么简单，\"他说，\"眼下我们也不会再谈这个话题了。"

"Askonia 在召唤。我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

"Matters such as this are never so simple as they appear," he says. "And we shall not be speaking further on the subject at this time."

texts.en:
He frowns, looking down for a moment. Then back to you.

"I was never given favor for my secret name. Reynard Hannan saw to that. And I will not slacken now like a Gens-heir because of my name."

Achilles wears a hard expression, then continues.

"It is no small thing to be the son of Philip Andrada, but my potential is what I made of it. As for me, as for Askonia."

He takes a deep breath.

"I have much to do, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
他皱起眉，低头看了片刻，然后重新看向你。

"我这个隐秘的姓氏，从来没给我带来过什么优待。Reynard Hannan 把这条路堵死了。我也绝不会因为一个姓氏，就像个氏族继承人那样松懈下来。"

Achilles 面色严峻，接着说道。

"做 Philip Andrada 的儿子不是小事，可我这份潜力，是我自己挣出来的。于我如此，于 Askonia 亦如此。"

他深吸了一口气。

"我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"

"Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says stoically. "Your presence at the announcement of my Supreme Executorship was not unnoticed."

He lowers his head slightly, a slow nod. An acknowledgement that you acted as honorably as the situation allowed, even if you are no friend, much less an ally.

"$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 淡淡地说，\"你出席我获任最高元首的宣告仪式，我不是没看见。"

options.zh: 你接通讯可真够慢的。

options.en: I've come to ask you to make a compromise with the Volturnian Self Defense Covenant.
options.zh: 我来是想请你与 Volturnian 自卫盟约达成妥协。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colony, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colonies, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"I think not," Achilles says, a distinct chill entering his voice. "On both counts."

Achilles reaches for the comms cut off.

"This conversation serves no purpose. Consider it terminated."
texts.zh:
"我看未必，\"Achilles 说，声音里明显添了几分寒意，\"两条都不成立。"

Achilles 伸手去切断通讯。

"这场谈话毫无意义。就当它已经结束了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: The link terminates rather abruptly.
texts.zh: 通讯链接断得相当突兀。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
"That's not how it works, captain," he says.

"Perhaps you've been reading too much into the more esoteric sections of my father's 'transcendent philosophy'. He trained as an admiral, not a cloning technician; to be great at one field does not give mastery of all others."

"He forgot that, in time."

Achilles reaches for the comms cut off.

"I shall not."
texts.zh:
"事情不是这么运作的，舰长，"他说。

"也许你把我父亲那套【超凡意识形态】里过于玄虚的章节读得太多了。他受的是海军上将的训练，不是克隆技师；精通一行，并不等于通晓其余各行。"

"到后来，他把这一点忘了。"

Achilles 伸手去切断通讯。

"我不会忘。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Agent Siyavong." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Siyavong 特工。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎；我不是不知感恩的人。"

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colony, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colonies, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

options.en: The way I see it, if I can be rich, you can be Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 在我看来，只要我能发财，你就能当上最高元首。

options.en: Remember, I'm doing this for the Persean League.
options.zh: 记住，我做这些是为了英仙座联盟。

options.en: I do think you'll be the best for Askonia.
options.zh: 我确实认为，对 Askonia 来说，你才是最好的选择。

options.en: You must not become a client, a puppet, of Fortuna Kato.
options.zh: 你绝不能变成 Fortuna Kato 的门客、她的傀儡。

options.en: I want to ensure Macario is removed. I assume you're agreed?
options.zh: 我要确保 Macario 被除掉。我想你对此没有异议？

options.en: I'm only doing this so I can see Macario dead.
options.zh: 我这么做，只是为了亲眼看到 Macario 死。

options.en: It wasn't cheap.
options.zh: 这可不便宜。

texts.en:
"$TitlePL." Achilles begins to speak, then falters.

It's the first time you've seen him like this. He seems uncomfortable owing anyone such gratitude as would be appropriate.

"I'll assign a liaison officer, and," he pauses again. "I should say... thank you, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
"$TitlePL。"Achilles 开口，又顿住了。

你还是头一次见他这样。看来欠下别人这样一份感激，让他浑身不自在。

"我会派一名联络官，还有——\"他又顿住。\"我该说... 谢谢你，$titlePL。"

texts.en: "I expect you'll want something," he says, flashing a cynical look. "But first we're going to have a war to win."
texts.zh: "我猜你总归是想要点什么，\"他说，眼里闪过一丝讥讽。\"但首先，我们得先打赢一场战争。"

texts.en: "I expect you'll want something," he says, flashing a cynical look. "But first we're going to have a war to win."
texts.zh: "我猜你总归是想要点什么，\"他说，眼里闪过一丝讥讽。\"但首先，我们得先打赢一场战争。"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Have no fear that I misconstrue your ultimate loyalty, captain. I've heard that very sentiment often, and clearly."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"不必担心我会误解你最终的忠诚，舰长。这种话我听得多了，而且听得清清楚楚。"

texts.en: "Now," he says. "There is much to see done."
texts.zh: "现在，\"他说。\"还有许多事等着办。"

texts.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer. "My staff will contact you. An invitation. Will you do this? I ask no oath or pledge, simply your presence at... an important announcement."
texts.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气已换成指挥官那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。你愿意来吗？我不要誓言，也不要承诺，只要你到场——出席... 一场重要的宣告。"

texts.en:
As he draws breath to speak further some kind of alert sounds. With an annoyed look he presses his cuff and holds it to his ear.

"Understood." Achilles' expression hardens.

His eyes turn to you. "Setting this link to standby."
texts.zh:
他吸了口气，正要继续往下说，某种警报响了。他面露恼色，按下袖口，把它凑到耳边。

"明白。"Achilles 的神情沉了下去。

他的目光转向你。"这条链路转入待机。"

options.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
options.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

options.en: What's going on?
options.zh: 怎么回事？

texts.en:
He produces a brief and joyless smirk, then you can see his eyes and his attention shifting elsewhere.

"I have much to do," he says, and reaches for his interface.

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
他扯出一个短促、毫无喜色的笑，随后你眼看着他的目光与注意力转向了别处。

"我还有很多事要办，"他说着，伸手去按他的界面。

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
You cut the comms.

True to his word, an invitation arrives shortly thereafter. A ceremony - unspecified - is to be held on a warship held in a Gens Kato-owned spacedock.

Quite soon.

They must have been waiting, and ready. The Gens Kato strategists allowed Hector to make the first move - and had contingencies prepared for whatever form it took.
texts.zh:
你切断了通讯。

他说到做到，邀请很快就到了。一场仪式——细节未明——将在一艘停泊于 Kato 氏族名下太空船坞的战舰上举行。

就在不久之后。

他们一定早有准备，一直在等。Kato 氏族的谋士们任由 Hector 先动手——并为他可能采取的任何形式都备好了后手。

options.en: Attend the ceremony
options.zh: 出席仪式

options.en: Decline to attend the ceremony
options.zh: 拒绝出席仪式

texts.en:
Some hours later, you (and your bodyguards) step off your shuttle wearing your finest uniforms.

An attendant in Gens Kato livery meets you, reading instructions off a datapad.

"Um, $titlePL $PlayerName? $PlayerSirOrMadam. Yes, you and your, uh, party; if you could please come with me?"
texts.zh:
几个小时后，你 (带着你的保镖) 走下穿梭机，穿着你最体面的制服。

一名穿着 Kato 氏族服饰的侍从迎上来，一边从数据板上读着指示。

"呃，$titlePL $PlayerName？$PlayerSirOrMadam。对，就是你和你的，呃，随行人员；请跟我来好吗？"

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
You follow the attendant to the spacedock, then through a luxuriously spacious access bridge into a large hangar within a warship.

Lines of fighters and munitions ready to be loaded dominate a crowd of officers and crew, marines and technicians. More are streaming in by the minute, led to their positions by flustered attendants.

Most are wearing uniforms - an odd design to your eyes, as if the ghost army of some long-lost battlegroup appeared out of deep space. Looking closer, you see something of the utilitarian League Armada fit done up with tyrian trim on off-white field with gold touches.
texts.zh:
你跟着侍从走向太空港，穿过一条宽敞得近乎奢华的连接廊桥，进入一艘战舰内的大机库。

成排待装的战机与弹药横在眼前，抢尽了一群军官、船员、陆战队员与技师的风头。每一分钟都有更多人涌进来，被手忙脚乱的侍从领到各自的位置。

大多数人穿着制服——在你眼里式样古怪，仿佛某支早已湮没的战斗群的幽灵大军从深空里冒了出来。再细看，你辨认出几分联盟舰队那种实用主义的剪裁，只是配上了泰尔紫的镶边，米白的底子上缀着金色点缀。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You're led to a section of VIPs and their associates - dominated by Gens Kato, but with many notable client gens. Businessfolk of many worlds, glowering mercenaries, and a proud but more humbly dressed group set along the corridors with the best access from softly buzzing camera drones - refugees of Askonia, primarily Opis.

A bold association.

You are feted with drinks and snacks, the attention of VIPs, and the lingering look of more than a few media drones. The chatter grows to a respectable din. Speculation directed toward an empty stage at one end of the hangar.

The lights dim, and the chatter subsides.
texts.zh:
你被领到贵宾及其随从的区域——Kato 氏族的人占了多数，但也有不少显赫的附庸氏族。来自多个世界的商人、面色阴沉的雇佣兵，还有一群神情骄傲却衣着朴素的人，站在位置最好、能让嗡鸣的摄像无人机顺畅取景的廊道边——他们是 Askonia 的难民，多数来自 Opis。

这一手相当大胆。

酒水点心款待着你，贵宾们围着你说话，还有不止一架媒体无人机久久地打量你。交谈声渐渐汇成一片体面的喧响。种种猜测都指向机库尽头那座空着的舞台。

灯光暗下，喧响平息。

options.en: Look to the stage
options.zh: 望向舞台

texts.en:
A lone figure emerges as a shadow into the bright spotlight. Judicious application of muffling fields ensures an awed hush.

Achilles Andrada stands, eyes cast downward, face in shadow for a long moment. You can feel the tension build.
texts.zh:
一个孤身的人影自暗处走入明亮的聚光。消音场开合得恰到好处，压出一片敬畏的静默。

Achilles Andrada 站定，垂着眼睛，面孔在阴影里停留了很久。你能感觉到紧张在积聚。

options.en: Listen
options.zh: 听他说

texts.en:
"My father," he begins. "Was a man who showed many faces. A war hero." The muffling field adjusts to let am uneasy murmur through, then asserts itself to allow the next words. "-And the Hegemony's greatest traitor."

"He was a ruthless man. A genius, and to some, a monster. As great and terrible as a force of nature; the iron hand of history set in motion."

"Above all, he was a visionary."
texts.zh:
"我的父亲，"他开口道，"是个有许多副面孔的人。一位战争英雄。"消音场稍稍放开，让一阵不安的低语透了出来，随即又重新压住，为接下来的话留出空隙。"——也是霸主最大的叛徒。"

"他是个无情的人。一个天才，在某些人眼里则是怪物。如自然之力般伟大而可怖；是历史被启动时的那只铁手。"

"而最重要的，他是个有远见的人。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Achilles stares out at the crowd, his gaze directed at some elevated point. A practiced pose.

"But in time, surrounded by corrupt and immoral advisors, my father's vision grew dim - and the Sindrian Diktat rotted under those who conspired to deceive my aging father. They hid news of his death while plotting a treasonous coup."
texts.zh:
Achilles 望向人群，目光却落在某处高点上。一个练熟了的姿势。

"但时日一久，在腐败无德的顾问包围之下，我父亲的眼光渐渐暗淡——辛达强权在那些合谋欺瞒我年迈父亲的人手里烂掉了。他们隐瞒他的死讯，同时策划一场谋逆政变。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You may know my brother, Hector," a pause for some laughs, some jeers.

Achilles is hard-faced, raising a hand for silence. A dignified rebuke after the set-up for mockery.

"He is a victim." His hand movement quells all objection.

"A puppet controlled by Dolos Macario, my father's disloyal spymaster. You know HIM as the 'Spider of Sindria', and many are the rumors of his degenerate crimes - of torture, kidnapping, and above all treason. Treason against the final will of my father, the Supreme Executor!"
texts.zh:
"你们或许认识我的兄弟，Hector，"他停顿了一下，等着几声笑、几声嘘。

Achilles 板着脸，抬手要众人安静。他先容人起哄，再以不失体面的方式驳回。

"他是个受害者。"他的手势压下了所有异议。

"一个被 Dolos Macario 操控的傀儡——我父亲那个不忠的间谍头子。你们称他【辛达瑞亚之蛛】，关于他那些堕落的罪行，流言众多——酷刑、绑架，而最要紧的是叛国。背叛我父亲、最高元首最终的遗愿！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Achilles looks down for a moment, apparently concerned, projecting vulnerability - for a moment.

"Help me free my brother from that beast," he says quietly.

Then he looks up, eyes piercing in the carefully arranged lighting. Voice growing stronger, deeper.

"Help me free Askonia."
texts.zh:
Achilles 垂下眼，有那么一瞬显得忧虑，流露出一丝脆弱——只是一瞬。

"帮我把我兄弟从那头野兽手里救出来，"他轻声说。

随即他抬起头，目光在精心布置的灯光里锋利逼人。声音渐强，渐沉。

"帮我解放 Askonia。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I shall be the heir to Andrada!"

Achilles uses the voice of command.

"I shall be your Supreme Executor! I ask not for a blind pledge with a gun at your back; I ask only that my loyal citizens of the Sindrian Diktat remember - remember the hope and vision of Philip Andrada when he gave up his life to bring order to chaos. I make that same pledge to you."

"I give my life to bring order from chaos. For you, for Askonia, for the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
"Andrada 的继承人，理应是我！"

Achilles 拿出了发号施令的嗓音。

"我将成为你们的最高元首！我不要你们在枪口抵着后背时盲目效忠；我只求我忠诚的辛达强权公民记住——记住 Philip Andrada 为从混沌中带来秩序而献出生命时的希望与远见。我向你们立下同样的誓言。"

"我献出我的生命，为从混沌中带来秩序。为了你们，为了 Askonia，为了辛达强权！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The lighting shifts subtly, illuminating the hangar. As if on cue, the crowd cheers.

An unfamiliar banner unfurls behind Achilles - he stands alone before it.

Gens Kato's PR was skillfully restrained, crafting the image of a man who looks ready to fight, surrounded by the weapons of war and the warriors who will die using them.
texts.zh:
灯光悄然变换，照亮机库。人群仿佛接到了信号，齐声欢呼。

一面陌生的旗帜在 Achilles 身后展开——他独自立在旗前。

Kato 氏族的公关手腕克制而老练，精心塑造出这样一个形象：一个看上去随时准备开战的人，置身于战争的武器与将要持着这些武器赴死的战士之间。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: It has begun. A war between clone-brothers over the Sindrian Diktat, over who will become the
texts.zh: 开始了。一场克隆兄弟之间争夺辛达强权的战争，争夺谁将成为...
effects: #AddTextSmall "New intel created to track Askonian civil war" highlight

texts.en:
Now, now it is time for Hector to launch his own fleet into orbit of Sindria.

You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power to bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. He can restore your commission; he can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat!
texts.zh:
如今，该让 Hector 把自己的舰队送上 Sindria 轨道了。

你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。他能恢复你的委任；他能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献！

texts.en:
Now it is the time that Hector must launch his own fleet from Sindria to face the usurper, the pretender, Achilles.

You must bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given Macario's kill-on-sight order. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Only Hector can restore your commission. Only Hector can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat and make things as they should be.
texts.zh:
现在，Hector 必须把自己的舰队从 Sindria 派出，去迎战那个篡位者、那个僭位者，Achilles。

你必须把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，又不能被奉了 Macario 格杀令的辛达强权舰队截住。Caden 会让他的舰队按兵不动吗？Hyder 呢？

只有 Hector 能恢复你的委任。只有 Hector 能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献，让一切回到本该有的样子。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
Your bodyguards clear a path through the excited crowd - now given free license to pop the lids off pressurized drink capsules. You suspect the medics will be busy administering remedies come the end of next shift.

You step back onto your shuttle, already receiving updates from Tactical about massive fleet movements in close orbit.
texts.zh:
你的保镖在兴奋的人群中开出一条路——这些人如今获准随意拧开加压饮料罐的盖子。你估计，到下一班结束时，军医们要忙着分发解酒药了。

你回到穿梭机上，战术部门已经在不断发来近轨道大规模舰队调动的通报。

texts.en:
You close the invitation, preferring to keep your association just a little more covert.

It's a clever move, trying to have you attend the ceremony. Without saying a word it would create an image of your full support as a subordinate to Achilles Andrada. It would grant him your legitimacy - or, failing that, at least an appearance of commanding your potency.
texts.zh:
你关掉了邀请，宁可让你与他的关联再隐蔽一些。

这步棋很聪明：让你出席仪式，不必说一个字，就能造出你完全支持 Achilles Andrada、且甘居其下的形象。这会让他借到你的正统性——即便不成，至少也显得他能号令你这份力量。

texts.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam." It's your comms officer.
texts.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。"是你的通讯官。

options.en: What is it?
options.zh: 什么事？

texts.en:
"I think you're going to want to see this," they say. "Another signal flagged high interest by the content sweep."

A pause, a concerned look.

"Sindrian Diktat priority override codes, but... loc-tag says it's from the Zagan system?"
texts.zh:
"我想你最好看看这个，\"对方说，\"内容筛查又标出一条高关注度信号。"

一阵沉默，一副担忧的神色。

"辛达强权的优先级覆盖码，可是...定位标签显示它来自 Zagan 星系？"

options.en: Put it through.
options.zh: 接进来。

texts.en:
"-was a visionary."

Achilles Andrada stares out at you, his gaze appears directed at an elevated point behind you.

"But in time, surrounded by corrupt and immoral advisors, my father's vision grew dim - and the Sindrian Diktat fell under those who conspired to deceive my aging father. They hid news of his death while plotting a treasonous coup."
texts.zh:
"——是个有远见的人。"

Achilles Andrada 凝视着你，可那目光似乎落在你身后某处较高的点上。

"但时日一久，在腐败无德的顾问包围之下，我父亲的眼光渐渐暗淡——辛达强权落入了那些合谋欺瞒我年迈父亲的人手中。他们隐瞒他的死讯，同时策划一场谋逆政变。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You may know my brother, Hector," a pause for some laughs, some jeers.

Achilles is hard-faced, raising a hand for silence. A dignified rebuke after the set-up for mockery.

"He is a victim." His hand movement quells all objection. "A puppet controlled by Dolos Macario, my father's disloyal spymaster. You know HIM as the 'Spider of Sindria', and many are the rumors of his degenerate crimes - of torture, kidnapping, and above all treason. Treason against the final will of my father, the Supreme Executor!"
texts.zh:
"你们或许认识我的兄弟，Hector，"他停顿了一下，等着几声笑、几声嘘。

Achilles 板着脸，抬手要众人安静。他先容人起哄，再以不失体面的方式驳回。

"他是个受害者。\"他的手势压下了所有异议。\"一个被 Dolos Macario 操控的傀儡——我父亲那个不忠的间谍头子。你们称他【辛达瑞亚之蛛】，关于他那些堕落的罪行，流言众多——酷刑、绑架，而最要紧的是叛国。背叛我父亲、最高元首最终的遗愿！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Achilles looks down for a moment, apparently concerned, projecting vulnerability - for a moment.

"Help me free my brother from that beast," he says quietly.

Then he looks up, eyes piercing through the holo. Voice growing stronger, deeper.

"Help me free Askonia."
texts.zh:
Achilles 垂下眼，有那么一瞬显得忧虑，流露出一丝脆弱——只是一瞬。

"帮我把我兄弟从那头野兽手里救出来，"他轻声说。

随即他抬起头，目光穿透全息影像。声音渐强，渐沉。

"帮我解放 Askonia。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I am the heir to Andrada!"

Achilles uses the voice of command.

"I will be your Supreme Executor! I ask not for a blind pledge with a gun at your back; only that my loyal citizens of the Sindrian Diktat remember - remember the hope and vision of Philip Andrada when he gave up his life to bring order to chaos. I make that same pledge to you."

"I give my life to bring order from chaos. For you, for Askonia, for the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
"我才是 Andrada 的继承人！"

Achilles 拿出了发号施令的嗓音。

"我将成为你们的最高元首！我不要你们在枪口抵着后背时盲目效忠；我只求我忠诚的辛达强权公民记住——记住 Philip Andrada 为从混沌中带来秩序而献出生命时的希望与远见。我向你们立下同样的誓言。"

"我献出我的生命，为从混沌中带来秩序。为了你们，为了 Askonia，为了辛达强权！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The view pulls back - a warship hangar, lines of fighters and munitions ready to load. A crowd of officers and crew, marines and technicians, cheer.

An unfamiliar banner unfurls behind Achilles - he stands alone before it.

Gens Kato's PR was skillfully restrained, crafting the image of a man who looks ready to fight, surrounded by the weapons of war and the warriors who will die using them.
texts.zh:
镜头拉远——战舰机库，成排的战机与待装的弹药。一群军官与船员、陆战队员与技师在欢呼。

一面陌生的旗帜在 Achilles 身后展开——他独自立在旗前。

Kato 氏族的公关手腕克制而老练，精心塑造出这样一个形象：一个看上去随时准备开战的人，置身于战争的武器与将要持着这些武器赴死的战士之间。

texts.en:
Now, now it is time for Hector to launch his own fleet into orbit of Sindria.

You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power to bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. He can restore your commission; he can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat!
texts.zh:
如今，该让 Hector 把自己的舰队送上 Sindria 轨道了。

你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。他能恢复你的委任；他能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献！

texts.en:
Now it is the time that Hector must launch his own fleet from Sindria to face the usurper, the pretender, Achilles.

You must bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given Macario's kill-on-sight order. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Only Hector can restore your commission. Only Hector can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat and make things as they should be.
texts.zh:
现在，Hector 必须把自己的舰队从 Sindria 派出，去迎战那个篡位者、那个僭位者，Achilles。

你必须把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，又不能被奉了 Macario 格杀令的辛达强权舰队截住。Caden 会让他的舰队按兵不动吗？Hyder 呢？

只有 Hector 能恢复你的委任。只有 Hector 能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献，让一切回到本该有的样子。

"I'm jealous, $titleHeg, because you get an opportunity to see some action."

"Get out there and hit as many patrols and convoys as you can. Don't care if they claim to follow the traitor Philip or any one of his clones - they're all targets. And if you can get in and raid key facilities, even better. Anything bearing those purple wings is fair game."
texts.zh:
"我羡慕你，$titleHeg，因为你有机会真刀真枪干一场。"

"出去，能打多少巡逻队和运输队就打多少。别管他们声称效忠叛徒 Philip 还是他哪一个克隆体——全是目标。要是还能钻进去突袭关键设施，那就更好。凡带着那对紫色翼徽的，都可以打。"

A ping from your TriPad suggests that your own quartermaster has just received the news.

texts.en:
"I'm not releasing more fuel and supplies," he says.

"You've already got the stocks meant for the Charterists and I want them put to work killing mutineers one way or another."

His expression goes hard. "Is that understood?"
texts.zh:
"我不会再拨燃料和补给了，"他说。

"本来要给宪章派的那批库存已经在你手上，我要它们不管走哪条路，都用在杀叛军上。"

他的神情硬了起来。"听明白了吗？"

texts.en:
"Any more rebels, give 'em a little help, but not too much. And if you've got any more connections with unpleasant people, now's the time to call them in. We want to see the Sindrian Diktat fall, $titleHeg."

"Then the Phoenix will do what it does best and rise from the ashes, or whatever line the propaganda department is coming up for this one."

He tosses the datapad onto his desk. "That's it."

"Any questions? No?" He doesn't wait for you to interject. "Good. See you at the victory parade."
texts.zh:
"再碰上别的叛军，就给他们一点帮助，别太多。你要是还认识什么不三不四的人，现在正是把他们叫来的时候。我们要看到辛达强权倒下，$titleHeg。"

"然后凤凰会做它最擅长的事，从灰烬里重生——或者宣传部这回又想出什么说辞。"

他把数据板扔到桌上。"就这些。"

"还有问题吗？没有？\"他没等你插话。\"很好。胜利阅兵见。"

texts.en:
"Does it look like we care?" he growls.

"If I wanted a deranged mercenary with authority issues to steal all the glory, I'd have put the reserve fleet directly under your command. But you might be surprised that opinions both popular and elite among the Core worlds view your type somewhat dimly compared to the 'freedom fighters' from a rich little moon that got blown to gravel by the psychotic arch-traitor."

He raises a single finger.

"And don't mistake this for a conversation. I'm telling you this out of the respect from one warrior to another."

The hand lowers. "Moving on."
texts.zh:
"你看我们像在乎吗？"他低吼道。

"我要真想找一个满脑子不服管、还疯疯癫癫的雇佣兵来抢光所有功劳，早就把预备舰队直接拨到你手下了。可你也许想不到，核心世界的民意和精英，看你们这号人都不怎么顺眼——特别比起那颗富庶小卫星上出来的'自由斗士'。那颗卫星可是被那个疯魔的超级叛徒炸成了一地碎石。"

他竖起一根手指。

"别把这当成商量。我告诉你这些，是出于一个战士对另一个战士的尊重。"

那只手放下了。"继续。"

texts.en:
Horacio Caden appears on the holo.

Sweating, distraught. His eyebrows twitching.

Dolos Macario flanks him, face blank and still. To Caden's right there is space for another. Heavy banners bearing Sindrian Diktat crest and color fall behind them in velvet waves.

Caden is speaking.
texts.zh:
Horacio Caden 出现在全息影像中。

满头大汗，心神大乱。眉毛不住抽动。

Dolos Macario 立在他侧后，面无表情，静止不动。Caden 右手边空着一个位置。缀着辛达强权徽记与色彩的厚重旗帜在他们身后如天鹅绒的波纹般层层垂落。

Caden 正在讲话。

options.en: Listen

texts.en:
"-to announce that our beloved Supreme Executor," his voice catches for a moment. He proceeds. "Supreme Executor Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria, conqueror of Askonia, philosopher... teacher... died early this morning. He-"

You can almost picture it in your mind.
texts.zh:
"...宣布我们敬爱的最高元首，\"他的声音哽了一下，随即继续，\"最高元首 Philip Andrada，辛达瑞亚之狮，Askonia 的征服者，哲人...导师...已于今日凌晨逝世。他——"

你几乎能在脑中勾出那幅画面。

texts.en:
* * *

The man would have brought a squad of marines, a special unit attached to the Ministry of Internal Security for "wet work".

Loyal. Compromised. And two, perhaps three, senior officers of INTSEC in full uniform. To project authority.

There'd have been signs of violence. Perhaps a streak of blood where a body was pulled away. Inconvenient witnesses or principled objectors, purged.

If they had passed any bond-workers, those would have gaped shamelessly. Their guards would have known to salute.
texts.zh:
* * *

那人会带上一队陆战队——一支隶属于内部安全部、专门干"脏活"的特种小队。

忠诚。各有把柄。还有两三名 INTSEC 高级军官，全套制服在身，用以彰显权威。

现场本该留下暴力的痕迹。也许还有一道拖走尸体时蹭出的血迹。碍事的目击者，或是讲原则的反对者，都被清除了。

要是他们路上遇到什么契约工，那些人准会毫不掩饰地张大嘴看。看守他们的工头自然也懂得敬礼。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The lead officer would have halted at a biometric scanner, taking a moment to input unlock authorization. The armored doors would have opened, the movement of their enormous mass like the weight of a passing age.

That officer's white hair and long black coat gave him a priestly silhouette.

The party proceeded into a bunker deep, deep within Sindria.
texts.zh:
领头的军官会在生物识别扫描仪前停下，花片刻输入解锁授权。装甲大门随之开启，那巨大门扇的移动，沉重得仿佛一个正在逝去的时代从身边碾过。

那名军官白发、黑色长外套，勾勒出一副祭司般的剪影。

一行人向 Sindria 深处、极深处的掩体行去。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Beyond tiers of heavy blast doors lay a luxurious receiving room. A handful of offices and a suite - grand, yet hunkered somehow under the weight of armor and miles of rock.

The party entered an antiseptic inner chamber.

A giant coffin-like vessel lay flat. An off-white sarcophagus of ceramic and intricate technology, a golden winged crest. Within lay a corpse-like figure, its body invaded by bundles of tubing and wires leading to ranks of medical machines attending their master like boxy, robotic courtiers.

A wretched echo of Leonidas' cradle in far-off Irkalla.
texts.zh:
层层厚重的防爆门之后，是一间奢华的会客厅。几间办公室和一套居所——气派非凡，却又像是被装甲与数英里岩层的重量压得伏低了身子。

一行人走进一间洁净得近乎无菌的内室。

一具巨大的棺状容器平放着。那是陶瓷与精密技术打造的灰白色石棺，镶着一枚金色翼形纹章。棺内躺着一个形如尸体的身影，躯体被成束的管线侵入，管线连向一排排医疗机器——那些方头方脑的机器如同机械廷臣，侍奉着自己的主人。

遥远 Irkalla 那具 Leonidas 的摇篮，在此处落下一个凄凉的余响。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The neurological monitors would have shown 100% brain death, and must have for a long time.

Nanoscale filaments inserted into the brainstem compel a facsimile of life from the decaying nervous system.

A hand gloved in black reached toward the master switch. When it closed upon the power to end life, it did not hesitate.

The white noise died to half its former volume. Just ventilation and the creak of black armor as the INTSEC marines shifted their weight, unsure of protocol.
texts.zh:
神经监测仪上显示的该是百分之百的脑死亡，而且必定已持续很久。

插入脑干的纳米级细丝，强迫那具衰败的神经系统挤出一丝生命的假象。

一只戴着黑手套的手伸向总控开关。当它握住那终结生命的权力时，没有半分迟疑。

白噪音的音量降到原先的一半。只剩通风的声响，以及 INTSEC 陆战队员挪动重心时黑色装甲的吱嘎声——他们拿不准该按什么规矩行事。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The body of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat, Lion of Sindria, must have finally died under remorseless eyes.

* * *

Caden's next words were forgettable. He's unsteady and red-faced. In his drink, no doubt.

"My father," Hector has taken the podium; young, powerful, and confident, "was a great man."

His expression is brash. As he speaks, he sends challenging looks to each side, staring down imagined rivals.
texts.zh:
辛达强权最高元首、辛达瑞亚之狮 Philip Andrada 的躯体，想必终于在那双毫无怜悯的眼睛下死去了。

* * *

Caden 接下来的话没什么值得记的。他站得不稳，满脸通红。多半是喝多了。

"我的父亲，\"Hector 已走上讲台；年轻、强壮、自信，\"是一位伟人。"

他神情张扬。说话时，他朝两侧各投去挑衅的目光，像是在逼视想象出来的对手。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Caden is staring at his feet. Nothing is as he hoped.

Macario is the very image of poise.

"As Supreme Executor, the last of Philip's blood, pledge yourself to me! Pledge yourself as I pledge to carry on His traditions; His people, His work, His philosophy, His grand project - the Sindrian Diktat!"

Cheers erupt, pounding of fists and feet.

The display switches to a long shot - rank upon rank of officers, soldiers, navy, citizens; new subjects of the new age hail their Supreme Executor.
texts.zh:
Caden 盯着自己的脚。一切都不如他所愿。

Macario 则是镇定的化身。

"身为最高元首、Philip 最后的血脉，向我宣誓效忠！向我宣誓，正如我宣誓继承他的传统、他的人民、他的事业、他的理念、他的宏图——辛达强权！"

欢呼声爆发，拳与脚砰砰地砸着。

画面切到远景——一列列军官、士兵、海军、市民；新时代的新子民在向他们的最高元首致敬。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
They chant three syllables with the voice of one. AN-DRA-DA. Again and again and again.

Hector Andrada, Supreme Executor, raises his arms - illuminated in a pillar of light, he is as an avatar of the gods brought to Sindria.

You flick a control surface and the image dies away.
texts.zh:
他们齐声高呼三个音节。AN-DRA-DA。一遍，又一遍，再一遍。

最高元首 Hector Andrada 举起双臂——他沐浴在一道光柱之中，宛如被迎至 Sindria 的神明化身。

你拨了一下控制面板，影像熄灭了。

texts.en:
They chant three syllables with the voice of one. AN-DRA-DA. Again and again and again.

Hector Andrada, Supreme Executor, raises his arms - illuminated in a pillar of light, he is as an avatar of the gods brought to Sindria.

You catch your breath, returning to the moment, and press a control surface.

The image slowly fades away.
texts.zh:
他们齐声高呼三个音节。AN-DRA-DA。一遍，又一遍，再一遍。

最高元首 Hector Andrada 举起双臂——他沐浴在一道光柱之中，宛如被迎至 Sindria 的神明化身。

你缓过一口气，回到当下，按下一块控制面板。

影像缓缓淡去。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: He's consolidating power. You must be ready.
texts.zh: 他在收拢权力。你必须做好准备。

texts.en: The link with Horus Yaribay re-opens. He looks pale.
texts.zh: 与 Horus Yaribay 的通讯重新接通。他脸色苍白。

texts.en: A small icon slowly pulses. The link with Hyder.
texts.zh: 一个小图标缓缓跳动。是与 Hyder 的通讯。

texts.en: A small icon slowly pulses. The link with Achilles Andrada.
texts.zh: 一个小图标缓缓跳动。是与 Achilles Andrada 的通讯。

texts.en: You take a deep breath, then open your eyes.
texts.zh: 你深吸一口气，然后睁开眼。

texts.en:
It is highly likely that this is going to become a dangerous place to be found meddling with Diktat infrastructure, and soon.

The civil war must begin when Achilles declares his claim.

Which he must, and soon.
texts.zh:
此地十有八九很快就会变成一个危险的地方：一旦被人发现你在动强权的基础设施。

内战必定会随着 Achilles 宣布继承权而开始。

而他必定会，而且很快。

texts.en:
Macario is controlling the comms network. The only way to contact Caden - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
texts.zh:
Macario 控制着通讯网络。要联系 Caden——或任何其他人——唯一的办法是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Caden 会约束住他的舰船吗？Hyder 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

texts.en: You need to go to Yesod and contact Achilles, as Fortuna Kato requested.
texts.zh: 按 Fortuna Kato 的请求，你需要前往 Yesod，与 Achilles 取得联系。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

options.en: Re-open the comms with Hyder
options.zh: 重新接通与 Hyder 的通讯

options.en: Re-open the comms with Achilles
options.zh: 重新接通与 Achilles 的通讯

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh: 断开中继连接，离开

texts.en:
The image of Hyder reforms.

She looks as if her bridge's agrav has been tuned too high.
texts.zh:
Hyder 的影像重新成形。

她看上去，像是舰桥的人工重力被调得太高了。

texts.en: "It's happening," she says distantly.
texts.zh: "开始了，"她声音飘忽地说。

texts.en: "He was just like-" Hyder shakes her head. "The files. The truth is undeniable."
texts.zh: "他简直就像——\"Hyder 摇摇头。\"那些文件。真相无可辩驳。"

texts.en: "So now a 'son' of Andrada appears. With Macario's enthusiastic backing." A sniff, then, "Caden's evidently less so."
texts.zh: "于是，Andrada 的一个'儿子'登场了。带着 Macario 满腔热情的支持。\"她哼了一声，\"Caden 显然就没那么热情了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: I recovered files on the seven sons of Philip Andrada... (explain)
options.zh: 我找回了关于 Philip Andrada 七个儿子的文件... (解释)

options.en:
Have you considered what you're going to do now? Time is short.
#sdse_andradaDeathHyderOut:"I've... got to go. Good luck with Hector."
options.zh:
你想过接下来要怎么做吗？时间不多了。
#sdse_andradaDeathHyderOut:"我...得走了。祝你在 Hector 那儿顺利。"

texts.en:
"I can deploy a fleet to battle, balance my sabotaged logistics." It seems like she's speaking to herself. "This..."

Hyder trails off. Eyes searching. Like she can't bring herself to ask.

The next step.
texts.zh:
"我可以派一支舰队去作战，可以平衡被人动了手脚的后勤。\"听上去她像是在自言自语。\"可这个..."

Hyder 话音渐止。目光四下搜寻。像是怎么也开不了口问出来。

下一步。

texts.en: There's a growing skepticism, a reticence in her voice. You're losing her trust.
texts.zh: 她语气里的怀疑越来越重，还带着几分保留。你正在失去她的信任。

texts.en: There's a growing skepticism, a reticence in her voice. You're losing her trust.
texts.zh: 她语气里的怀疑越来越重，还带着几分保留。你正在失去她的信任。

options.en: Let me be candid - Orcus Rao sent me to discover your intentions.
options.zh: 我就直说了——Orcus Rao 派我来探你的意图。

options.en: Another clone, heir, then. One could be a man of character and ability.
options.zh: 那就换个克隆体，换个继承人。总该有一个是有品性、有本事的。

options.en: Maybe a schemer. A spymaster, a sneak, a rogue. Everything you're not.
options.zh: 也许要个阴谋家。一个间谍头子、一个暗探、一个无赖。所有你不是的东西。

options.en: I suspect Macario plans to eliminate you. You've got to be ready.
options.zh: 我怀疑 Macario 打算除掉你。你得做好准备。

options.en: This is your chance! If you seize the initiative, you could become Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 这是你的机会！只要抓住先机，你就能成为最高元首。

options.en: Turn yourself over to the Hegemony. I'll get Orcus Rao's assurance of a fair trial. Maybe a deal.
options.zh: 向霸主自首。我会拿到 Orcus Rao 的保证，给你一场公正的审判。也许还能谈个交易。

options.en: Turn yourself in to the Hegemony. You'll get a fair trial, or a deal from... from Orcus Rao.
options.zh: 向霸主自首。你会得到公正的审判，或者...或者从 Orcus Rao 那里得到一个交易。

options.en: There is a rightful heir you could back - Achilles Andrada. (explain)
options.zh: 有一位名正言顺的继承人值得你支持——Achilles Andrada。 (解释)

options.en: You should back Achilles Andrada. He is the better man.
options.zh: 你应该支持 Achilles Andrada。他才是更合适的人。

options.en: There is a rightful heir you could back - Hector Andrada. (explain)
options.zh: 有一位名正言顺的继承人值得你支持——Hector Andrada。 (解释)

options.en: You must stand by Hector Andrada. He is the rightful heir.
options.zh: 你必须站在 Hector Andrada 这边。他才是名正言顺的继承人。

options.en: Duty and honor above all. Stand by your oath to the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 责任与荣誉高于一切。守住你对辛达强权的誓言！

options.en: I'm not here to tell you what to do. Just a warning about what is to come.
options.zh: 我不是来教你怎么做的。只是提醒你，接下来要发生什么。

texts.en:
"Rao."

There's a change in her voice.

"He hates me, you know," she says. "He hates us all. You cannot understand unless you were there."
texts.zh:
"Rao。"

她的声音变了。

"他恨我，你知道的，\"她说。\"他恨我们所有人。除非你当时在场，否则你不会明白。"

options.en: Maybe. But his loyalty to the Hegemony is greater than his hatred for you.
options.zh: 也许。但他对霸主的忠诚，胜过对你的恨意。

options.en: It doesn't matter what he thinks. It matters what you are going to do.
options.zh: 他怎么想无关紧要。重要的是你打算怎么做。

texts.en:
She looks into the feed.

"And what good does that do me?"
texts.zh:
她望向通讯画面。

"那对我有什么好处？"

texts.en:
"Yes." She looks directly into the feed.

Uncertain. And working hard not to show it.
texts.zh:
"是。"她直直望向通讯画面。

心里没底。而且正竭力不露出来。

texts.en: "Who did you have in mind?" She looks skeptical.
texts.zh: "你心里想的是谁？"她神情怀疑。

options.en: Hercules. A historian. Young, but... he's smart, and stable.
options.zh: Hercules。一个历史学者。年轻，可是...他聪明，也稳重。

options.en: I'm, uh, not sure. It was just a thought.
options.zh: 我，呃，还没想好。只是随口一提。

texts.en:
"A historian?"

Hyder doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh:
"历史学者？"

Hyder 一脸不以为然。

texts.en:
"An academician."

Hyder doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh:
"一位院士？"

Hyder 一脸不以为然。

texts.en: "How many capital ships does he have?"
texts.zh: "他手上有多少主力舰？"

options.en: Well... zero. So far.
options.zh: 这个...零。到目前为止。

texts.en:
Her expression doesn't visibly change, but somehow Hyder looks even less impressed now than she did before.

She closes her eyes and rubs the bridge of her nose, as if warding off an impending headache.
texts.zh:
她的表情看不出变化，可 Hyder 现在似乎比刚才更不以为然了。

她闭上眼，揉了揉鼻梁，像是在压住一场快要发作的头痛。

texts.en: She doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh: 她看上去并不以为然。

texts.en: Hyder folds her arms, giving you an impatient look.
texts.zh: Hyder 抱起双臂，不耐烦地看着你。

texts.en:
She looks entirely skeptical of the notion.

"Elaborate."
texts.zh:
她对这个说法显然满心怀疑。

"说下去。"

options.en: K-O Jove. He's a sort of information broker and spy on Qaras...
options.zh: K-O Jove。他算是 Qaras 上的情报贩子，也干间谍的活儿...

options.en: Orcus Rao. I'm not saying it'll be easy, but he could get you out of this.
options.zh: Orcus Rao。我不敢说这事容易，但他能把你从这里捞出去。

options.en: Orcus Rao. I'm not saying it'll be easy, but he could get you out of this.
options.zh: Orcus Rao。我不敢说这事容易，但他能把你从这里捞出去。

options.en: Faro Inesis. He's... an agent, of sorts, for an arm of Tri-Tachyon. He'll do it for credits.
options.zh: Faro Inesis。他算是...速子科技某个分支机构的代理人。给星币他就办事。

options.en: Finlay Siyavong. He's a Persean League agent...
options.zh: Finlay Siyavong。他是英仙座联盟的特工...

options.en: Arnaud Iscare. He's a reputable Charterist...
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare。他是个口碑不错的宪章派...

options.en: Perhaps this wasn't such a good idea...
options.zh: 也许这主意本来就不怎么样...

texts.en:
"A criminal and a pirate, you mean," she says, interrupting. "From Qaras, a notorious and lawless gathering of spacer trash of the worst kind."

"I'll hear no more of it."
texts.zh:
"你是说，一个罪犯、一个海盗，\"她打断你。\"从 Qaras 来的——那地方声名狼藉、无法无天，聚着最下等的太空渣滓。"

"这事我不想再听了。"

texts.en:
"Rao."

There's a change in her voice.

"He hates me, you know," she says. "He hates us all. You cannot understand unless you were there."
texts.zh:
"Rao。"

她的声音变了。

"他恨我，你知道的，\"她说。\"他恨我们所有人。除非你当时在场，否则你不会明白。"

texts.en: "The Hegemony already sentenced me for... mutiny," she speaks robotically. "They abhor mutiny, as well they should."
texts.zh: "霸主已经以...叛乱罪判过我，\"她机械地说。\"他们痛恨叛乱，这理所应当。"

options.en: Let me try. I'll speak to him, get a deal.
options.zh: 让我试试。我去跟他谈，谈成一笔交易。

options.en: I'll speak to him, get a deal. Anything is possible.
options.zh: 我去跟他谈，谈成一笔交易。什么事都有可能。

texts.en:
Hyder takes a deep breath, composing herself.

"I will hear your offer. But I agree to nothing."
texts.zh:
Hyder 深吸一口气，稳住心神。

"你的提议我可以听。但我什么都没答应。"

options.en: In the meantime, watch yourself. Macario...
options.zh: 这期间，你自己当心。Macario...

texts.en:
She places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank you captain, your report will be given due consideration by the appropriate authorities. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."

Her expression is grimly neutral.

"That will be all."
texts.zh:
她双手背到身后，摆出正式的姿态。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长。你的报告会由有关部门予以适当考虑。荣耀归于辛达强权。"

她的神情冷硬，毫无波澜。

"就到这里。"

texts.en: Your tech officer gives a casual salute and looks to ops - who nods - then taps something on a datapad.
texts.zh: 你的技术军官随意地敬了个礼，看向行动长官——对方点了点头——随后在数据板上点了点什么。

texts.en:
"This'll take a minute," says Tech. "It's big. Don't know what Rao's cooked up, considering, uh."

With an apologetic look your tech officer shuts up and adopts a stiff at-attention posture as if to make up for the breach of protocol.
texts.zh:
"这要花上一分钟，\"技术官说，\"东西很大。考虑到眼下的情况，真不知道 Rao 都捣鼓了些什么，呃。"

你的技术军官带着歉意看了你一眼，闭上嘴，摆出一副僵硬的立正姿势，仿佛想以此弥补方才的失礼。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"That's it, ah, $playerSirOrMadam," Tech reports. "Confirmation ping returns true. Lots of traffic..."

A quick salute and they retreat to their post in a secondary ops-lab.
texts.zh:
"好了，啊，$playerSirOrMadam，\"技术官报告道，\"确认回执为真。通讯流量很大..."

一个干脆的敬礼之后，他们退回了副行动室的岗位。

texts.en:
"That's it, ah, $playerSirOrMadam," Tech reports. "Confirmation ping returns true. Lots of traffic..."

A quick salute and they retreat to their post in a secondary ops-lab.
texts.zh:
"好了，啊，$playerSirOrMadam，\"技术官报告道，\"确认回执为真。通讯流量很大..."

options.zh: 与 Oxana Hyder 的舰队建立通讯链路

texts.en:
The connection stutters through a series of hyperwave adjustment cycles, then proceeds to a holding signal- awaiting pickup.

After a moment, Hyder herself appears, at attention.

A look of shock flashes across her face as she registers it is indeed you she is looking at, not a lieutenant star marshal ensconced in the star fortress orbiting Sindria, as she expected.
texts.zh:
连接在一连串超波校准周期中卡顿地推进，随后转入等待接通的保持信号。

片刻之后，Hyder 本人出现在画面中，站得笔直。

当她看清屏幕对面确实是你，而不是她预想中那位驻守 Sindria 轨道恒星要塞的低阶星际元帅时，脸上闪过一丝震惊。

options.en: Deputy Star Marshal Hyder. We have much to discuss.
options.zh: 副星际元帅 Hyder。我们有很多事要谈。

options.en: Hi, remember me?
options.zh: 嗨，还记得我吗？

texts.en: She swats the privacy field control, and a vague blurriness grows around her.
texts.zh: 她啪地拍下隐私场控制键，一层朦胧的模糊在她周围弥漫开来。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word.

"I recall you all but declared yourself Supreme Executor the last time we spoke. You have no tact and less honor. You're nothing but Macario's pet imp, sent to tempt and corrupt."

"And now, what has happened? He's cut you loose? Declared you terrorist and murderer - for all I know it's true. Maybe it doesn't-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。"她把这个字吐了出来。

"我记得上次谈话时，你几乎就要自封最高元首了。你毫无分寸，更无荣誉可言。你不过是 Macario 养的一只小恶魔，被派来引诱和腐蚀别人。"

"现在呢，出什么事了？他把你甩了？宣布你是恐怖分子和杀人犯——就我所知，这或许是真的。也许这并不——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word.

"I recall you were Macario's lickspittle. Now he's cut you loose, it appears. Declared you his nemesis, a terrorist and murderer. For all I know it's true."

"I don't trust a word you-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。"她把这个字吐了出来。

"我记得你是 Macario 的跟屁虫。现在看样子，他把你甩了。宣布你是他的死敌、恐怖分子和杀人犯。就我所知，这或许是真的。"

"你说的每一个字我都不信——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word. "Macario's lickspittle."

"I see he's cut you loose, declared you his nemesis. A terrorist and murderer. For all I know it's true."

"Now you hack our comms? Not only do you have no honor, you waste your-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。\"她把这个字吐了出来，\"Macario 的跟屁虫。"

"我看出来了，他把你甩了，宣布你是他的死敌。恐怖分子和杀人犯。就我所知，这或许是真的。"

"现在你还来黑我们的通讯？你不但毫无荣誉，还白白浪费你的——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"Last we spoke you were acting as Macario's minion. Now you're declared his arch-nemesis, a terrorist and murderer. To speak with you is treason."

"Was betrayal your reward? Not that I believe Dolos, of course."

Her expression doesn't soften.

"Not the way he tells it, anyway. Were the killings just a job? Or are you another convenient Spider's patsy whose worth is spent?"
texts.zh:
"上次我们说话时，你还是 Macario 的走狗。如今你被宣布为他的头号死敌、恐怖分子和杀人犯。跟你说话就是叛国。"

"背叛就是你的报酬？当然，我并不相信 Dolos 的说辞。"

她的神色没有缓和。

"至少不像他说的那样。那些谋杀只是一桩差事吗？还是说，你又是蜘蛛随手用完即弃的替罪羊，价值已经耗尽？"

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName." She pauses, then takes a deep breath.

"I do not believe Macario. At least, I don't believe whatever has happened went the way he tells it. The entire announcement... secret heirs, after all this time?"

She looks at you, suspicious, but clearly wanting answers.
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"她顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario。至少，我不信发生的一切真像他说的那样。整场宣告...秘密继承人，过了这么久才冒出来？"

她看着你，满腹狐疑，可显然是在等一个答案。

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"I do not believe the news, the lies, which Macario has spread concerning you. I can only imagine he is, once more, attempting to tarnish the reputation of an honorable leader."

"Besides," she says, shaking her head, "...secret heirs, hidden conspiracies suddenly revealed? After all this time?"
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario 散布的关于你的那些消息、那些谎言。我只能认为，他又一次想抹黑一位可敬领袖的名声。"

"再说，"她摇着头说，"...秘密继承人、暗藏的阴谋突然被揭穿？过了这么多年？"

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"I do not believe the news, the lies, which Macario has spread concerning you. I can only imagine he is, once more, attempting to tarnish the reputation of an honorable leader."

"Besides," she says, shaking her head, "if the files you gave me are all true..."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario 散布的关于你的那些消息、那些谎言。我只能认为，他又一次想抹黑一位可敬领袖的名声。"

"再说，"她摇着头说，"要是你给我的那些档案都是真的..."

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"Much has happened. Philip, declared dead. Macario presenting this... clone of Philip as successor. Your files were real."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"发生了很多事。Philip，被宣布死亡。Macario 把 Philip 的...那个克隆体推出来当继承人。你的档案是真的。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.zh: 继续
