options.en: Was it a mistake to trust Macario?
options.zh: 信任 Macario 是不是一开始就错了？

texts.en: It is increasingly clear that he considers you a loose end that needs to be trimmed.
texts.zh: 越来越清楚的是，他把你当成了一个需要剪掉的尾巴。

options.en: Forget about Macario, then. I must support the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 那就别再管 Macario 了。我必须支持辛达强权！

options.en: I'll make Macario regret his betrayal. Revenge will be mine!
options.zh: 我要让 Macario 为他的背叛后悔。这仇我一定报！

texts.en:
The question remains- Which Sindrian Diktat?

Who will you back as the true heir of Andrada?
texts.zh:
问题仍在——哪一个辛达强权？

你要拥立谁作 Andrada 真正的继承人？

options.en: Hector. Who I shall convince of my loyalty.
options.zh: Hector。我会让他相信我的忠诚。

options.en: Achilles. Who, conveniently, already opposes Macario.
options.zh: Achilles。正好，他本就与 Macario 为敌。

texts.en:
Then you must prove yourself despite the inconvenience of being declared the foremost enemy of the Sindrian Diktat by that treacherous spymaster.

Hector will recognize your loyalty because you will demonstrate it to him by providing material support, securing wavering allies, and pledging yourself directly to his cause - once you have the opportunity to do so...
texts.zh:
那么，尽管那个背信弃义的谍报头子已把你宣布为辛达强权的头号公敌，你仍得证明自己。

Hector 会认可你的忠诚，因为你要以实际支援、稳住摇摆的盟友、直接向他宣誓效忠来向他证明——只等你有机会这么做...

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The only way you are going to be able to contact Hector - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Hyder hold her ships back? Would Caden?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
texts.zh:
你能联系上 Hector——或任何其他人——的唯一办法，就是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Hyder 会约束住她的舰船吗？Caden 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh: 断开中继连接，离开

texts.en: Then you must pledge yourself to Achilles, a trained military leader who is not burdened by being the puppet of a spymaster quite so treacherous as Dolos Macario.
texts.zh: 那么你必须向 Achilles 宣誓效忠——一位受过训练的军事领袖，不必背负做 Dolos Macario 这种背信弃义的谍报头子傀儡的包袱。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh: 断开中继连接，离开

texts.en:
So it's personal.

You will pledge yourself to one goal above all: the destruction of Dolos Macario.

Who are his enemies? Who will turn on him, who will aid you in sabotaging his machinations? Now is the time to call upon their resources.
texts.zh:
这么说，是私怨。

你将立誓只为一个目标：毁掉 Dolos Macario。

谁是他的敌人？谁会倒戈相向，谁会帮你破坏他的算计？现在正是动用他们资源的时候。

options.en:
Continue
#defaultLeave:Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh:
继续
#defaultLeave:断开中继连接，离开

texts.en:
And what of the heirs?

Who will you back as a 'true' heir of Andrada?
texts.zh:
那些继承人呢？

你要拥立谁作 Andrada 的'真正'继承人？

options.en: Hector. Who I shall convince of my loyalty.
options.zh: Hector。我会让他相信我的忠诚。

options.en: Achilles. Who, conveniently, already opposes Macario.
options.zh: Achilles。正好，他本就与 Macario 为敌。

options.en: No one. Let them both burn, and their Sindrian Diktat with them.
options.zh: 谁都不。让他们两个一起烧，连同他们的辛达强权。

texts.en: So be it.
texts.zh: 那就这样吧。

options.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave
options.zh: 断开中继连接，离开

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Have no fear that I misconstrue your ultimate loyalty, captain. I've already heard that very sentiment often, and clearly."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"不必担心我会误解你最终的忠诚，舰长。这种话我已经听得多了，而且听得清清楚楚。"

texts.en:
"I cannot disagree."

He smiles, though it is a cold smile. "Leadership in Askonia has been rather scarce of late, has it not?"
texts.zh:
"我无法反驳。"

他笑了笑，只是那笑冷得很。"最近 Askonia 的领导人可是相当稀缺，不是吗？"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Trust that I have no intention of becoming that, captain."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"请相信，我没有变成那种人的打算，舰长。"

texts.en:
"Trust that I have no intention of becoming that, captain."

He smiles, a cold smile.

"Strange, though, this behaviour... from a client of Fortuna Kato. Or do you call it a partnership?"
texts.zh:
"请相信，我没有变成那种人的打算，舰长。"

他露出一个冷笑。

"不过真奇怪，这种做派... 竟出自 Fortuna Kato 的一个门客。还是说，你们管这叫合伙？"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"I am entirely untroubled by your motivation, captain. After all it is likely, though not certain, that he was behind the assassination attempt that Fleet Intelligence is content to call 'a bar fight'."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"你的动机我毫不介意，舰长。毕竟那场暗杀——舰队情报部乐意称之为'一场酒吧斗殴'——多半是他主使的，虽然还不能确定。"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"I have no qualms with your motive, captain. After all it is likely, though not certain, that he tried to have me assassinated in what League intelligence is content to call 'a bar fight'. The other possibilities..."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"你的动机我毫无意见，舰长。毕竟他多半——虽然还不能确定——就是想让人暗杀我，而联盟情报部门乐意把这事称作'一场酒吧斗殴'。其余的可能性..."

texts.en:
"You made a wager, captain, and I presume you accept the risk that entails."

He smiles, a cold smile.

"I'll see that you win, however. Though not for the sake of your accounts."
texts.zh:
"你下了注，舰长，我猜你也接受随之而来的风险。"

他露出一个冷笑。

"不过，我会让你赢的。虽然不是为了你的账本。"

texts.en:
"The work of Agent Siyavong, no doubt." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. But your support is welcome, whatever the means by which it was obtained; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"这无疑是 Siyavong 特工的手笔。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。不过，不论你用什么手段换来的，你的支持我都欢迎；我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
"Fortuna. Of course." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome, whatever its motive, and I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna。当然。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。不论你出于什么动机，你的支持我都欢迎，我也并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
"Fortuna. Of course."

Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome, and I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna。当然。"

Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，我不是不知感恩的人。"

texts.en:
Achilles almost smiles, then acknowledges your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 几乎露出笑意，随后以一个点头而非鞠躬，算是领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
Achilles almost smiles, then acknowledges your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 几乎露出笑意，随后以一个点头而非鞠躬，算是领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
Achilles watches you carefully, acknowledging your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 仔细打量着你，以一个点头而非鞠躬，领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected. He doesn't look pleased, however, and understandably.

"I can only assume this is more bedamned Gens politicking," he says. "It has the smell of Reynard Hannan about it."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。不过他看上去并不高兴——这也难怪。

"我只能认为，这又是那些该死的氏族政治，\"他说。\"这味道一闻就是 Reynard Hannan 的手笔。"

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected. He doesn't look pleased, however, and understandably.

"I can only assume this is more bedamned Gens politicking," he says. "It has the smell of Reynard Hannan about it."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。不过他看上去并不高兴——这也难怪。

"我只能认为，这又是那些该死的氏族政治，\"他说。\"这味道一闻就是 Reynard Hannan 的手笔。"

options.en: I tell you this because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

options.en: I tell you this because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

options.en: No, actually I am working with Horus Yaribay.
options.zh: 不，其实我是在和 Horus Yaribay 合作。

texts.en: "I respect your candor, if not your choice of master," he says.
texts.zh: "我敬重你的坦率，虽然不敬重你选的主子，"他说。

texts.en: "A public demonstration of support, even if it is given no true substance, is nonetheless useful."
texts.zh: "公开表态支持，哪怕没有半点实质内容，也依然有用。"

texts.en: "Then I may say with confidence that we share that much," he says, though his voice is not warm.
texts.zh: "那么我可以有把握地说，至少在这一点上我们是一致的，"他说，只是语气并不热络。

texts.en:
Achilles is taken aback.

"Unexpected. I always considered Horus Yaribay to be a tr-" He catches himself.

"An uncertain leader. With unconventional beliefs, given his position."
texts.zh:
Achilles 一怔。

"出乎意料。我一直以为 Horus Yaribay 是个叛——"他及时收住了。

"一个靠不住的领袖。以他的位置而言，信念未免太不合常规。"

options.en: I tell you this because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

options.en: I tell you this because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

texts.en:
"This was anticipated," he says, then gives you an inquisitive look.

"But why are you here, now, telling me this?"
texts.zh:
"这在我预料之中，"他说，随后探询地看了你一眼。

"可你为什么现在跑来，把这件事告诉我？"

options.en: To warn you. I want you to win despite Reynard.
options.zh: 来提醒你。我希望你赢，哪怕 Reynard 插手也一样。

options.en: Because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
options.zh: 因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

options.en: Because it amuses me.
options.zh: 因为我觉得有趣。

options.en: Because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

texts.en: "Good," he says like your position is both obvious and unquestionably correct.
texts.zh: "很好，"他说，那口气仿佛你的立场既显而易见，又无可置疑地正确。

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition." Achilles almost smiles. "Your support is welcome; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。\"Achilles 几乎笑了。\"你的支持我欢迎；我不是不知感恩的人。"

texts.en: "I respect your candor," he says. "And I must ask the question: do I have your support?"
texts.zh: "我敬重你的坦率，\"他说。\"而且我必须问一句：我是否得到了你的支持？"

options.en: Yes.
options.zh: 是的。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 没有。

texts.en:
"Too bad," he says. "As we have nothing more to discuss, I will consider the conversation concluded."

Without another word he reaches over and presses the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"太遗憾了，\"他说。\"既然我们再没有什么可谈的，我就此认为谈话结束。"

他一言不发，伸手按下了通讯切断键。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"It is strange, $playerName, to taunt me to my face after so much effort. It is a waste. And for what?"

He, for one, sounds unamused. His expression clears and is replaced by something stoic, hardened over many cycles.

"You are no use to me. Do not interfere."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"$playerName，费了这么多功夫之后当面嘲弄我，真是奇怪。这是浪费。究竟图什么？"

至少他听起来毫无笑意。他脸上的神情一扫而空，换成了某种坚忍的东西——历经许多星历年磨出来的硬。

"你对我没有用处。别来碍事。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: "Then we have nothing more to talk about," he says conclusively, then reaches over and presses the comms cut-off.
texts.zh: "那我们就没有什么可谈的了，"他以定论的口吻说，随后伸手按下了通讯切断键。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"An understandable position," he says calmly. "Your choice must be your own."

"I must ask the question, $titlePL: do I have your support?"
texts.zh:
"可以理解，\"他平静地说。\"你的选择必须由你自己作。"

"我必须问一句，$titlePL：我是否得到了你的支持？"

options.en: Yes.
options.zh: 是的。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 没有。

texts.en: "Yes, we've had unusually sophisticated materiel coming in. Good Tri-Tachyon tech. Unlocked, it seems, by an insider. The kind of kit that usually comes from lucky convoy-raiding."
texts.zh: "是的，最近进来的物资精密得反常。上好的速子科技货。看来是有内鬼解锁的。这种装备，通常只有运气极好地劫下一支运输队才弄得到。"

texts.en:
"It is useful to diversify sources of material support. I expect you appreciate the implications, captain."

He nods toward you. "I do."
texts.zh:
"物资来源多样化，总是有用的。我想你明白这意味着什么，舰长。"

他朝你点了点头。"我明白。"

texts.en:
He nods, satisfied and even amused.

"It is welcome," he says. "I admit, my staff - yes, I have a staff now - was a little surprised when your partner first made contact."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，颇为满意，甚至有些觉得好笑。

"这很受欢迎，\"他说。\"我承认，我的幕僚——没错，我现在也有幕僚了——在你那位伙伴初次接触时，还有点吃惊。"

texts.en:
"Of course." He doesn't quite smile.

"My logistics team noted that the black market prices were unusually generous. My new shadowy 'benefactor' might make enemies of the usual con-artists if they aren't careful."
texts.zh:
"当然。"他算不上笑了。

"我的后勤组注意到，黑市上的价格优惠得反常。我那位新来的、神出鬼没的'恩主'，要是不小心，恐怕会把那些惯常坑蒙拐骗的家伙都得罪光。"

texts.en:
He blinks, expressionless.

Saying nothing for several moments more. As if to drive the point home that he does not owe you an explanation or even a reaction.

"Captain," he says finally. "You did not come here to whine, I hope."
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，面无表情。

又是好一会儿一言不发。仿佛要把这一点钉实：他不欠你任何解释，甚至连一个反应都不欠。

"舰长，\"他终于开口。\"我希望你不是来这儿诉苦的。"

texts.en:
"Unthinkable," he snaps.

"Those Pather terrorists have been carrying out a campaign of sabotage and assassination to directly undermine my cause. And for what? One would hope that they recognize that I am not my father - or my brother - and am not to fault for the excesses of either."

Achilles takes a deep breath. "I've already shown considerable restraint, captain. Considerable."

His tone makes his feelings about further discussion of the topic quite clear.
texts.zh:
"想都别想，"他厉声道。

"那些左径恐怖分子一直在搞破坏、搞暗杀，就是要直接毁掉我的事业。可这又是图什么？我倒希望他们能明白：我不是我父亲——也不是我兄长——他们两人做过的那些过头事，怪不到我头上。"

Achilles 深吸了一口气。"我已经克制得够多了，舰长。相当多。"

他的语气已经把他的态度说得很清楚：这个话题不必再谈。

texts.en:
Shockingly, the comms open not with some under-secretary, but upon Reynard Hannan himself.

"$TitlePL $playerLastName! You've made quite an impression in the holos, haven't you - a terrorist and child-murderer, I hear."

He chuckles luxuriously, then quite deliberately catches himself, and pauses.

"I know, I know. It's just Dolos playing his game."
texts.zh:
出乎意料，通讯接通的不是哪个副秘书，而是 Reynard Hannan 本人。

"$TitlePL $playerLastName！你在全息新闻里可真是出尽风头——恐怖分子，还杀过孩子，我听说是这样。"

他惬意地低笑几声，随即刻意收住，顿了顿。

"我知道，我知道。不过是 Dolos 在玩他那套把戏。"

options.en: Macario is slandering your client. You'll allow that?
options.zh: Macario 在诽谤你的门客。这你也能由着他？

options.en: Yes, it's all terribly funny. Especially to me.
options.zh: 是啊，这一切真是好笑极了。尤其对我而言。

options.en: He's only sealing his own fate as far as I'm concerned.
options.zh: 在我看来，他只是在亲手了结自己的命运。

options.en: Macario is slandering your client. You'll allow that?
options.zh: Macario 在诽谤你的门客。这你也能由着他？

options.en: He's crafting a big lie to cover his attempt to seize control of the Diktat!
options.zh: 他编出一套弥天大谎，就为了掩盖他夺取强权控制权的图谋！

options.en: It doesn't matter - he must be destroyed for the good of the Sector.
options.zh: 那不重要——为了星域的大局，他必须被除掉。

options.en: Macario is slandering your client. You'll allow that?
options.zh: Macario 在诽谤你的门客。这你也能由着他？

options.en: Yes, it's very funny being declared a child-murdering terrorist.
options.zh: 是啊，被人宣布成杀害孩童的恐怖分子，真是太好笑了。

options.en: Macario is slandering your client. You'll allow that?
options.zh: Macario 在诽谤你的门客。这你也能由着他？

options.en: Yes, it's all terribly funny. Especially to me.
options.zh: 是啊，这一切真是好笑极了。尤其对我而言。

options.en: He's only sealing his own fate as far as I'm concerned.
options.zh: 在我看来，他只是在亲手了结自己的命运。

texts.en:
A slow smile grows.

"It seems you understand my position. It is refreshing, from time to time, to be relieved of the need to explain myself yet again to some underling."
texts.zh:
一个笑容缓缓绽开。

"看来你明白我的处境。偶尔不必再向哪个下属解释一遍自己，倒也让人神清气爽。"

texts.en: "I'll see to Dolos," he says. "But first there is a matter more important to me. Fortuna Kato."
texts.zh: "Dolos 的事我会处置，\"他说，\"但眼下有件对我更重要的事。Fortuna Kato。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"But first, I ask a question of you, $titlePL," he says regally.

"It is the question of whether you are with me, with Gens Hannan, or if you are not. I would see that you given great rewards, power, and access as a client of my patronage."

"It is a choice," he says softly. "I want you to confirm it to me."

"Now."
texts.zh:
"但首先，我要问你一个问题，$titlePL，"他说，气度俨然。

"问题就是：你到底站在我这边、站在 Hannan 氏族这边，还是不。若你站过来，我会让你作为我的门客，得到丰厚的赏赐、权力与门路。"

"这是个选择，\"他轻声说，\"我要你亲口向我确认。"

"就现在。"

options.en: I am with you.
options.zh: 我站在你这边。

options.en: I cannot submit myself to you and your Gens.
options.zh: 我不能向你和你的氏族屈膝。

texts.en: "Good," he whispers.
texts.zh: "很好，"他低声道。

texts.en: The comms cut quite abruptly.
texts.zh: 通讯骤然中断。

texts.en: Reynard's meaning is as clear as your answer to his arrogant demand. If you want help, you'll have to go elsewhere.
texts.zh: 你对他那傲慢要求的回答，已经让 Reynard 的意思再明白不过。想要帮忙，你得另寻他人。

texts.en:
"Now - we were speaking of the ANDRADA files."

Reynard sits up, attentive. Expectant.
texts.zh:
"好了——刚才我们说到 ANDRADA 档案。"

Reynard 坐直身子，专注，带着期待。

texts.en:
He drops whatever expression he was performing for you and turns away.

The link cuts to black.
texts.zh:
他收起了那副专门演给你看的神情，转过身去。

通讯切断，屏幕一片漆黑。

texts.en: "I'll see to Dolos," he says. "But first is a matter more important to me: Fortuna Kato."
texts.zh: "Dolos 的事我会处置，\"他说，\"但眼下有件对我更重要的事：Fortuna Kato。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Fortuna Kato's puppet, Achilles, will soon launch his claim as Philip Andrada's heir."

He looks off-link as he speaks, at some view not shared with you. It's probably grand.

"She seeks to undermine the cohesion of the Persean League and primacy of Gens Hannan. A foolish plan, and doomed, but it nonetheless requires my personal response."

He smiles to himself, a feral gleam in his eyes. "She'll see that I am not lax in my attentions. And you can help me with a part of it."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna Kato 的傀儡，Achilles，很快就要公开宣称自己是 Philip Andrada 的继承人。"

他说话时目光飘向链路之外，看着一处不与你共享的景象。那景象想必很气派。

"她想瓦解英仙座联盟的团结，动摇 Hannan 氏族的首要地位。这计划很蠢，也注定失败，可终究需要我亲自应对。"

他自顾自地笑了笑，眼里闪着野性的光。"她会看到，我盯事情从不松懈。而其中一部分，你可以帮我。"

options.en: What are you proposing?
options.zh: 你的提议是什么？

texts.en:
"A quiet and civilized war, as is proper. I have had a quantity of materiel assembled. It shall be transferred to your name before the end of our conversation."

"I want you to take this materiel to Umbra and give Imoinu Kato everything she possibly wants for her little play-revolution."

He seems very, very pleased with himself.

"Do this, and you will be rewarded."
texts.zh:
"一场安静而文明的战争，这才合规矩。我已经备好了一批军需物资，等我们谈完，就会转到你名下。"

"我要你把这批物资送到 Umbra，交给 Imoinu Kato；她那个过家家似的革命要什么，就给她什么。"

他看上去对自己满意极了。

"办成这件事，你会得到赏赐。"
effects: #AddTextSmall "You have been given fuel and supplies in a storage bay on $entity.name" highlight

texts.en:
"I was going to ask you to take weapons and supplies to Umbra to fuel one Imoinu Kato's little revolution - imagine my surprise at the report that you had already done so!"

He examines you with an oddly penetrating gaze far from his usual show of nonchalance.

"If I was a more suspicious man, I might have concerns that you shared the anarchic delusions of Antis like the Gens Kato child. But I know you better than that, $titlePL. You appreciate what power provides."

"Keep up the good work. I want the Gens Kato child to have everything she wants."
texts.zh:
"我本打算让你带武器和补给去 Umbra，给 Imoinu Kato 那场小革命添把火——结果报告说，你已经这么干过了！你可以想见我有多意外。"

他打量着你，目光锐利得有些反常，全无平日那副漫不经心。

"我要是疑心再重些，或许会担心你跟 Kato 氏族那小丫头一样，抱着 Antis 那套无政府的妄想。可我了解你，$titlePL，不至于此。你懂得权力能给你什么。"

"继续这么干。Kato 氏族那小丫头要什么，我就要她得到什么。"

texts.en:
"I was going to ask you to take weapons and supplies to Umbra to fuel one Imoinu Kato's little revolution - imagine my surprise at the report that you had already done so."

He examines you with an oddly penetrating gaze far from his usual show of nonchalance.

"If I was a more suspicious man, I might have concerns that you shared the anarchic delusions of Antis like the Gens Kato child. But I know you better than that, $titlePL. You appreciate what power provides."

He snaps his fingers at someone off-link.
texts.zh:
"我本打算让你带武器和补给去 Umbra，给 Imoinu Kato 那场小革命添把火——结果报告说，你已经这么干过了。你可以想见我有多意外。"

他打量着你，目光锐利得有些反常，全无平日那副漫不经心。

"我要是疑心再重些，或许会担心你跟 Kato 氏族那小丫头一样，抱着 Antis 那套无政府的妄想。可我了解你，$titlePL，不至于此。你懂得权力能给你什么。"

他朝链路外的某个人打了个响指。

options.en: You want me to... help Imoinu and the ARC?
options.zh: 你要我...去帮 Imoinu 和 ARC？

texts.en:
"Yes!"

He laughs.

"Nothing will vex Fortuna more. I want to see the flames from Kazeron!"

He closes his eyes to take in a slow, pleased breath.

"If there's anything left over, keep it. Use it or sell it, I don't care."
texts.zh:
"对！"

他大笑起来。

"没什么比这更让 Fortuna 恼火了。我要从 Kazeron 都能看见那火光！"

他闭上眼，缓缓吸了一口气，满心惬意。

"要是有剩下的，就留着。自己用还是卖掉，我不管。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"As for Macario's propaganda... yes, in fact, I have just the thing. Speak to Finlay Siyavong; he's an agent with Fleet Intelligence. A bit unimaginative," Reynard flashes a look of minor embarassment on Siyavong's behalf, "but competent nonetheless."

"He has much potential if he can get over... well, you'll see. My secretary will arrange his comms-id for you, I'm sure."

Reynard looks away, something off-link catching his eye.
texts.zh:
"至于 Macario 的那套宣传...没错，我这儿正好有个办法。去找 Finlay Siyavong，他是舰队情报部的特工。人有点缺乏想象力，\"Reynard 脸上掠过一丝替 Siyavong 感到的尴尬，\"但办事还是靠得住的。"

"只要他能克服...算了，你见了就知道。他很有潜力。我的秘书会把他的通讯编号给你，我想没问题。"

Reynard 移开目光，链路外有什么东西吸引了他。

options.en: I've spoken with Agent Siyavong before.
options.zh: 我之前和 Siyavong 特工谈过。

texts.en:
"Wonderful," he says in a way that ensures you are not mistaken about the fact that he does not care.

"Fleet Intelligence will probably ask you to pledge yourself to support Achilles Andrada," he waves a hand, growing bored.

"Do it, or don't, I care not."
texts.zh:
"太好了，"他说道，那语气确保你不会误会——他其实一点也不在乎。

"舰队情报部大概会让你表态支持 Achilles Andrada，"他摆了摆手，已经开始觉得无聊。

"做不做，随你，我不在乎。"

options.en: Don't you want to undermine Achilles, and therefore Kato?
options.zh: 你不想搞垮 Achilles，从而搞垮 Kato 吗？

texts.en:
"Ultimately." He looks over his desk at you. "But I find it amusing to allow Fortuna to believe the millions of credits she's committed to this scheme, and continues to commit, will pay off."

He barks a laugh to himself.

"Let us speak of it again after the war is announced. Now I have much to do. Probably. Good day then, $titlePL."

The comms cut seemingly of their own accord, to a holding pattern, the crest of Gens Hannan.
texts.zh:
"终究会。\"他隔着桌子看向你。\"不过我倒觉得有趣：让 Fortuna 相信她投进这个计划的几百万星币——还有她继续投的那些——终会有回报。"

他自顾自地短笑了一声。

"等战争宣布之后，我们再谈这件事。眼下我有很多事要办。大概吧。那就这样，$titlePL，日安。"

通讯仿佛自己断了，转入了等待画面：Hannan 氏族的纹章。

texts.en:
"Ultimately." He looks over his desk at you. "But I find it amusing to allow Fortuna to believe the millions of credits she's committed to this scheme, and continues to commit, will pay off."

He barks a laugh to himself, then pauses.

"Although... yes, I think I would have you speak to Horus Yaribay."
texts.zh:
"终究会。\"他隔着桌子看向你。\"不过我倒觉得有趣：让 Fortuna 相信她投进这个计划的几百万星币——还有她继续投的那些——终会有回报。"

他自顾自地短笑了一声，随即顿住。

"不过...对，我想让你去和 Horus Yaribay 谈谈。"

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: What do you want me to say to Horus?
options.zh: 你要我对 Horus 说什么？

texts.en:
Reynard's secretary appears, for only a moment. "Hold please, I shall forward the link per the Prime Demarchon's request," they say, before disappearing.

The crest of Gens Hannan appears again for a moment. An upthrust, open hand. Golden rays.

You're pondering Reynard's petty revenge against Fortuna via her granddaughter Imoinu when your quartermaster pings you about an inquiry from a warehouse manager on $entity.name.

Before you can respond, the comms flash an incoming link.
texts.zh:
Reynard 的秘书只露了一瞬。"请稍候，我这就按大统领的吩咐把链路转过去，"说完便消失了。

Hannan 氏族的纹章又出现了一瞬：一只向上张开的手，金色的光芒。

你正琢磨着 Reynard 如何借 Fortuna 的孙女 Imoinu 来实施他那点小报复，军需官忽然发来提示：$entity.name 上有一位仓库管理员提出查询。

你还没来得及回应，通讯界面上闪起一条接入请求。

options.en: Accept the link
options.zh: 接入通讯

texts.en:
"Advise him, as a contact, as a friend, to work against Fortuna Kato," he says, a slow smile growing at the thought.

"He is soft and will respond to sentiment. Then let us speak of all of this again, once the war is announced, as soon it must be. I have much to do now, probably."

"Good day, $titlePL."

The comms cut seemingly of their own accord.
texts.zh:
"以联系人的身份、以朋友的身份劝他，去跟 Fortuna Kato 作对，"他说，想到这儿，笑容缓缓绽开。

"他心软，吃感情这一套。等战争宣布之后——那不会太久了——我们再把这一切谈一遍。眼下我有很多事要办，大概吧。"

"日安，$titlePL。"

通讯仿佛自己断了。

options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

options.zh: 我去找 Finlay Siyavong

options.zh: 我去找 Horus Yaribay

options.zh: 我不需要任何人的帮助

texts.en: He, at least, can be counted on to support the Persean League rather than the interests of one Gens over another.
texts.zh: 至少他指望得上——他会支持英仙座联盟，而不是让某一个氏族的利益压过别家。

options.en: Open the comm directory
options.zh: 打开通讯目录

texts.en: You connect to the local comm directory and browse the public and otherwise known listings.
texts.zh: 你与本地通讯目录建立连接，并浏览公共列表和其他已知列表。

texts.en: For all her pride, at least Fortuna Kato will make an agreement without demanding you submit as if to a king.
texts.zh: 尽管她骄横自负，至少 Fortuna Kato 愿意谈条件，不会要求你像对君王那样俯首称臣。

options.en: Open the comm directory
options.zh: 打开通讯目录

texts.en: Despite his distance from true power, despite his self-doubt, at least Horus does not seek to make himself your master.
texts.zh: 尽管他与真正的权力相隔甚远，尽管他心存自我怀疑，至少 Horus 没打算做你的主子。

options.en: Open the comm directory
options.zh: 打开通讯目录

texts.en: If Reynard Hannan cannot accept your independence, then you'll simply have to take it for yourself and act accordingly.
texts.zh: 既然 Reynard Hannan 容不下你的独立，那你就自己去挣，然后照自己的意思行事。

options.en: Close the comms interface
options.zh: 关闭通讯界面

texts.en:
"Then you resign yourself to irrelevance," Reynard says with icy contempt.

"I have nothing more to say to you."
texts.zh:
"那你就是认了命，甘做一个无足轻重的人，"Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑。

"我跟你没什么好说的了。"

texts.en:
"Oh?" He raises his eyebrows, carnivorous smile in place.

"Perhaps I shouldn't place my hand upon the scale... just to see how you attempt it."

"But as amusing as that might be, I cannot let this insult to my patronage go unanswered."
texts.zh:
"哦？"他挑起眉毛，脸上挂着那副食肉动物般的笑。

"也许我不该伸手去动那架天平...就看看你打算怎么动手。"

"可尽管那会很有趣，对我这份庇护的侮辱，我不能不作回应。"

texts.en:
A slow smile grows. Then he can't hold it in any longer, and he bursts out laughing, canines flashing.

It takes him some time to settle down.

"You came to me- for help?"

He suppresses another burst of laughter. "Due to your own short-sighted decisions, you are no longer a member of the Persean League, captain! You expect... help? From ME?"
texts.zh:
一个笑容缓缓绽开。接着他再也憋不住，放声大笑起来，犬齿闪着光。

他好一会儿才收住笑。

"你来找我——就为了求助？"

他压下又一阵笑。"因为你自己那些短视的决定，你已经不再是英仙座联盟的一员了，舰长！你还指望...帮忙？从我这儿？"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You've resigned yourself to irrelevance," Reynard says with icy contempt. "I have nothing more to say to you."

The comms cut.

Reynard has made his position clear. If you want help, you'll have to go elsewhere.
texts.zh:
"你已经认了命，甘做一个无足轻重的人，\"Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑，\"我跟你没什么好说的了。"

通讯中断。

Reynard 的立场已经很清楚了。想要帮忙，你得另寻他人。

texts.en:
"No doubt," he says, not quite rolling his eyes. "You need to learn to enjoy yourself from time to time, $titlePL," he says. "I do."

He lets out a breath and looks aside.

"Regardless. I cannot let this insult to my patronage go unanswered."
texts.zh:
"那是自然，\"他说，差点就要翻起白眼。\"$titlePL，你得学会偶尔让自己快活一点，\"他说，\"我就很会。"

他吐出一口气，目光移向别处。

"总之。对我这份庇护的侮辱，我不能不作回应。"

texts.en:
Your comms connect.

"Arroyo here."

Rayan Arroyo looks you over, not quite disapproving.

"Askonia. Exciting place."
texts.zh:
通讯接通了。

"Arroyo 在此。"

Rayan Arroyo 把你打量了一遍，说不上是不赞同。

"Askonia。是个热闹地方。"

options.en: Yes, that's one way to put it.
options.zh: 是啊，也可以这么说。

options.en: A lot of good people died, Rayan.
options.zh: Rayan，很多好人死了。

texts.en:
He shrugs, then leans back, fingertips together.

"For me, it was a bit of an exploratory venture. You pushed me," he admits, "But don't get any ideas."
texts.zh:
他耸了耸肩，向后靠去，指尖抵在一起。

"对我来说，这趟多少算是一次探路之行。是你推了我一把，\"他承认道，\"不过你别多想。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Anyway I've got a good 'in' to land some plush reconstruction contracts. They've got a navy to rebuild - I hear the new guy, Hector? He likes warships. But you know what they say about clones..."

Arroyo goes quiet for a second, seeing no need to finish the aphorism.

"There's a lot of planetary infrastructure to rebuild as well, but those won't have quite the same margins." He rubs his hands together. "But also - less oversight. There are opportunities. It'll be busy times!"
texts.zh:
"总之我已经打通了一条不错的路子，能拿下几份肥厚的重建合同。他们要重建舰队——听说那位新人，Hector？他喜欢战舰。不过克隆体那些事，你也知道人们怎么说..."

Arroyo 静了一秒，觉得不必把这句谚语说完。

"要重建的行星基础设施也不少，只是那些的利润差得远。\"他搓了搓手。\"不过——监管也松。机会是有的。接下来有的忙了！"

texts.en:
He sighs, giving you a look just short of accusing.

"Here's the thing - it's politics. You back to wrong guy, make a gamble and the new Grand Lion isn't the one you put your credits on..."

He shakes his head, looking aside. Perhaps at the spectacular mountain-top view from his private chalet.

"Still. Lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. Plenty of planetary infrastructure to bring back online too, but those won't have quite the same margins."
texts.zh:
他叹了口气，看你的眼神里差一点就是责备。

"关键是——这是政治。你押错了人，赌了一把，可新任大狮不是你下了星币的那位..."

他摇了摇头，把目光移开。也许是在看他那座私人山庄外的壮丽山景。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。还有成堆的行星基础设施等着重新上线，只是那些的利润差得远。"

texts.en:
"Anyway I've got a good 'in' to land some plush reconstruction contracts. They've got a navy to rebuild - I hear the new guy, Achilles? He's a navy man. But you know what they say about clones..."

Arroyo goes quiet for a second, seeing no need to finish the aphorism.

"There's planetary infrastructure to rebuild too, and I'm hearing good things about some economic reforms that should loosen things up in Askonia. Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime - with the new guy?"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"It's an open orbit! That's the chatter among investors, anyway." He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead!"
texts.zh:
"总之我已经打通了一条不错的路子，能拿下几份肥厚的重建合同。他们要重建舰队——听说那位新人，Achilles？他是行伍出身。不过克隆体那些事，你也知道人们怎么说..."

Arroyo 静了一秒，觉得不必把这句谚语说完。

"行星基础设施也有得重建，而且我听说有些经济改革会让 Askonia 松快起来。不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近——可现在这位新人呢？"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"眼下是一片开阔轨道！至少投资圈里是这么传的。\"他搓了搓手。\"接下来有的忙了！"

texts.en:
He sighs, giving you a look just short of accusing.

"Here's the thing - it's politics. You back to wrong guy, make a gamble and the new Grand Lion isn't the one you put your credits on..."

He shakes his head, looking aside. Perhaps at the spectacular mountain-top view from his private chalet.

"Still. Lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And plenty of planetary infrastructure to bring back online too, but those won't have quite the same margins."
texts.zh:
他叹了口气，看你的眼神里差一点就是责备。

"关键是——这是政治。你押错了人，赌了一把，可新任大狮不是你下了星币的那位..."

他摇了摇头，把目光移开。也许是在看他那座私人山庄外的壮丽山景。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。还有成堆的行星基础设施等着重新上线，只是那些的利润差得远。"

texts.en:
"A glorious mess, isn't it?" He grins.

"Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime, and not a few senior execs in the Company. And you know what happens when their cozy arrangement with the old guard collapses!"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"Got lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place! Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight." He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead!"
texts.zh:
"一场光辉灿烂的烂摊子，不是吗？"他咧嘴一笑。

"不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近，公司里也有好些高管。你也知道，他们跟旧势力那套舒坦的勾当一垮，会是什么下场！"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是！利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。\"他搓了搓手。\"接下来有的忙了！"

texts.en:
"It's a glorious mess, isn't it." He frowns.

"Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime, and not a few senior execs in the Company. And you know what happens when their cozy arrangement with the old guard collapses!"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"Got lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place. Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight."

He rubs his hands together. "I can still turn this whole operation into the black. Busy times ahead!"
texts.zh:
"这真是场光辉灿烂的烂摊子。"他皱起眉。

"不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近，公司里也有好些高管。你也知道，他们跟旧势力那套舒坦的勾当一垮，会是什么下场！"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是。利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。"

他搓了搓手。"我照样能把整桩买卖做成盈利。接下来有的忙了！"

texts.en:
"I'll tell you what I think - I think it's a big, Ludd-damned mess. First Opis, and now Sindria? What an unbelievable waste of capital."

He shakes his head, clearly upset. Though not quite, you suspect, at the loss of life for its own sake.

"What idiot gave that blowhard Diktat general, or admiral, or... whatever; some idiot gave him a planet-killer. Unbelievable."
texts.zh:
"我跟你说我怎么想——我觉得这就是一大摊卢德诅咒的烂事。先是 Opis，现在又是 Sindria？难以置信的资本浪费。"

他摇了摇头，看样子很恼火。不过你猜，这不全是为那些人命。

"是哪个白痴，把一件行星杀手塞给了辛达强权那个爱吹牛的将军、或者上将、或者...随便什么军衔来着；反正是个白痴把行星杀手给了他。简直难以置信。"

texts.en:
"Wrong!" He slams a hand back on his desk.

"It's 'don't listen to hot tips from $playerName'. I can't believe I ever let you talk me into getting involved."

He turns away.

"Now stop bothering me, I have work to do."
texts.zh:

"正确答案是'别听 $playerName 的内幕消息'。我真不敢相信，我居然让你说动我掺和进来。"

他转过身去。

"行了，别再来烦我，我还有活要干。"

Arroyo looks aside, at the excellent view from his chalet.

"Still. There are lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place! Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight."

He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 把目光移开，望向他山庄外那片极好的景致。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是！利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。"

他搓了搓手。"接下来有的忙了。"

It appears to come through green because $heOrShe sighs, and says, "$PlayerSirOrMadam. You are clear to proceed, just... try to keep a low profile from now on, alright?"

texts.en:
The $faction $personRank pauses and looks off-screen.

"But what about these cargo pods, which, let me check - why, they do contain illegal cargo. Not yours, are they? No? Excellent. We'll be confiscating the contents, then."
texts.zh:
$faction $personRank 停了下来，并把视线从屏幕上移开了。

"请你解释下这些货舱是怎么回事，为什么它们装的是违禁品？这不是你的，对吧？不是？很好，我们之后会没收这些玩意。"

texts.en:
$PersonRank $personName looks vaguely displeased.

"If I catch you running with the transponder off again, you won't get off so easily."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
texts.zh:
$personName $PersonRank 看上去很失望。

"如果再让我抓到你关着{应答器}晃悠，事情就不会这么简单了。"

没等你做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

texts.en:
The scan finds no overt contraband, but there is enough suspicion of your involvement in black market activities that the patrol commander is not appeased by this.

"Prepare to receive a boarding party. We'll be conducting a very thorough, hands-on inspection."

You consider it very likely the inspectors will do some small - but just borderline excusable - damage to the combat worthiness of your ships during the course of this "thorough" inspection.
texts.zh:
扫描没有发现公开的违禁品，但对由于你参与黑市活动的嫌疑充分，巡逻队指挥官对此并未善罢甘休。

"准备好迎接一个登船小组。我们要亲自动手进行一次非常彻底的检查。"

你认为在这次 "彻底" 的检查过程中，检查人员很可能会对你的舰船的战备造成一些还算勉强可以接受的少量损害。

texts.en:
"Well, well. Just as I suspected, we've got a smuggler here. Per standard $faction procedure, you're required to eject the contraband into space, for pickup or incineration at the discretion of the patrol commander."

$PersonRank $personLastName looks rather pleased, and you suspect that "pickup" rather than "incineration" might be the order of the day.
texts.zh:
"好啊。正如我所料，我们这还真逮到了个走私犯。遵照 $faction 的标准流程，你必须将违禁品抛弃到太空中，由巡逻队指挥官全权决定是拾取还是焚毁。"

$PersonRank $personLastName 看上去相当高兴，你猜今天的命令应该是 "拾取" 而不是 "焚毁"。

texts.en:
The comms link holds for a moment on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, $TitlePL $playerLastName," Siyavong says.
texts.zh:
通讯链路在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚低调的徽记上停留了片刻，随后接通。

"你好，$TitlePL $playerLastName，"Siyavong 说。

texts.en:
He proceeds immediately into a rant.

"It was a fool who provided a planet-killer to the Sindrian Diktat," Siyavong says forcefully. "Not a monster, I think. Merely a credits-hungry fool. Or worse, a believer."

He looks away. There is more anger in his voice than you've ever heard before - something well beyond the uptight annoyance you might expect, what with his educated Kazeronian accent.

"I would hate to think it was a believer."

An awkward silence extends.
texts.zh:
他立刻发作起来。

"把行星杀手交给辛达强权的，是个蠢货，\"Siyavong 语气强硬地说。\"我想不是恶棍。只是个见钱眼开的蠢货。或者更糟——一个信徒。"

他移开视线。他声音里的怒气，比你以往听过的都要重——远不止他那口受过良好教育的 Kazeron 腔调本该带来的那种拘谨的烦躁。

"我真不愿去想那是个信徒。"

尴尬的沉默漫延开来。

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Demarchon of the Sindrian Diktat."

Siyavong taps his desk. And you see his half-smile appear.

"Victories which are too great can turn into dangerous things, you know. Sometimes it is best if success is... moderate."
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 以辛达强权统领的身份掌权。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。你看到他那抹半笑浮了上来。

"你要知道，太大的胜利是会变成危险东西的。有时候，成功...适度一些反而最好。"

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Supreme Executor."

"And he's slipped from... Gens influence, shall we say. But at least it was not, as many are also now saying, a 'great' victory."

Siyavong taps his desk.

"Great victories can be a dangerous thing, you know. Sometimes it is best for most of us to avoid too many of them. Accounting for context, of course."
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 以最高元首的身份掌权。"

"而且他已经摆脱了...氏族的操控，姑且这么说吧。但至少，那并不是如今许多人也在说的那种'伟大'胜利。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。

"你要知道，伟大的胜利可能是危险的东西。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利少一些反而最好。当然，这要视情况而定。"

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Supreme Executor after a great victory."

Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for... for the rest of us if there are not too many of them."

His half-smile does not re-appear.
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 在一场伟大胜利之后以最高元首的身份掌权。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对...对我们其余人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好。"

他那抹半笑没有再出现。

texts.en:
"Hector Andrada," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough. He's tapping his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for... for most of us if there are not too many of them. The results, you see; well..."

His half-smile does not re-appear.
texts.zh:
"Hector Andrada，"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。他敲着书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对...对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好。你看那些后果；唉..."

他那抹半笑没有再出现。

texts.en:
"Hector Andrada," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough.

"But it was not, as many are now saying, a great victory." He emphasizes that word, 'great'. Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for most of us if there are not too many of them," a flicker of smile regrows, "with context accounted for, of course."
texts.zh:
"Hector Andrada，"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。

"但那并不是——如今许多人正这么说——一场伟大的胜利。"他把'伟大'这个词咬得很重。Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好，\"一丝笑意重新泛起，\"当然，这要把具体情况算进去。"

texts.en:
"The end of the Sindrian Diktat," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough. "It was no great victory for anyone. Though perhaps the Hegemony is pleased to make example of 'their' mutiny?"

Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for most of us if there are not too many of them," a flicker of a smile regrows, "with context accounted for, of course."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权的终结，\"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。\"那对谁都不是什么伟大的胜利。不过也许霸主倒乐意拿'他们的'那场叛乱来做个榜样？"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好，\"一丝笑意重新泛起，\"当然，这要把具体情况算进去。"

texts.en:
He frowns. Not a subject he wished to revisit, apparently.

"He cannot become anything more than he was." Siyavong raises a finger at you. "I suggest that you not read too much into this absence of information. You recall his condition - which is almost certainly irreversible barring the provision of a miracle which, as a humble servant of the Fleet Intelligence Service, is not amongst the privileges I may draw upon to perform my duties."

"The matter is effectively closed."

He is still frowning.
texts.zh:
他皱起眉头。看来这不是他想再谈的话题。

"他不可能比从前更有起色。\"Siyavong 朝你竖起一根手指。\"我建议你别从这份信息缺失里读出太多东西。你记得他的状况——那几乎肯定是不可逆的，除非出现奇迹；而作为舰队情报部一名卑微的雇员，动用奇迹并不在我履行职责所能享有的特权之列。"

"这件事实际上已经了结了。"

他仍然皱着眉。

texts.en:
"Yes, well." A grimace. "Not quite like this."

He pauses. Watching you.

"What I want is what is best for the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
"是啊，好吧。\"他嘴角一抽，\"可不是这样收场的。"

他顿了顿，目光打量着你。

"我所求的，是对英仙座联盟的安全与安稳最有利的结果，$titlePL。"

texts.en:
He turns his head at you, almost coy.

"I thank you, $titlePL. For your help."
texts.zh:
他转过头看你，神情近乎羞怯。

"我谢谢你，$titlePL。谢谢你的帮助。"

texts.en:
He turns his head at you, almost coy.

"We must all contend with how events played out. You in your way, me in mine. It is, after all, my duty."

Siyavong folds his hands together and re-affirms his ironic half-smile like the lowering of a blast-shield.
texts.zh:
他转过头看你，神情近乎羞怯。

"我们都得面对事情最终的走向。你以你的方式，我以我的。毕竟，这是我的职责。"

Siyavong 十指交叠，重新挂上那抹带着讥诮的半笑，仿佛降下一道防爆闸门。

texts.en:
"What I want," Siyavong says.

He makes as if to consider the question for a moment.

"What I want is the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL." A quick smile. "Contingency and circumstance willing, we may get it."
texts.zh:

他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL。\"他飞快地一笑，\"若时势与机缘允许，我们或许能得到它。"

"What I want is the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL." A quick smile. "Contingency and circumstance willing, we may get it."

他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL。\"他飞快地一笑，\"若时势与机缘允许，我们或许能得到它。"
